<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>DOMINION · City</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0e1116;
    --panel:rgba(252,253,255,.94); --panel2:#ffffff;
    --edge:#d7dee6; --edge2:#bcc7d2;
    --ink:#1d242c; --dim:#5d6975; --dim2:#8a95a1;
    --accent:#2f7fd0; --good:#2f9e63; --bad:#d24b3f; --warn:#d99a2b;
    --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(18,28,40,.16);
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
  html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);
    font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);user-select:none;}
  #app{position:fixed;inset:0;}
  canvas{display:block;touch-action:none;}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;}

  /* ---------- top bar ---------- */
  #top{position:fixed;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:30;
    display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:stretch;}
  .pod{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:11px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);display:flex;align-items:center;}
  .stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;}
  .stat .ic{font-size:15px;}
  .stat .col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.1;}
  .stat .v{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;}
  .stat .l{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--dim2);text-transform:uppercase;}

  #resWrap{position:relative;}
  #resBtn{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:11px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:8px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
    color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:12px;}
  #resBtn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  #resBtn .caret{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim2);}
  #resPanel{position:absolute;top:100%;margin-top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px);
    width:320px;max-height:66vh;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--panel2);
    border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    padding:14px 12px 12px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.16s;}
  #resPanel.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  .rgrp{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim2);
    font-weight:700;margin:9px 0 5px;}
  .rgrp:first-child{margin-top:0;}
  .rgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px 10px;}
  .rrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;padding:2px 0;}
  .rrow .ri{width:15px;text-align:center;}
  .rrow .rn{flex:1;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .rrow .rv{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;}
  .rrow .rf{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;min-width:30px;text-align:right;}
  .rf.up{color:var(--good);} .rf.dn{color:var(--bad);}

  /* ---------- side tools ---------- */
  #tools{position:fixed;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:30;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
  .tool{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--panel);
    border:1px solid var(--edge);color:var(--dim);font-size:17px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    transition:.14s;}
  .tool:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
  .tool.act{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;}
  .tool.on{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad);color:#fff;}

  /* ---------- confirm bar ---------- */
  #confirmBar{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:20px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
    z-index:45;display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--panel2);
    border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:11px 15px;
    opacity:0;transition:.18s;}
  #confirmBar.show{display:flex;opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  #confirmLabel{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;}
  .cfBtn{border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 15px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;}
  .cfYes{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;}
  .cfNo{background:#eef1f4;color:var(--dim);}

  /* ---------- trap picker ---------- */
  #defPanel{position:fixed;left:64px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(-10px);
    z-index:40;width:200px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--edge);
    border-radius:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:11px;display:none;opacity:0;transition:.16s;
    max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;}
  #defPanel.show{display:block;opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);}
  .dpTitle{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim2);
    font-weight:700;margin-bottom:9px;line-height:1.4;}
  .dpGrid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
  .dpItem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;
    background:#f4f6f9;border:1.5px solid transparent;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;width:100%;}
  .dpItem:hover{border-color:var(--edge2);}
  .dpItem.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:#eef4ff;}
  .dpic{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .dpnm{flex:1;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
  .dpcost{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--dim2);white-space:nowrap;}

  /* ---------- build menu ---------- */
  #buildMenu{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:14px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
    z-index:30;width:min(760px,96vw);background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--edge);
    border-radius:15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.18s;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:52vh;}
  #buildMenu.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  #bmHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:11px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);}
  #bmHead h3{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.6px;}
  #bmHead .sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--dim2);}
  #bmClose{background:none;border:none;color:var(--dim2);font-size:15px;}
  #bmTabs{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:9px 15px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .bmtab{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:16px;
    background:#eef2f6;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--dim);}
  .bmtab.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;}
  #bmList{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(228px,1fr));
    gap:7px;padding:11px 15px 14px;overflow-y:auto;}
  .bmitem{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--edge);
    border-radius:10px;background:#fbfcfe;transition:.13s;cursor:pointer;}
  .bmitem:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:#f2f8ff;}
  .bmitem.poor{opacity:.5;}
  .bmic{font-size:22px;width:28px;text-align:center;}
  .bmtxt{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .bmnm{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;}
  .bmd{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim2);line-height:1.3;margin:1px 0 3px;}
  .bmstats{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim);}
  .bmcost{font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;font-weight:600;}
  .levelcard{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;padding:15px;
    border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:12px;background:#fffaf0;}
  .lvic{font-size:30px;}
  .lvtxt{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .lvnm{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;}
  .lvd{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);margin:2px 0 4px;line-height:1.35;}
  .lvstats{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--warn);font-weight:600;}
  .lvcost{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin-top:4px;}
  .lvbtn{padding:11px 18px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--warn);
    background:var(--warn);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;}
  .lvbtn:disabled{background:#e6eaef;border-color:var(--edge);color:var(--dim2);cursor:not-allowed;}
  .bmempty{padding:20px;color:var(--dim2);font-size:12px;text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;}

  /* ---------- production panel ---------- */
  #iProd{margin:8px 0;}
  #iProd:empty{display:none;}
  .prodHead{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 5px;}
  .prodGrid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
  .prodItem{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;
    padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px;background:#eef4ff;border:1px solid transparent;
    cursor:pointer;text-align:left;width:100%;}
  .prodItem:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .prodItem.locked{background:#eceef1;color:var(--dim2);cursor:not-allowed;}
  .prodItem.poor{opacity:.55;}
  .pum{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;}
  .pud{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim2);white-space:nowrap;}
  .qBar{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:#e3e8ee;margin:7px 0 5px;overflow:hidden;}
  .qFill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:3px;transition:width .2s linear;}
  .qList{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;}
  .qChip{font-size:9.5px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:6px;background:#dfe6ef;cursor:pointer;}

  /* ---------- inspector ---------- */
  #inspect{position:fixed;right:66px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(10px);
    z-index:30;width:236px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--edge);
    border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:14px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
    transition:.16s;}
  #inspect.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);}
  #inspect h3{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.4px;}
  #inspect .sub{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim2);text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  #inspect .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;
    padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f5;}
  #inspect .row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  #inspect .row span:first-child{color:var(--dim);}
  #inspect .row span:last-child{font-weight:600;}
  #iUpCost{font-size:10.5px;text-align:center;margin:9px 0 5px;font-weight:600;}
  #inspect button{width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
    border:1px solid var(--edge);background:#f4f7fa;color:var(--ink);margin-top:5px;}
  #iUp{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;}
  #iUp:disabled{background:#e6eaef;border-color:var(--edge);color:var(--dim2);cursor:not-allowed;}
  #iDel:hover{border-color:var(--bad);color:var(--bad);}
  #iClose{position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;width:auto;padding:2px 6px;margin:0;
    background:none;border:none;color:var(--dim2);font-size:14px;}

  /* ---------- hint ---------- */
  #hint{position:fixed;top:112px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:39;
    font-size:11.5px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:18px;
    padding:7px 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);opacity:0;transition:.35s;pointer-events:none;
    white-space:nowrap;}
  #hint.show{opacity:1;}
  #hint b{color:var(--accent);}

  /* ---------- powers ---------- */
  #powers{position:fixed;left:14px;top:14px;z-index:30;width:172px;
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:12px;
    padding:10px 11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  #powers .ptitle{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--dim2);
    text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .prow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:3px 0;font-size:10.5px;}
  .prow .pdot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .prow .pn{flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--dim);}
  .prow.you .pn{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;}
  .prow .pv{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);}

  /* ---------- terraform ---------- */
  #terra{position:fixed;left:14px;top:132px;z-index:30;width:128px;
    background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:11px;
    padding:8px 9px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  #terra .ttitle{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--dim2);
    text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
  #terra .ttitle span{color:var(--warn);}
  .trow{display:flex;gap:4px;}
  .ttool{flex:1;height:30px;border-radius:7px;font-size:15px;line-height:1;
    background:#eef2f6;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--dim);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;}
  .ttool:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .ttool.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);}
  #terraBar{height:4px;border-radius:3px;background:#e3e8ee;margin-top:7px;overflow:hidden;display:none;}
  #terraBar.show{display:block;}
  #terraProg{height:100%;width:0%;background:var(--warn);border-radius:3px;transition:width .1s linear;}
  #terraStatus{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--warn);margin-top:4px;min-height:11px;font-weight:600;}

  /* ---------- warnings ---------- */
  #warnings{position:fixed;top:64px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:29;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:center;}
  .warn{display:none;background:rgba(210,75,63,.95);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
    padding:6px 15px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .tool#tFlat.act{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;}

  /* ---------- crop chooser ---------- */
  #cropPick{position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:99997;
    width:min(460px,94vw);max-height:82vh;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e7ee;
    border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(18,28,40,.28);display:none;
    font-family:Inter,system-ui;padding:0 0 14px;}
  #cropPick.show{display:block;}
  .cpH{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f5;
    font-size:14px;color:#1d242c;position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;}
  .cpH button{margin-left:auto;background:none;border:none;color:#8a95a1;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;}
  .cpS{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#98a1ab;
    font-weight:800;padding:12px 16px 6px;}
  .cpG{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:0 16px;}
  .cpI{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #e4e9ee;
    border-radius:10px;background:#fbfcfe;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;}
  .cpI:hover{border-color:#2f7fd0;background:#f2f8ff;}
  .cpI.on{border-color:#2f7fd0;background:#e8f2fd;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(47,127,208,.16);}
  .cpI i{font-style:normal;font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;}
  .cpI b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#1d242c;}
  .cpI s{text-decoration:none;font-size:10px;color:#7c8894;line-height:1.45;display:block;margin-top:2px;}
  .cpOut{margin:12px 16px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#f4f8f4;
    border:1px solid #dfeadf;font-size:11.5px;color:#3b4652;line-height:1.6;}
  .cpOut b{color:#1d242c;}
  .cpGo{display:block;width:calc(100% - 32px);margin:12px 16px 0;padding:11px;border:none;
    border-radius:11px;background:#2f9e63;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}
  .cpGo:hover{background:#35b070;}
  .cpEdit{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #d7dee6;border-radius:9px;
    background:#f4f7fa;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:#3b4652;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;}
  .cpEdit:hover{border-color:#2f9e63;color:#1d242c;}

  /* ---------- guide (actionable warning) ---------- */
  #guide{position:fixed;left:50%;top:74px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
    z-index:40;width:min(440px,94vw);background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--warn);
    border-left:4px solid var(--warn);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    padding:12px 14px;display:none;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;opacity:0;transition:.2s;}
  #guide.show{display:flex;opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  #guide .gicon{font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;}
  #guide .gtext{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  #guideTitle{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:3px;}
  #guideBody{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.5;}
  #guideBody b{color:var(--ink);}
  #guideClose{background:none;border:none;color:var(--dim2);font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;}

  /* ---------- ponder (recipe diagram) ---------- */
  #ponder{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:72;background:rgba(14,18,24,.72);
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);}
  #ponder.show{display:flex;}
  .pmodal{width:min(440px,94vw);max-height:82vh;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--panel2);
    border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:0;}
  .phead{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--panel2);display:flex;align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);}
  .phead span{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:18px;}
  #ponderClose{background:none;border:none;font-size:16px;color:var(--dim2);}
  #ponderBody{padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0;}
  .pfoot{padding:11px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);text-align:center;}
  .pchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:10px;
    background:#f6f8fb;border:2px solid var(--edge);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}
  .pchip .pci{font-size:14px;}
  .pchip.out{background:#eefaf1;}
  .pchip.out.target{background:#dff5e6;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(47,158,99,.18);}
  .pchip.raw{background:#faf5ec;}
  .pchip.loop{background:#f2f2f5;opacity:.75;}
  .pchip.pw{background:#fff9e6;}
  .pchip .psrc{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:500;}
  .pstep{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;gap:2px;}
  .prow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:2px;
    padding:9px;border:1px dashed var(--edge2);border-radius:12px;background:#fbfcfd;max-width:100%;}
  .pcell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;}
  .psub{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .pplus{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--dim2);padding:0 5px;align-self:center;}
  .pamt{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:700;}
  .pconn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;width:100%;max-width:230px;margin:5px 0;}
  .pconn .pline{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--edge2);}
  .pconn .plbl{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:800;}
  .pconn .plbl.eq{font-size:15px;color:var(--good);letter-spacing:0;}
  .pbuild{padding:9px 16px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
  .palt{font-size:9px;opacity:.85;font-weight:500;}
  .rrow{cursor:pointer;}
  .rrow:hover{background:#f2f6fb;border-radius:6px;}
  .rp{font-size:9px;opacity:0;transition:.1s;}
  .rrow:hover .rp{opacity:.6;}

  /* ---------- city lost ---------- */
  #lostOv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;background:rgba(14,17,22,.82);
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);}
  #lostOv.show{display:flex;}
  #lostOv .card{background:var(--panel2);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 32px;text-align:center;
    max-width:400px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  #lostOv h2{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:1px;
    color:var(--bad);margin-bottom:8px;}
  #lostOv p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.5;}

  /* ---------- menu button + pause overlay ---------- */
  #menuBtn{position:fixed;left:14px;top:14px;z-index:31;background:var(--panel);

const _matCache = {};
function mat(hex, opts){
  opts = opts||{};
  const key = hex+'|'+JSON.stringify(opts);
  if(_matCache[key]) return _matCache[key];
  const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color:hex,
    metalness:opts.metal!==undefined?opts.metal:0.3,
    roughness:opts.rough!==undefined?opts.rough:0.6,
    emissive:opts.emissive!==undefined?opts.emissive:0x000000,
    emissiveIntensity:opts.ei!==undefined?opts.ei:1,
    transparent:opts.transparent||false,
    opacity:opts.opacity!==undefined?opts.opacity:1,
    flatShading:opts.flat||false,
  });
  _matCache[key]=m;
  return m;
}
function styleMat(kind, s){

  if(kind==='glass') return mat(s.glass,{metal:0.9,rough:0.08,emissive:s.emissive,ei:0.35});
  if(kind==='glassLit') return mat(s.glass,{metal:0.4,rough:0.1,emissive:s.emissive,ei:0.9});

  if(kind==='emit') return mat(s.trim,{emissive:s.trim,ei:1.2,metal:0.2,rough:0.4});
  // industrial-specific materials
  if(kind==='brick') return mat(s.brick||s.body,{metal:0.05,rough:0.95});

function buildLighting(){

/* Smooth day/night cycle. Bright, natural daylight; genuinely dark night. */
function applyDayTime(){
  const t = dayTime;                        // 0..1
  const ang = (t-0.25)*Math.PI*2;           // sun angle; t=0.25 sunrise, 0.5 noon
  const elev = Math.sin(ang);               // -1..1  (>0 = day)
  const day = Math.max(0, elev);            // 0 at horizon, 1 at noon
  const night = Math.max(0, -elev);

  sunLight.position.set(Math.cos(ang)*160, Math.max(-40, elev*190), 70);
  sunLight.intensity = 0.15 + day*2.35;

  // warm at dawn/dusk, neutral at noon
  const warm = new THREE.Color(0xffb066), noon = new THREE.Color(0xfff6e8);
  sunLight.color.copy(warm).lerp(noon, Math.min(1, day*1.8));

  moonLight.intensity = night*0.45;

  hemiLight.intensity = 0.22 + day*1.05;
  ambient.intensity   = 0.12 + day*0.62;

  // sky + fog colours: deep blue night → pale bright blue day
  const skyNight = new THREE.Color(0x0a1020);
  const skyDawn  = new THREE.Color(0xe8a070);
  const skyDay   = new THREE.Color(0xa9d4f2);
  const sky = new THREE.Color();
  if(elev < 0)      sky.copy(skyNight).lerp(skyDawn, Math.max(0,1+elev*3.2));
  else              sky.copy(skyDawn).lerp(skyDay, Math.min(1, elev*2.6));
  scene.background.copy(sky);
  scene.fog.color.copy(sky);
  renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.0 + night*0.18;

  const wasNight = isNight;
  isNight = elev < 0.04;
  if(wasNight !== isNight) for(const b of buildings) applyNightGlow(b, isNight);
  if(waterMesh){
    waterMesh.material.color.copy(new THREE.Color(0x2b4f6b).lerp(new THREE.Color(0x4f8fbf), day));
  }
}
function dayTick(dt){
  if(!cycleRunning) return;
  dayTime = (dayTime + dt/dayLength) % 1;
  applyDayTime();
}
function setNight(night){
  dayTime = night ? 0.86 : 0.35;
  applyDayTime();
}
function applyNightGlow(b, night){
  b.mesh.traverse(o=>{
    if(o.isMesh && o.userData.window){
      o.material.emissiveIntensity = night ? (o.userData.lit?0.95:0.12) : 0.02;
    }
  });
}

let _fireworks=[];
function celebrate(){

  for(let blast=0;blast<5;blast++){
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const ox=cx+(Math.random()-0.5)*40, oz=cz+(Math.random()-0.5)*40, oy=18+Math.random()*10;
      const hue=Math.random();
      const col=new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue,0.9,0.6);
      const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      const N=60, pos=new Float32Array(N*3), vel=[];
      for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
        pos[i*3]=ox; pos[i*3+1]=oy; pos[i*3+2]=oz;
        const th=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, ph=Math.acos(2*Math.random()-1), sp=6+Math.random()*6;
        vel.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(ph)*Math.cos(th)*sp, Math.cos(ph)*sp, Math.sin(ph)*Math.sin(th)*sp));
      }
      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      const mat=new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:col, size:1.1, transparent:true, opacity:1, depthWrite:false});
      const pts=new THREE.Points(geo,mat); scene.add(pts);
      _fireworks.push({pts, vel, life:0, max:1.8});

function tickFireworks(dt){
  for(let i=_fireworks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const f=_fireworks[i]; f.life+=dt;
    const pos=f.pts.geometry.attributes.position;
    for(let j=0;j<f.vel.length;j++){
      f.vel[j].y-=9.8*dt*0.6;
      pos.setX(j,pos.getX(j)+f.vel[j].x*dt);
      pos.setY(j,pos.getY(j)+f.vel[j].y*dt);
      pos.setZ(j,pos.getZ(j)+f.vel[j].z*dt);

/* ============================================================
   TERRAIN — procedural heightmap landscape
   ============================================================ */
let terrainMesh, waterMesh;
const TERR_SEG = 460;   // higher res for the much larger map
const heightData = [];
const WATER_LEVEL = -0.6;

function makeNoise(seed){
  const p = new Uint8Array(512);
  let s = seed||1234;
  const rnd=()=>{ s=(s*16807)%2147483647; return (s-1)/2147483646; };
  const perm=[...Array(256).keys()];
  for(let i=255;i>0;i--){ const j=(rnd()*(i+1))|0; [perm[i],perm[j]]=[perm[j],perm[i]]; }
  for(let i=0;i<512;i++) p[i]=perm[i&255];
  const fade=t=>t*t*t*(t*(t*6-15)+10);
  const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
  const grad=(h,x,y)=>{ const u=(h&1)?x:-x, v=(h&2)?y:-y; return u+v; };
  return (x,y)=>{
    const X=Math.floor(x)&255, Y=Math.floor(y)&255;
    x-=Math.floor(x); y-=Math.floor(y);
    const u=fade(x), v=fade(y);
    const a=p[X]+Y, b=p[X+1]+Y;
    return lerp(
      lerp(grad(p[a],x,y),   grad(p[b],x-1,y),   u),
      lerp(grad(p[a+1],x,y-1), grad(p[b+1],x-1,y-1), u), v);
  };
}
let _noise, _noise2, _noiseT, _noiseM;
/* ---- BIOMES ----
   Two slow-moving fields (temperature & moisture) carve the world into
   regions, so every map has deserts, forests, plains, wetlands and tundra
   in different places. Each biome also shapes the ground differently. */
const BIOMES = {
  tundra:   { nm:'Tundra',    ground:0xd6dee4, accent:0xeaf1f5, tree:0x4a6a55, trees:0.35, rough:0.55 },
  taiga:    { nm:'Taiga',     ground:0x5d7a55, accent:0x47653f, tree:0x2f5738, trees:1.35, rough:0.9  },
  plains:   { nm:'Plains',    ground:0x7da356, accent:0x8fae4e, tree:0x4f8a3a, trees:0.55, rough:0.7  },
  forest:   { nm:'Woodland',  ground:0x5f8f45, accent:0x4d7a37, tree:0x3f7a30, trees:1.8,  rough:0.85 },
  savanna:  { nm:'Savanna',   ground:0xa8a154, accent:0xb8a95c, tree:0x7a8a3a, trees:0.4,  rough:0.6  },
  desert:   { nm:'Desert',    ground:0xd9c48c, accent:0xe4d3a2, tree:0x8a8a4a, trees:0.06, rough:0.45 },
  badlands: { nm:'Badlands',  ground:0xb07a52, accent:0xc08c5e, tree:0x7a6a3a, trees:0.12, rough:1.35 },
  wetland:  { nm:'Wetlands',  ground:0x5a8a63, accent:0x6f9d6a, tree:0x3f7050, trees:1.1,  rough:0.5  },
};
const BIOME_KEYS = Object.keys(BIOMES);
/* temperature 0..1 (cold→hot) and moisture 0..1 (dry→wet) at a world point */
function climateAt(wx,wz){
  const nT=_noiseT||_noise, nM=_noiseM||_noise2;
  if(!nT) return {t:0.5,m:0.5};
  // large regions, plus a gentle north-south temperature gradient
  let t = 0.5 + nT(wx/520, wz/520)*0.55 + nT(wx/210+13, wz/210-7)*0.18;
  t += (wz/(GRID*TILE))*0.30;                 // one end of the map runs colder
  let m = 0.5 + nM(wx/470-21, wz/470+31)*0.6 + nM(wx/190+5, wz/190+17)*0.16;
  return { t:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)), m:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,m)) };
}
const _bioCache=new Map();
function biomeKeyAtCached(wx,wz){
  // biomes vary slowly, so resolve them on a coarse cell and reuse
  const k=((wx/24)|0)+','+((wz/24)|0);
  let v=_bioCache.get(k);
  if(v===undefined){ v=biomeKeyAt(wx,wz); if(_bioCache.size<60000) _bioCache.set(k,v); }
  return v;
}
function biomeKeyAt(wx,wz){
  const c=climateAt(wx,wz);
  if(c.t<0.28) return c.m>0.45 ? 'taiga' : 'tundra';
  if(c.t>0.64){
    if(c.m<0.42) return 'desert';
    if(c.m<0.56) return 'badlands';
    return 'savanna';
  }
  if(c.m>0.70) return 'wetland';
  if(c.m>0.54) return 'forest';
  return 'plains';
}
function biomeAt(wx,wz){ return BIOMES[biomeKeyAtCached(wx,wz)]; }
/* Base natural elevation: rolling lowlands with mountain ranges and lakes.
   Modifications (terraforming) are layered on top via HMOD. */
function baseHeight(wx, wz){
  const n=_noise, n2=_noise2||_noise;
  if(!n) return 0;
  const s=1/120;
  // gentle continental roll
  let h = n(wx*s, wz*s)*6.0 + n(wx*s*2.1+11, wz*s*2.1+7)*2.6
        + n(wx*s*4.7+23, wz*s*4.7+19)*1.0;
  // mountain ranges: ridged noise raised to a power so peaks are sharp & tall
  let m = 0;
  m += (1-Math.abs(n2(wx/220+5, wz/220+9)))*1.0;
  m += (1-Math.abs(n2(wx/95+31, wz/95+17)))*0.5;
  const mMask = Math.max(0, n2(wx/300-7, wz/300+3));   // where ranges occur
  h += Math.pow(Math.max(0,m-0.35),1.8) * mMask * 46;   // tall mountains
  // carve some lake basins below sea level
  const lake = n2(wx/160+50, wz/160-40);
  if(lake < -0.35) h += (lake+0.35)*7;
  // biome character: deserts shockwave into dunes, badlands break up, wetlands flatten out
  const bk = biomeKeyAtCached(wx,wz);
  if(bk==='desert'){ h = h*0.62 + n(wx/38+90, wz/38-60)*1.9 + 0.8; }
  else if(bk==='badlands'){ h = h*1.15 + Math.abs(n(wx/44-30, wz/44+22))*4.2; }
  else if(bk==='wetland'){ h = h*0.45 - 0.35; }
  else if(bk==='tundra'){ h = h*0.8; }
  else if(bk==='savanna'){ h = h*0.75 + 0.4; }
  return h;
}
const HMOD={};                       // "gx,gz" -> additive terraform delta
/* ============================================================
   TERRAFORM REGIONS — a player edit is a real shape, not a smudge.
   Each region is a rectangle with a flat floor, near-vertical sides and a
   small corner radius, evaluated directly in terrainHeightAt so the mesh
   resolves it as a crisp box rather than a smooth ramp.
   ============================================================ */
const TERRA_REGIONS = [];
function addTerraRegion(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1,target,kind){
  const x0=Math.min(gx0,gx1)*TILE-TILE/2, x1=Math.max(gx0,gx1)*TILE+TILE/2;
  const z0=Math.min(gz0,gz1)*TILE-TILE/2, z1=Math.max(gz0,gz1)*TILE+TILE/2;
  // drop any earlier region this one completely covers
  for(let i=TERRA_REGIONS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const r=TERRA_REGIONS[i];
    if(r.x0>=x0-0.01 && r.x1<=x1+0.01 && r.z0>=z0-0.01 && r.z1<=z1+0.01) TERRA_REGIONS.splice(i,1);
  }
  TERRA_REGIONS.push({x0,x1,z0,z1,y:target,kind:kind||'flat',

  reshapeTerrain(); refreshSlotArea(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1); addTerraEdges(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1);
}
/* dig a rectangle down to a target depth — returns the dirt yielded */
function digArea(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1, target){
  if(target===undefined) target=areaTargetHeight(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1)-3;
  addTerraRegion(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1,target,'dig');
  let dirt=0;
  for(let gx=gx0;gx<=gx1;gx++)for(let gz=gz0;gz<=gz1;gz++){
    const nat=baseHeight(gx*TILE,gz*TILE);
    const cur=terrainHeightAt(gx*TILE,gz*TILE);
    if(cur>target){ dirt+=(cur-target); HMOD[gx+','+gz]=target-nat;
      if(target<WATER_LEVEL){ delete PADS[gx+','+gz]; hidePadDecal(gx,gz); } }
  }
  reshapeTerrain(); refreshSlotArea(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1); addTerraEdges(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1);
  return dirt;
}
/* carve a river channel along a poly-line of grid points, below water level */
function carveRiver(points, width){
  width = width||1;
  const bed = WATER_LEVEL-1.2;
  for(let s=0;s<points.length-1;s++){
    const a=points[s], b=points[s+1];
    const steps=Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.gx-a.gx,b.gz-a.gz)));
    for(let t=0;t<=steps;t++){
      const cgx=Math.round(a.gx+(b.gx-a.gx)*t/steps);
      const cgz=Math.round(a.gz+(b.gz-a.gz)*t/steps);
      for(let dx=-width;dx<=width;dx++)for(let dz=-width;dz<=width;dz++){
        if(Math.hypot(dx,dz)>width+0.3) continue;
        const gx=cgx+dx, gz=cgz+dz;
        const nat=baseHeight(gx*TILE,gz*TILE);
        const depth = bed - (Math.hypot(dx,dz)*0.25);
        HMOD[gx+','+gz]=Math.min(HMOD[gx+','+gz]!==undefined?HMOD[gx+','+gz]:0, depth-nat);
        delete PADS[gx+','+gz]; hidePadDecal(gx,gz);
      }
    }
  }
  reshapeTerrain();
  // stone revetment along the new channel, so a dug river reads as built
  let rx0=1e9,rz0=1e9,rx1=-1e9,rz1=-1e9;
  for(const p of points){ rx0=Math.min(rx0,p.gx); rx1=Math.max(rx1,p.gx);
                          rz0=Math.min(rz0,p.gz); rz1=Math.max(rz1,p.gz); }
  if(isFinite(rx0) && typeof addTerraEdges==='function')
    addTerraEdges(rx0-width-1, rz0-width-1, rx1+width+1, rz1+width+1);
}
/* After an earthwork, line the boundary where the new ground meets the old with
   a built structure — a poured retaining wall where we cut down, a stepped
   embankment with footings where we filled up. Makes terraforming read as
   engineering rather than a smooth blob. */
let terraWorks=null;
function addTerraEdges(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1){
  if(!terraWorks){ terraWorks=new THREE.Group(); scene.add(terraWorks); }
  const conc=mat(0xb9b3a6,{rough:0.95,metal:0.02});
  const dark=mat(0x8f8a80,{rough:0.98,metal:0.02});
  const rail=mat(0x8a8f96,{metal:0.5,rough:0.5});
  const key=(x,z)=>x+','+z;
  // clear any structures we previously built on this footprint
  if(terraWorks.userData.tiles===undefined) terraWorks.userData.tiles={};
  const owned=terraWorks.userData.tiles;
  for(let gx=gx0-1;gx<=gx1+1;gx++)for(let gz=gz0-1;gz<=gz1+1;gz++){
    const old=owned[key(gx,gz)];
    if(old){ for(const m of old) terraWorks.remove(m); delete owned[key(gx,gz)]; }
  }
  const nb=[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];
  for(let gx=gx0;gx<=gx1;gx++)for(let gz=gz0;gz<=gz1;gz++){
    const inside=terrainHeightAt(gx*TILE,gz*TILE);
    const made=[];
    for(const [dx,dz] of nb){
      const ox=gx+dx, oz=gz+dz;
      if(ox>=gx0&&ox<=gx1&&oz>=gz0&&oz<=gz1) continue;   // interior edge, skip
      const outside=terrainHeightAt(ox*TILE,oz*TILE);
      const diff=inside-outside;
      if(Math.abs(diff)<0.55) continue;                   // barely a step
      const mx=(gx+ox)/2*TILE, mz=(gz+oz)/2*TILE;
      const along=(dx!==0)?0.16:TILE, across=(dx!==0)?TILE:0.16;
      const hgt=Math.min(9,Math.abs(diff))+0.45;
      const midY=(inside+outside)/2;
      if(diff<0){
        // we dug down here: a poured retaining wall holding the higher ground back
        const wall=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(along,hgt,across), conc);
        wall.position.set(mx, midY, mz); wall.castShadow=true; wall.receiveShadow=true;
        terraWorks.add(wall); made.push(wall);
        // coping along the top + a safety rail
        const cap=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(along*1.5,0.18,across*1.5), dark);
        cap.position.set(mx, outside+0.09, mz); terraWorks.add(cap); made.push(cap);
        const n=Math.max(2,Math.round(TILE/1.6));
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const t=(i/(n-1)-0.5)*TILE*0.86;
          const post=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.045,0.045,0.6,5), rail);
          post.position.set(mx+(dx!==0?0:t), outside+0.4, mz+(dx!==0?t:0));
          terraWorks.add(post); made.push(post);
        }
      } else {
        // we filled up here: a stepped embankment with a footing at the toe
        const steps=Math.min(3,Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.abs(diff)/1.1)));
        for(let s=1;s<=steps;s++){
          const t=s/(steps+1);
          const wdt=(dx!==0)?0.16+t*0.7:TILE;
          const dpt=(dx!==0)?TILE:0.16+t*0.7;
          const st=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(wdt,0.3,dpt), s===steps?dark:conc);
          st.position.set(mx+(dx!==0?dx*t*0.5:0), inside-Math.abs(diff)*t, mz+(dz!==0?dz*t*0.5:0));
          st.receiveShadow=true; terraWorks.add(st); made.push(st);
        }
        const toe=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(along*1.2,0.4,across*1.2), dark);
        toe.position.set(mx+(dx!==0?dx*0.5:0), outside+0.2, mz+(dz!==0?dz*0.5:0));
        terraWorks.add(toe); made.push(toe);
      }
    }
    if(made.length) owned[key(gx,gz)]=made;
  }
}
function refreshSlotArea(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1){
  for(let gx=gx0-1;gx<=gx1+1;gx++)for(let gz=gz0-1;gz<=gz1+1;gz++){
    const p=slotPlates[gx+','+gz];
    if(p){ p.position.y=terrainHeightAt(gx*TILE,gz*TILE)+0.35; }
  }
  if(typeof refreshSlotVisuals==='function') refreshSlotVisuals();
}

function buildGround(){
  initNoise();
  const size = GRID*TILE + 120;        // terrain extends past the buildable grid
  const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, TERR_SEG, TERR_SEG);
  geo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(geo.attributes.position.count*3),3));
  terrainMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    vertexColors:true, roughness:0.95, metalness:0.02, flatShading:false }));
  terrainMesh.receiveShadow = true;
  terrainMesh.name='terrain';
  scene.add(terrainMesh);
  ground = terrainMesh;
  applyTerrainHeights();
  buildFog(size);

  // water plane
  const wgeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size*1.4, size*1.4, 1, 1);
  wgeo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
  waterMesh = new THREE.Mesh(wgeo, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color:0x4f8fbf, roughness:0.12, metalness:0.35, transparent:true, opacity:0.78 }));
  waterMesh.position.y = WATER_LEVEL;
  waterMesh.name='water';
  scene.add(waterMesh);

  // buildable grid overlay, draped slightly above the terrain
  gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(GRID*TILE, GRID, 0x8fa8c8, 0x50627e);
  gridHelper.material.transparent = true;
  gridHelper.material.opacity = 0.0; gridHelper.visible=false;
  gridHelper.position.y = 0.05;
  scene.add(gridHelper);

  /* trees + terrain painting are done by the staged loader */
}

/* ============================================================
   FORESTS — every tree is tracked so lumber yards can actually cut
   them down. Stands thin out as you harvest, and new saplings keep
   seeding near your city so you are never stranded without timber.
   ============================================================ */
const TREES = [];              // {x,z,alive,i}
let treeTrunks, treeLeaves, treeLeaves2, treeRocks;
const TREE_MAX = 7000;
const _tm = new THREE.Matrix4(), _tq = new THREE.Quaternion(),
      _ts = new THREE.Vector3(), _tp = new THREE.Vector3();
function treeSpotOK(x,z){
  const hh=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
  if(hh<WATER_LEVEL+0.9 || hh>9) return false;
  if(typeof occupied!=='undefined'){
    const gx=Math.round(x/TILE), gz=Math.round(z/TILE);
    if(occupied[gx+','+gz]) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function placeTree(i,x,z,species,scale){
  const B=biomeAt(x,z);
  // trees in a stand share a species and a size band, so a wood reads as one
  // thing rather than a random assortment
  const band=(scale===undefined? 1 : scale);
  const s=(0.8+Math.random()*0.9)*band;
  const hh=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
  _tp.set(x,hh+0.6*s,z); _ts.set(s,s,s); _tq.identity();
  _tm.compose(_tp,_tq,_ts); treeTrunks.setMatrixAt(i,_tm);
  // conifers are taller and narrower, broadleaf rounder and wider
  const conifer = (species===undefined) ? (Math.random()<0.5) : (species===1);
  const crownY = conifer ? 1.85*s : 1.5*s;
  const crownS = conifer ? s*(0.62+Math.random()*0.22) : s*(0.95+Math.random()*0.45);
  _tp.set(x,hh+crownY,z); _ts.set(crownS, crownS*(conifer?1.7:1.0), crownS);
  _tq.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0,Math.random()*6,0));
  _tm.compose(_tp,_tq,_ts);
  const useA = conifer;
  (useA?treeLeaves:treeLeaves2).setMatrixAt(i,_tm);
  _tm.compose(new THREE.Vector3(0,-999,0),_tq,_ts);
  (useA?treeLeaves2:treeLeaves).setMatrixAt(i,_tm);
  treeTrunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  treeLeaves.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  treeLeaves2.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  TREES[i]={x,z,alive:true,i,species:conifer?1:0,scale:band,_seen:true};
}

function hideTree(i){
  const off=new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-999,0);
  treeTrunks.setMatrixAt(i,off); treeLeaves.setMatrixAt(i,off); treeLeaves2.setMatrixAt(i,off);
  treeTrunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  treeLeaves.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  treeLeaves2.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  if(TREES[i]) TREES[i].alive=false;
}
function treesNear(x,z,r){
  let n=0, r2=r*r;
  for(let i=0;i<TREES.length;i++){ const t=TREES[i]; if(!t||!t.alive) continue;
    const dx=t.x-x, dz=t.z-z; if(dx*dx+dz*dz<=r2) n++; }
  return n;
}
/* fell the nearest living tree to a point — returns true if one was cut */
function fellNearestTree(x,z,r){
  let best=-1, bd=r*r;
  for(let i=0;i<TREES.length;i++){ const t=TREES[i]; if(!t||!t.alive) continue;
    const dx=t.x-x, dz=t.z-z, d=dx*dx+dz*dz; if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=i; } }
  if(best<0) return false;
  hideTree(best); return true;
}
/* saplings keep appearing around your city so timber never dries up for good */
let _seedAcc=0;
function forestTick(dt){
  if(!treeTrunks) return;
  _seedAcc+=dt; if(_seedAcc<1.4) return; _seedAcc=0;
  const nearMe = treesNear(START.x,START.z,320);
  const batch = nearMe<600 ? 5 : (nearMe<1400 ? 3 : 1);
  for(let n=0;n<batch;n++) seedOneSapling();
}
function seedOneSapling(){
  // find a free instance slot
  let slot=-1;
  for(let i=0;i<TREES.length;i++) if(TREES[i] && !TREES[i].alive){ slot=i; break; }
  if(slot<0){ if(TREES.length<TREE_MAX) slot=TREES.length; else return; }
  // seed near your own city, biased to wetter biomes
  const anchor = buildings.length
    ? buildings[Math.floor(Math.random()*buildings.length)] : null;
  const ax = anchor ? (anchor.cx!==undefined?anchor.cx:anchor.gx*TILE) : START.x;
  const az = anchor ? (anchor.cz!==undefined?anchor.cz:anchor.gz*TILE) : START.z;
  for(let tries=0;tries<14;tries++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r=22+Math.sqrt(Math.random())*170;
    const x=ax+Math.cos(a)*r, z=az+Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(Math.abs(x)>HALF-8||Math.abs(z)>HALF-8) continue;
    if(!treeSpotOK(x,z)) continue;
    const B=biomeAt(x,z);
    // new growth prefers the edge of an existing wood, so stands spread
    // outward instead of speckling the countryside
    const _f=(typeof forestDensityAt==='function')? forestDensityAt(x,z) : {d:0.5,species:undefined,scale:1};
    const _chance=Math.min(1, (B.trees||0)*0.45 + _f.d*0.9);
    if(Math.random()>_chance) continue;
    placeTree(slot,x,z,_f.species,_f.scale);
    return;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   FORESTS — trees grow in stands, not confetti. The map is seeded with
   woodland patches whose size and density come from the biome; each patch
   has a dense core, a thinning edge, and the odd clearing inside it. A few
   lone trees are scattered between stands so the gaps do not look bald.
   ============================================================ */
const FOREST_PATCHES = [];
function seedForestPatches(){
  FOREST_PATCHES.length=0;
  const span=GRID*TILE-40, half=span/2;
  // aim for a lot of small-to-medium stands rather than a few huge blobs
  const want=260;
  for(let i=0;i<want*6 && FOREST_PATCHES.length<want;i++){
    const x=(Math.random()-0.5)*span, z=(Math.random()-0.5)*span;
    const hh=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
    if(hh<WATER_LEVEL+1.2 || hh>9) continue;
    const B=biomeAt(x,z);
    const lush=Math.min(1,(B.trees||0)*1.1);
    if(lush<0.08) continue;                       // deserts stay open
    if(Math.random()>lush) continue;
    FOREST_PATCHES.push({
      x, z,
      r: 14 + Math.random()*Math.random()*70,     // mostly modest, a few big
      dens: 0.55 + lush*0.5,
      // each stand leans to one species, so woods read differently
      species: Math.random()<0.62 ? 0 : 1,
      scale: 0.85 + Math.random()*0.5,
      // a couple of clearings punched out of the bigger stands
      holes: (Math.random()<0.45) ? [{
        hx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.9, hz:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.9, hr:0.16+Math.random()*0.2
      }] : null
    });
  }
}
/* How thick is the canopy at this point? 0 outside every stand. */
function forestDensityAt(x,z){
  let best=0, sp=0, sc=1;
  for(let i=0;i<FOREST_PATCHES.length;i++){
    const p=FOREST_PATCHES[i];
    const dx=x-p.x, dz=z-p.z;
    const d2=dx*dx+dz*dz;
    if(d2 > p.r*p.r) continue;
    const d=Math.sqrt(d2)/p.r;
    // dense core, soft edge
    let v=p.dens*(1-d*d*0.85);
    if(p.holes){
      for(let hIdx=0;hIdx<p.holes.length;hIdx++){
        const ho=p.holes[hIdx];
        const hx=p.x+ho.hx*p.r, hz=p.z+ho.hz*p.r, hr=ho.hr*p.r;
        const hd=Math.hypot(x-hx, z-hz);
        if(hd<hr) v*= (hd/hr)*(hd/hr);            // a clearing inside the wood
      }
    }
    if(v>best){ best=v; sp=p.species; sc=p.scale; }
  }
  return {d:best, species:sp, scale:sc};
}
function* scatterTreesChunked(){
  const trunkG=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12,0.17,1.2,5);
  const leafG=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.95,0);
  const rockG=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.6,0);
  const trunkM=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x4a3826,roughness:1});
  const leafM=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x3f6b34,roughness:1,flatShading:true});
  const leafM2=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x4f7a3a,roughness:1,flatShading:true});
  const rockM=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x5f5a54,roughness:1,flatShading:true});
  treeTrunks=new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkG,trunkM,TREE_MAX);
  treeLeaves=new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafG,leafM,TREE_MAX);
  treeLeaves2=new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafG,leafM2,TREE_MAX);
  treeRocks=new THREE.InstancedMesh(rockG,rockM,700);
  const off=new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-999,0);
  for(let i=0;i<TREE_MAX;i++){ treeTrunks.setMatrixAt(i,off); treeLeaves.setMatrixAt(i,off); treeLeaves2.setMatrixAt(i,off); }

  seedForestPatches();
  yield 0.05;

  let ti=0, ri=0;
  // ---- fill the stands first: sample inside each patch, not across the map ----
  for(let p=0; p<FOREST_PATCHES.length && ti<TREE_MAX*0.94; p++){
    const pa=FOREST_PATCHES[p];
    if(p%12===0) yield 0.05 + 0.8*(p/FOREST_PATCHES.length);
    // trees roughly proportional to the area of the stand
    const tries=Math.min(900, Math.round(pa.r*pa.r*0.09*pa.dens));
    for(let k=0;k<tries && ti<TREE_MAX*0.94;k++){
      // bias toward the middle so the canopy thickens inward
      const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const rr=Math.sqrt(Math.random())*pa.r;
      const x=pa.x+Math.cos(a)*rr, z=pa.z+Math.sin(a)*rr;
      if(Math.abs(x)>GRID*TILE/2-12||Math.abs(z)>GRID*TILE/2-12) continue;
      const hh=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
      if(hh<WATER_LEVEL+0.9 || hh>9.5) continue;
      const f=forestDensityAt(x,z);
      if(Math.random()>f.d) continue;             // edge thins out naturally
      placeTree(ti,x,z,f.species,f.scale); ti++;
    }
  }
  yield 0.88;
  // ---- a light scatter of lone trees and hedgerows between the woods ----
  for(let i=0;i<26000 && ti<TREE_MAX; i++){
    const x=(Math.random()-0.5)*(GRID*TILE-20);
    const z=(Math.random()-0.5)*(GRID*TILE-20);
    const hh=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
    if(hh<WATER_LEVEL+0.9) continue;
    const B=biomeAt(x,z);
    if(hh>9){
      if(ri>=700) continue;
      _tp.set(x,hh,z); _ts.setScalar(0.6+Math.random()*1.1);
      _tq.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(Math.random(),Math.random()*6,Math.random()));
      _tm.compose(_tp,_tq,_ts); treeRocks.setMatrixAt(ri++,_tm); continue;
    }
    if(Math.random() > Math.min(1,(B.trees||0))*0.10) continue;   // sparse on purpose
    placeTree(ti,x,z); ti++;
  }
  for(const im of [treeTrunks,treeLeaves,treeLeaves2,treeRocks]){
    im.castShadow=true; im.receiveShadow=true; im.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true; scene.add(im); }
}

/* ============================================================
   BUILD SLOTS — plates that hover just above the terrain. Click an
   empty slot first, then choose what to raise there.
   ============================================================ */
const SLOT_R = 26;                // slots span a wide region around the player
const slotPlates = {};            // "gx,gz" -> mesh
let slotGroup, slotCenter={gx:0,gz:0};
function buildCursor(){
  slotGroup = new THREE.Group();
  scene.add(slotGroup);
  cursorGroup=new THREE.Group();
  const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(TILE*0.44,TILE*0.5,4),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x3aa0ff,transparent:true,opacity:0.95,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
  ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; ring.rotation.z=Math.PI/4;
  cursorGroup.add(ring); hoverTile=ring;
  cursorGroup.visible=false; scene.add(cursorGroup);
  rebuildSlots();
}
/* (re)create the pool of slot plates centred on the player's location */
const _slotGeo = ()=> new THREE.PlaneGeometry(TILE*0.86, TILE*0.86);
function rebuildSlots(){
  return;   // build plates destroyed — placement is free-form
  const cgx=Math.round(START.x/TILE), cgz=Math.round(START.z/TILE);
  slotCenter={gx:cgx,gz:cgz};
  for(const k in slotPlates){ slotGroup.remove(slotPlates[k]); delete slotPlates[k]; }
  const geo=_slotGeo();
  for(let gx=cgx-SLOT_R; gx<=cgx+SLOT_R; gx++){
    for(let gz=cgz-SLOT_R; gz<=cgz+SLOT_R; gz++){
      const wx=gx*TILE, wz=gz*TILE;
      const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color:0xffffff, transparent:true, opacity:0.14, depthWrite:false, side:THREE.DoubleSide }));
      m.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
      m.position.set(wx, terrainHeightAt(wx,wz)+0.35, wz);
      m.userData.gx=gx; m.userData.gz=gz; m.userData.slot=true;
      slotGroup.add(m); slotPlates[gx+','+gz]=m;
    }
  }
  refreshSlotVisuals();
}
/* make sure slot plates exist in a box around (gx,gz) so newly-claimed
   territory becomes visibly buildable — this is how buildings "open up" more slots */
function ensureSlotsAround(cgx,cgz,rad){
  return;
  if(!slotGroup) return;
  const geo=_slotGeo();
  for(let gx=cgx-rad; gx<=cgx+rad; gx++)for(let gz=cgz-rad; gz<=cgz+rad; gz++){
    const key=gx+','+gz;
    if(slotPlates[key]) continue;
    if(Math.abs(gx*TILE-START.x)>HALF-4 || Math.abs(gz*TILE-START.z)>HALF-4) continue;
    const wx=gx*TILE, wz=gz*TILE;
    const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color:0xffffff, transparent:true, opacity:0.14, depthWrite:false, side:THREE.DoubleSide }));
    m.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
    m.position.set(wx, terrainHeightAt(wx,wz)+0.35, wz);
    m.userData.gx=gx; m.userData.gz=gz; m.userData.slot=true;
    slotGroup.add(m); slotPlates[key]=m;
  }
}
function refreshSlotVisuals(){
  return;

    const m=slotPlates[k];

    if(slotUnderwater(gx,gz)){ m.visible=false; continue; }   // no plate on open water
    const owned = inTerritory(gx,gz);

      const near = inTerritory(gx+1,gz)||inTerritory(gx-1,gz)||inTerritory(gx,gz+1)||inTerritory(gx,gz-1);

let slotsVisible=false, hoveredSlotKey=null;
let terraStart=null, terraBox=null;
function showTerraBox(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1){

/* ---- ROAD DRAWING: drag to trace a path of road tiles ---- */
let roadMode=false, roadPath=[], roadPreview=null, penPts=null, _pendingStroke=null;
window.__DOM_PEN=true;           // roads are drawn as flowing curves by default
window.__DOM_SMOOTH=true;        // iron out hand jitter
window.__DOM_SNAP=true;          // align new buildings to neighbours
/* Turn a hand-drawn stroke into a connected run of road tiles. The stroke is
   smoothed first (unless you have turned that off) so a shaky drag still gives
   a clean road, then walked onto the grid with no diagonal gaps. */
function penToTiles(pts){
  if(!pts||!pts.length) return [];
  let p=pts.slice();
  if(window.__DOM_SMOOTH!==false){
    for(let pass=0;pass<2 && p.length>2;pass++){
      const out=[p[0]];
      for(let i=0;i<p.length-1;i++){
        const a=p[i], b=p[i+1];
        out.push({x:a.x*0.75+b.x*0.25, z:a.z*0.75+b.z*0.25});
        out.push({x:a.x*0.25+b.x*0.75, z:a.z*0.25+b.z*0.75});
      }
      out.push(p[p.length-1]);
      p=out;
    }
  }
  const tiles=[], seen={};
  let prev=null;
  for(const q of p){
    const gx=Math.round(q.x/TILE), gz=Math.round(q.z/TILE);
    if(prev && (prev.gx!==gx || prev.gz!==gz)){
      // step through so the run never breaks diagonally
      let cx=prev.gx, cz=prev.gz;
      while(cx!==gx || cz!==gz){
        if(cx!==gx) cx+=Math.sign(gx-cx);
        else cz+=Math.sign(gz-cz);
        const k=cx+','+cz;
        if(!seen[k]){ seen[k]=1; tiles.push({gx:cx,gz:cz}); }
      }
    }
    const k=gx+','+gz;
    if(!seen[k]){ seen[k]=1; tiles.push({gx,gz}); }
    prev={gx,gz};
  }
  return tiles;
}
window.roadMode=false;
/* build a straight line of tiles from a to b, snapping to the dominant axis
   (or a clean 45° diagonal) so defensive walls come out as tidy rows */
function straightLine(a, b){
  if(!a) return [b];
  const dx=b.gx-a.gx, dz=b.gz-a.gz;
  const adx=Math.abs(dx), adz=Math.abs(dz);
  const out=[];
  if(adx>adz*1.8){ for(let i=0;i<=adx;i++) out.push({gx:a.gx+Math.sign(dx)*i, gz:a.gz}); }
  else if(adz>adx*1.8){ for(let i=0;i<=adz;i++) out.push({gx:a.gx, gz:a.gz+Math.sign(dz)*i}); }
  else { const n=Math.max(adx,adz); for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)
    out.push({gx:a.gx+Math.sign(dx)*i, gz:a.gz+Math.sign(dz)*i}); }
  return out;
}
function appendRoadRun(path, gx, gz){
  // extend the path from its last tile to (gx,gz) in an L-shape (no diagonals)
  let last=path[path.length-1];
  if(!last){ path.push({gx,gz}); return; }
  while(last.gx!==gx){ last={gx:last.gx+Math.sign(gx-last.gx), gz:last.gz};
    if(!path.some(p=>p.gx===last.gx&&p.gz===last.gz)) path.push(last); }
  while(last.gz!==gz){ last={gx:last.gx, gz:last.gz+Math.sign(gz-last.gz)};
    if(!path.some(p=>p.gx===last.gx&&p.gz===last.gz)) path.push(last); }
}
function showRoadPreview(path){
  if(!roadPreview){ roadPreview=new THREE.Group(); scene.add(roadPreview); }
  while(roadPreview.children.length) roadPreview.remove(roadPreview.children[0]);
  const geo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(TILE*0.9,TILE*0.9);
  for(const p of path){
    const ok = typeof inTerritory==='function' ? true : true; // preview shows all
    const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: canPlaceRoad(p.gx,p.gz)?0x3aa0ff:0xd24b3f, transparent:true, opacity:0.5,
      side:THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite:false }));
    m.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
    m.position.set(p.gx*TILE, terrainHeightAt(p.gx*TILE,p.gz*TILE)+0.4, p.gz*TILE);
    roadPreview.add(m);
  }
}
function hideRoadPreview(){ if(roadPreview){ while(roadPreview.children.length) roadPreview.remove(roadPreview.children[0]); } }
const ROAD_CLEARANCE = 1.6;      // minimum vertical gap to cross over a road
function canPlaceRoad(gx,gz,altY){
  const sitting=occupied[gx+','+gz];
  if(sitting){
    // an elevated road may cross over one already there, given enough headroom
    const isRoadBelow = (sitting.key==='road'||sitting.key==='roundabout');
    if(!isRoadBelow || altY===null || altY===undefined) return false;
    const belowY = (sitting.altY!==undefined && sitting.altY!==null)
      ? sitting.altY : groundHeight(gx*TILE,gz*TILE);
    if(Math.abs(altY-belowY) < ROAD_CLEARANCE) return false;
    return true;
  }
  if(typeof slotUnderwater==='function' && slotUnderwater(gx,gz)) return false;
  if(Math.abs(gx*TILE-START.x)>HALF-4 || Math.abs(gz*TILE-START.z)>HALF-4) return false;
  return true;
}
let terraColor=0x3aa0ff;
function setSlotsVisible(v){ slotsVisible=v; refreshSlotVisuals(); }

/* ============================================================
   CAMERA — pan (drag), orbit (right/two-finger), zoom (wheel/pinch)
   Custom controls so it works without OrbitControls dependency.
   ============================================================ */
const camState = {
  target: new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0),
  dist: 130, minDist: 30, maxDist: 1900,   // zoom moves the camera in/out
  azimuth: Math.PI*0.25,                   // yaw
  // polar = angle from the horizontal: SMALL polar = high & looking down,
  // LARGE polar = low & looking across.  polar≈0.12 is nearly straight down.
  polar: 0.62,                             // pitch — normal perspective 3D angle
  minPolar: 0.12,                          // nearly top-down
  maxPolar: 1.32,                          // low, near-horizon view
};
let flatView = false;              // true = straight top-down symbol map
function clampPolar(p){ return Math.max(camState.minPolar, Math.min(camState.maxPolar, p)); }
function updateCamera(){
  const s = camState;
  s.dist = Math.max(s.minDist, Math.min(s.maxDist, s.dist));
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  const sinP=Math.sin(s.polar), cosP=Math.cos(s.polar);
  camera.position.set(
    s.target.x + s.dist*sinP*Math.sin(s.azimuth),
    s.target.y + s.dist*cosP,
    s.target.z + s.dist*sinP*Math.cos(s.azimuth)
  );
  camera.lookAt(s.target);
}

let dragMode = null;   // 'orbit' | 'pan' | null
let lastPointer = {x:0,y:0};
let pointers = new Map();
let pinchDist = 0;
let toolMode = 'move';  // 'move' | 'delete'

function initCameraControls(){
  const el = renderer.domElement;

  el.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
    el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    pointers.set(e.pointerId, {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY});
    lastPointer = {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY};
    if(pointers.size===2){
      const p = [...pointers.values()];
      pinchDist = Math.hypot(p[0].x-p[1].x, p[0].y-p[1].y);
      dragMode = 'orbit';
    } else {
      // left = place/pan; right = orbit; terraform = area; road/trap = line draw
      if(e.button!==2 && ((typeof roadMode!=='undefined'&&roadMode) || (typeof barrierMode!=='undefined'&&barrierMode))){
        const g=pointerToGrid(e);
        if(g){ dragMode='road'; roadPath=[{gx:g.gx,gz:g.gz}]; _downPos={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}; _moved=false;
          if(window.__DOM_PEN && !(typeof barrierMode!=='undefined' && barrierMode)){
            penPts=[{x:g.world.x, z:g.world.z}];
          } else showRoadPreview(roadPath); }
        else { dragMode='orbit'; }
      } else if(e.button!==2 && typeof terraTool!=='undefined' && terraTool){
        const g=pointerToGrid(e);
        if(g){ dragMode='terra'; terraStart={gx:g.gx,gz:g.gz};
          _downPos={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}; _moved=false; showTerraBox(g.gx,g.gz,g.gx,g.gz); }
        else { dragMode='orbit'; }
      } else {
        dragMode = (e.button===2) ? 'orbit' : 'tap';
        _downPos = {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY};
        _moved = false;
      }
    }
  });

  el.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{
    if(pointers.has(e.pointerId)) pointers.set(e.pointerId, {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY});

    if(pointers.size===2){
      const p = [...pointers.values()];
      const nd = Math.hypot(p[0].x-p[1].x, p[0].y-p[1].y);
      if(pinchDist>0){ camState.dist *= nd/pinchDist; updateCamera(); }
      pinchDist = nd;
      // two-finger drag = orbit
      const cx=(p[0].x+p[1].x)/2, cy=(p[0].y+p[1].y)/2;
      const dx=cx-lastPointer.x, dy=cy-lastPointer.y;
      if(!flatView) camState.azimuth -= dx*0.005;
      if(!flatView){ camState.polar = clampPolar(camState.polar - dy*0.004); }
      updateCamera();
      lastPointer={x:cx,y:cy};
      return;
    }

    const dx = e.clientX - lastPointer.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - lastPointer.y;
    if(Math.abs(e.clientX-_downPos.x)+Math.abs(e.clientY-_downPos.y) > 5) _moved = true;

    if(dragMode==='road'){
      const g=pointerToGrid(e);
      if(g && window.__DOM_PEN && !(typeof barrierMode!=='undefined' && barrierMode)){
        // pen mode: record where the cursor actually went, tiles come later
        if(!penPts) penPts=[];
        const wp=g.world;
        const lastp=penPts[penPts.length-1];
        if(e.shiftKey && penPts.length){
          // hold Shift for a flat straight run from where you started
          penPts = [penPts[0], {x:wp.x, z:wp.z}];
          roadPath = penToTiles(penPts);
          if(window.__DOM_RIBBON && window.__DOM_RIBBON.preview) window.__DOM_RIBBON.preview(penPts, true);
          lastPointer={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
          return;
        }
        if(!lastp || Math.hypot(wp.x-lastp.x, wp.z-lastp.z) > TILE*0.28){
          penPts.push({x:wp.x, z:wp.z});
          roadPath = penToTiles(penPts);
          // show the actual road shape you are drawing, not the tiles beneath it
          if(window.__DOM_RIBBON && window.__DOM_RIBBON.preview) window.__DOM_RIBBON.preview(penPts);
          else showRoadPreview(roadPath);
        }
        lastPointer={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
        return;
      }
      if(g){
        if(typeof barrierMode!=='undefined' && barrierMode){
          // traps are drawn like a road, but the run is always flat straight
          roadPath = straightLine(roadPath[0], g);
          showRoadPreview(roadPath);
        } else {
          const last=roadPath[roadPath.length-1];
          if(!last || last.gx!==g.gx || last.gz!==g.gz){
            appendRoadRun(roadPath, g.gx, g.gz);
            showRoadPreview(roadPath);
          }
        }
      }
      lastPointer={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
      return;
    }
    if(dragMode==='terra'){
      // a river is drawn like a road: keep every tile the cursor crosses
      if(typeof terraTool!=='undefined' && terraTool==='river' && g){
        if(!riverPath) riverPath=[];
        const _lp=riverPath[riverPath.length-1];
        if(!_lp || _lp.gx!==g.gx || _lp.gz!==g.gz) riverPath.push({gx:g.gx, gz:g.gz});
      }
      const g=pointerToGrid(e);
      if(g && terraStart) showTerraBox(terraStart.gx,terraStart.gz,g.gx,g.gz);
      lastPointer={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
      return;
    }
    if(dragMode==='orbit'){
      if(!flatView) camState.azimuth -= dx*0.006;
      if(!flatView){ camState.polar = clampPolar(camState.polar - dy*0.005); }
      updateCamera();
    } else if(dragMode==='tap' && _moved){
      // panning with left drag on empty space
      dragMode = 'pan';
    }
    if(dragMode==='pan'){
      panCamera(dx, dy);
    }
    lastPointer = {x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY};
    updateHover(e);
  });

  el.addEventListener('pointerup', e=>{
    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    if(dragMode==='road'){
      hideRoadPreview();
      if(window.__DOM_RIBBON && window.__DOM_RIBBON.clearPreview) window.__DOM_RIBBON.clearPreview();
      if(typeof barrierMode!=='undefined' && barrierMode){
        // a trap run is laid straight away, like a road — no tile-by-tile ghosts
        if(roadPath.length && typeof commitBarrierLine==='function') commitBarrierLine(roadPath, true);
      } else {
        var _stroke = penPts; penPts=null;
        if(roadPath.length && typeof commitRoadPath==='function') commitRoadPath(roadPath, _stroke);
      }
      roadPath=[];
    } else if(dragMode==='terra'){
      const g=pointerToGrid(e);

    } else if(dragMode==='tap' && !_moved){
      handleTap(e);
    }
    if(pointers.size<2) pinchDist=0;
    dragMode = pointers.size? dragMode : null;
  });
  el.addEventListener('pointercancel', e=>{ pointers.delete(e.pointerId); dragMode=null; });

  el.addEventListener('wheel', e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    camState.dist *= (1 + Math.sign(e.deltaY)*0.12);
    updateCamera();
  }, {passive:false});

  el.addEventListener('contextmenu', e=>e.preventDefault());
  el.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>updateHover(e));
}
let _downPos={x:0,y:0}, _moved=false;

function panCamera(dx, dy){
  const s = camState;
  const panSpeed = s.dist * 0.0016;
  // move target in the camera's ground plane
  const forward = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(s.azimuth), 0, Math.cos(s.azimuth));
  const right = new THREE.Vector3(forward.z, 0, -forward.x);
  s.target.addScaledVector(right, -dx*panSpeed);
  s.target.addScaledVector(forward, -dy*panSpeed);   // drag down = move back (was inverted)
  // clamp target to a sane area
  const lim = HALF + 30;
  s.target.x = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, s.target.x));
  s.target.z = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, s.target.z));
  updateCamera();
}

/* ---------- pointer → grid ---------- */
function pointerToGrid(e){
  const r = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  const nx = ((e.clientX - r.left)/r.width)*2 - 1;
  const ny = -((e.clientY - r.top)/r.height)*2 + 1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera({x:nx, y:ny}, camera);
  // First try a real hit against the terrain mesh so elevation is respected.
  let pt=null;
  if(terrainMesh){
    const hit = raycaster.intersectObject(terrainMesh, false);
    if(hit.length) pt = hit[0].point;
  }
  // Fallback / refinement: march the ray until it crosses the terrain height.
  if(!pt){
    const o=raycaster.ray.origin, d=raycaster.ray.direction;
    let last=null;
    for(let t=1;t<1400;t+=3){
      const p=o.clone().addScaledVector(d,t);
      const h=terrainHeightAt(p.x,p.z);
      if(p.y<=h){ pt=last?last.lerp(p,0.5):p; break; }
      last=p;
    }
    if(!pt){
      const plane=new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),0), q=new THREE.Vector3();
      if(!raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane,q)) return null; pt=q;
    }
  }
  const gx = Math.round(pt.x/TILE);
  const gz = Math.round(pt.z/TILE);
  if(Math.abs(gx) > GRID/2 || Math.abs(gz) > GRID/2) return null;
  return {gx, gz, world:pt};
}

function updateHover(e){
  if(dragMode==='orbit'||dragMode==='pan'){ cursorGroup.visible=false; return; }
  const g = pointerToGrid(e);
  if(!g || !g.world){ cursorGroup.visible=false; return; }
  cursorGroup.visible=true;
  cursorGroup.position.set(g.world.x,(groundHeight(g.world.x,g.world.z)||0)+0.4,g.world.z);
}

function handleTap(e){
  const r = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  const nx = ((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1;
  const ny = -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera({x:nx,y:ny}, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(buildings.map(b=>b.mesh), true);

  if(toolMode==='delete'){
    if(hits.length) removeBuildingByMesh(hits[0].object);
    return;
  }
  // clicking an existing building opens its info / upgrade panel
  if(hits.length){ selectBuilding(hits[0].object); return; }
  // otherwise: clicking an empty slot opens the build menu for that slot
  // ground clicks no longer open a build menu — you pick the building first
  // and then place it (see place mode). A bare click just clears the selection.
  if(typeof deselectBuilding==='function') deselectBuilding();
  if(typeof closeBuildMenu==='function') closeBuildMenu();
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER LOOP
   ============================================================ */
let _t = 0, _econAcc=0, _aiAcc=0;
let paused = false;
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  if(paused){ renderer.render(scene, camera); return; }   // frozen, still drawn
  const dt = 0.016 * (window.SIM_SPEED||1);               // fast-forward multiplier
  _t += dt;
  _econAcc += dt;
  _aiAcc += dt;
  dayTick(dt);
  if(_econAcc>=0.5){ if(typeof economyTick==='function') economyTick(_econAcc); _econAcc=0; }
  // military simulation
  if(typeof unitsTick==='function') unitsTick(dt, _t);
  if(typeof installationsTick==='function') installationsTick(dt, _t);
  if(_aiAcc>=1.0){
    if(typeof aiTick==='function') aiTick(_aiAcc);
    if(typeof playerForcesTick==='function') playerForcesTick(_aiAcc);
    if(typeof updateFactionPanel==='function') updateFactionPanel();
    _aiAcc=0;
  }
  // gentle animation: rotating beacons, pulsing emissives, machinery
  for(const b of buildings){
    const ud=b.mesh.userData;
    if(ud.spin){ ud.spin.rotation.y += 0.01; }
    if(ud.excavator && ud.excavator.userData.dig){
      ud.excavator.rotation.y = Math.sin(_t*0.6)*0.5;                    // swing
      ud.excavator.userData.dig.rotation.x = -0.3 + Math.sin(_t*1.4)*0.4; // dig cycle
    }
    if(ud.spinX){ ud.spinX.rotation.x += 0.03; }              // legacy
    if(ud.spinAxle){ ud.spinAxle.rotation.z += 0.04; }        // water wheel on its axle
    if(ud.turbines){ for(const t of ud.turbines) t.rotation.z += 0.18; }  // dam turbines
    if(ud.rotors){ for(const r of ud.rotors) r.rotation.z += 0.12; }      // wind blades
    if(ud.pump){ ud.pump.rotation.z = Math.sin(_t*1.6)*0.35; }            // pumpjack
    if(ud.pulse){
      ud.pulse.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.6 + Math.sin(_t*2 + b.gx)*0.4;
    }
    // construction rise animation: the model grows up out of the ground when built
    if(ud.building!==undefined){
      // more builders (from construction buildings) => faster construction
      const troops = Math.sqrt(window.cityBuilders||1) * (window.__DOM_BUILD_SPEED||1);
      ud.building += dt*troops/ud.buildTime;
      if(ud.building>=1){
        b.mesh.scale.set(1,1,1); b.mesh.position.y=ud.finalY;
        if(ud.scaffold){ b.mesh.remove(ud.scaffold);
          ud.scaffold.traverse(o=>{ if(o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); }); ud.scaffold=null; }
        delete ud.building;
      } else {
        const e=ud.building;
        const ease=e<0.5? 2*e*e : 1-Math.pow(-2*e+2,2)/2;   // easeInOut
        b.mesh.scale.set(1, 0.05+0.95*ease, 1);
        // rise from slightly sunk to final height
        b.mesh.position.y = ud.finalY - (1-ease)*2.2;
        if(ud.scaffold && ud.scaffold.userData.opacityMat)
          ud.scaffold.userData.opacityMat.opacity = 0.55*(1-e);
      }
    }
    if(ud.smoke){
      for(const puff of ud.smoke){
        puff.position.y += 0.012*puff.userData.scale;
        puff.position.x += Math.sin(_t*0.6 + puff.userData.phase)*0.004;
        const prog = (puff.position.y - puff.userData.baseY)/(puff.userData.top - puff.userData.baseY);
        puff.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.34*(1-prog));
        puff.scale.setScalar(1 + prog*1.6);
        if(puff.position.y > puff.userData.top){
          puff.position.set(puff.userData.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, puff.userData.baseY, puff.userData.z+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.2);
          puff.scale.setScalar(1);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if(_fireworks.length) tickFireworks(dt);
  updateFog(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

  updateCamera();

}

/* ============================================================
   BUILDING MODELS — elaborate procedural geometry per type,
   restyled by architecture. Each generator returns a THREE.Group.
   Buildings are built to sit on the XZ plane, footprint centered.
   ============================================================ */

/* Building catalogue. `foot` = tiles wide/deep, `h` nominal height. */

const CATS = ['Homes','Commerce','Civic','Industry'];

/* small deterministic RNG so a rebuild looks the same */
function srand(seed){ let s=seed%2147483647; if(s<=0)s+=2147483646;
  return ()=>{ s=s*16807%2147483647; return (s-1)/2147483646; }; }

/* ---- helpers ---- */
function box(w,h,d, material, x,y,z){
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), material);
  m.position.set(x||0, y||0, z||0);
  m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true;
  return m;
}
function cyl(rt,rb,h,seg, material, x,y,z){
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt,rb,h,seg||16), material);
  m.position.set(x||0,y||0,z||0);
  m.castShadow=true; m.receiveShadow=true;
  return m;
}
/* Chimney smoke — a stack of translucent puffs that drift up; registered
   on the group's userData.smoke so the render loop animates them. */
function addSmoke(g, x, y, z, scale){
  scale = scale||1;
  const puffs=[];
  const smokeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x6b6258, transparent:true,
    opacity:0.32, roughness:1, flatShading:true, depthWrite:false});
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry((0.4+i*0.16)*scale,0), smokeMat.clone());
    p.position.set(x + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2, y + i*0.7*scale, z + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.2);
    p.userData.baseY = y; p.userData.phase = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    p.userData.top = y + 4*scale; p.userData.x=x; p.userData.z=z; p.userData.scale=scale;
    g.add(p); puffs.push(p);
  }
  if(!g.userData.smoke) g.userData.smoke=[];
  g.userData.smoke.push(...puffs);
}
/* Generic industrial treatment for buildings without a bespoke branch:
   brick body, iron banding, riveted cornice, a smokestack, sooty windows. */
function industrialGeneric(g, def, s, seed, opts){
  opts = opts||{};
  const rnd = srand(seed);
  const w = (opts.w!==undefined?opts.w:def.foot*TILE*0.72);
  const d = (opts.d!==undefined?opts.d:def.foot*TILE*0.72);
  const h = opts.h!==undefined?opts.h:(6+def.foot*3+rnd()*4);
  const floors = Math.max(2, Math.floor(h/1.8));
  g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('brick',s),0,h/2,0));
  g.add(box(w*1.03,0.5,d*1.03, styleMat('iron',s),0,0.25,0));
  g.add(box(w*1.03,0.4,d*1.03, styleMat('iron',s),0,h-0.2,0));
  for(let fl=1; fl<floors; fl++){
    g.add(box(w*1.01,0.14,d*1.01, styleMat('iron',s),0,(fl/floors)*h,0));
  }
  for(const sx of[-1,1])for(const sz of[-1,1]){
    g.add(box(0.18,h,0.18, styleMat('iron',s), sx*w/2, h/2, sz*d/2));
  }
  if(h>8){
    const cx=w*0.3, cz=-d*0.3;
    g.add(cyl(0.32,0.4,h*0.5,12, styleMat('brick',s), cx,h+h*0.25,cz));
    addSmoke(g, cx, h+h*0.5, cz, 0.9);
  }
  g.add(cyl(0.5,0.5,0.9,10, styleMat('copper',s), -w*0.25,h+0.6,d*0.2));
  windowGrid(g, w,h,d, floors, Math.max(3,def.foot*2), s, seed);
}

/* Rivet band — small studs around a box face, for iron plating detail */
function rivetBand(g, w, y, d, s){
  const m=styleMat('iron',s);
  const n=Math.max(3,Math.round(w/0.5));
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const t=(i/(n-1)-0.5)*w;
    g.add(cyl(0.04,0.04,0.08,6, m, t, y, d/2+0.02));
  }
}
/* window strip on the 4 facades. Windows span y=0..h (body base sits on ground). */
function windowGrid(group, w, h, d, floors, cols, s, seed, yBase){
  const rnd = srand(seed||1);
  const fh = h/floors;
  yBase = yBase||0;
  const faces = [
    {axis:'z', off:d/2+0.03, rot:0,          across:w},
    {axis:'z', off:-d/2-0.03, rot:Math.PI,   across:w},
    {axis:'x', off:w/2+0.03, rot:Math.PI/2,  across:d},
    {axis:'x', off:-w/2-0.03, rot:-Math.PI/2, across:d},
  ];
  for(const f of faces){
    const cw = f.across/cols * 0.62;
    const ch = fh*0.58;
    for(let fl=0; fl<floors; fl++){
      for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){
        if(rnd()<0.12) continue;               // some dark/gap windows
        const lit = rnd()<0.5;
        const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(cw,ch),
          mat(s.glass,{emissive:s.emissive, ei:lit?1.0:0.25, metal:0.4, rough:0.1}).clone());
        m.userData.window = true; m.userData.lit = lit;
        const ax = (c+0.5)/cols*f.across - f.across/2;
        const y = yBase + (fl+0.5)*fh;         // stack from base upward
        if(f.axis==='z'){ m.position.set(ax, y, f.off); m.rotation.y=f.rot; }
        else            { m.position.set(f.off, y, ax); m.rotation.y=f.rot; }
        group.add(m);
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MASTER BUILD FUNCTION
   ============================================================ */
function makeBuilding(key, styleKey, seed){
  const def = BUILDINGS[key];
  const s = STYLES[styleKey];
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const fn = GEN[key] || GEN._default;
  fn(g, def, s, seed||1);
  g.userData.key = key;
  return g;
}

const GEN = {};

/* ---------------- generic fallback ---------------- */
GEN._default = (g, def, s, seed)=>{
  const w = def.foot*TILE*0.8, h = 8;
  g.add(box(w,h,w, styleMat('body',s), 0, h/2, 0));

GEN.house = (g, def, s, seed)=>{

    g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('body',s),0,h/2,0));
    // pitched roof
    const roof = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(w*0.8,1.6,4), styleMat('trim',s));
    roof.rotation.y=Math.PI/4; roof.position.y=h+0.8; roof.castShadow=true; g.add(roof);
    // columns
    for(const sx of [-1,1]){
      g.add(cyl(0.12,0.12,h*0.8,8, styleMat('trim',s), sx*w*0.35, h*0.4, d/2+0.05));

    roof.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; roof.rotation.y=Math.PI/2; roof.scale.set(1,1,d/w);
    roof.position.y=h+0.6; roof.castShadow=true; g.add(roof);

    const chim=box(0.4,1.6,0.4, styleMat('brick',s), w*0.3,h+1,-d*0.2); g.add(chim);

GEN.tower = (g, def, s, seed)=>{
  if(s===STYLES.industrial){ industrialGeneric(g,def,s,seed,{ h:26+srand(seed)()*10, w:TILE*1.5, d:TILE*1.5 }); return; }
  const rnd=srand(seed);

  if(s===STYLES.futuristic){
    // twisting glass tower via stacked rotated slabs
    const slabs=Math.floor(h/1.4);
    const spin=new THREE.Group();
    for(let i=0;i<slabs;i++){
      const t=i/slabs;
      const sw=w*(1-0.28*t);
      const slab=box(sw,1.4,sw*d/w, styleMat(i%3===0?'glassLit':'body',s),0,i*1.4+0.7,0);
      slab.rotation.y = t*Math.PI*0.5;

    g.userData.pulse = spire;
  } else if(s===STYLES.neofuture){
    g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('body',s),0,h/2,0));

    for(let fl=2; fl<floors; fl+=3){

GEN.park = (g, def, s, seed)=>{
  const rnd=srand(seed);
  const w=TILE*1.9;

  g.add(box(w,0.3,w, mat(0x3f7a4a,{rough:1}),0,0.15,0));

  g.add(box(w,0.32,0.8, mat(0x6a6152,{rough:0.9}),0,0.16,0));
  g.add(box(0.8,0.32,w, mat(0x6a6152,{rough:0.9}),0,0.16,0));
  // trees (style-tinted)
  const treeCol = s===STYLES.eco?0x5aa86a: s===STYLES.neofuture?0x3ad0c0:0x4a9a5a;
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const tx=(rnd()-0.5)*w*0.8, tz=(rnd()-0.5)*w*0.8;

      mat(treeCol,{flat:true,rough:1}));
    crown.position.set(tx,1.5,tz); crown.castShadow=true; g.add(crown);

  if(s===STYLES.futuristic||s===STYLES.neofuture){
    const orb=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.7,1), styleMat('emit',s));

GEN.factory = (g, def, s, seed)=>{
  const rnd=srand(seed);
  const w=TILE*1.6,d=TILE*1.4,h=6;
  if(s===STYLES.industrial){
    // classic red-brick mill with tall smokestacks belching soot
    g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('brick',s),0,h/2,0));
    // iron base course & cornice
    g.add(box(w*1.03,0.5,d*1.03, styleMat('iron',s),0,0.25,0));
    g.add(box(w*1.03,0.4,d*1.03, styleMat('iron',s),0,h-0.2,0));
    rivetBand(g, w, h*0.5, d, s);
    // sawtooth glazed roof (soot-darkened glass)
    for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
      const saw=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55,0.55,d,3,1),styleMat(i%2?'glass':'iron',s));
      saw.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; saw.rotation.y=Math.PI/2; saw.scale.set(1,1,0.55);
      saw.position.set(i*w*0.18,h+0.25,0); saw.castShadow=true; g.add(saw);
    }
    // two tall brick smokestacks with iron bands + smoke
    for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
      const cx=w*0.32*(i?1:-1), cz=-d*0.28;
      g.add(cyl(0.42,0.55,6,14, styleMat('brick',s), cx,h+3,cz));
      for(let k=1;k<=3;k++) g.add(cyl(0.46,0.46,0.2,14, styleMat('iron',s), cx,h+1.2*k+0.5,cz));
      g.add(cyl(0.5,0.42,0.4,14, styleMat('iron',s), cx,h+6,cz));
      addSmoke(g, cx, h+6.3, cz, 1.1);
    }
    // glowing furnace door at ground level
    const forge=box(1.0,1.3,0.15, styleMat('furnace',s),0,0.9,d/2+0.02);
    g.add(forge); g.userData.pulse=forge;
    // external pipework
    g.add(cyl(0.12,0.12,h,8, styleMat('copper',s), w/2-0.1,h/2,d/2-0.1));
    g.add(cyl(0.12,0.12,w*0.6,8, styleMat('copper',s), 0,h*0.7,d/2-0.1));
    g.children[g.children.length-1].rotation.z=Math.PI/2;
    windowGrid(g,w,h,d,3,4,s,seed);
    return;
  }
  g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('body',s),0,h/2,0));
  // sawtooth roof
  for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
    const saw=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6,0.6,d,3,1),styleMat(i%2?'glass':'trim',s));
    saw.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; saw.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;
    saw.scale.set(1,1,0.6);
    saw.position.set(i*w*0.18,h+0.3,0); saw.castShadow=true; g.add(saw);
  }
  // chimneys
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const cx=w*0.25*(i?1:-1), cz=-d*0.2;
    g.add(cyl(0.4,0.5,4,12, styleMat('trim',s), cx,h+2,cz));
    if(s===STYLES.cyber){ const cap=cyl(0.5,0.4,0.4,12, styleMat('emit',s),cx,h+4,cz); g.add(cap); }
  }
  windowGrid(g,w,h,d,3,4,s,seed);
};

GEN.powerplant = (g, def, s, seed)=>{
  const w=TILE*1.6,d=TILE*1.6,h=5;

    // coal-fired power station: brick hall, coal shelter, huge chimney
    g.add(box(w,h,d, styleMat('brick',s),0,h/2,0));

    g.add(cyl(0.7,0.95,10,16, styleMat('brick',s), -w*0.15,h+5,-d*0.1));

    addSmoke(g, -w*0.15, h+10, -d*0.1, 1.5);
    // coal shelter (dark heap) + conveyor
    g.add(box(1.6,1.2,1.6, styleMat('iron',s), w*0.3,0.6,d*0.2));
    const heap=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.9,1.1,8), mat(0x1a1712,{rough:1,flat:true}));
    heap.position.set(w*0.3,1.5,d*0.2); g.add(heap);
    const conv=box(2.4,0.15,0.4, styleMat('iron',s), w*0.05,2.2,d*0.2); conv.rotation.z=0.35; g.add(conv);

    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){

    const core=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.9,1), styleMat('emit',s));
    core.position.y=h+1.5; g.add(core); g.userData.pulse=core;
