    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i/4*Math.PI*2;
      g.add(cyl(0.1,0.1,2,6, styleMat('trim',s), Math.cos(a),h+0.5,Math.sin(a)));}
  } else {
    // cooling towers
    for(const sx of[-1,1]){
      const tw=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.3,1.7,5,20,1,true),styleMat('body',s));
      tw.position.set(sx*w*0.25,h+2.5,0); tw.castShadow=true; g.add(tw);
      // steam
      const steam=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.2,0),
        mat(0xdde6f0,{transparent:true,opacity:0.35,rough:1,flat:true}));
      steam.position.set(sx*w*0.25,h+6,0); g.add(steam);
    }
    // reactor dome
    const dome=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.4,16,10,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2),styleMat('trim',s));
    dome.position.set(-w*0.1,h,d*0.2); g.add(dome);
  }

const CITY_CATS = ['Core','Infrastructure','Housing','Services','Extraction','Industry','Electrical','Power','Civic','Military','Defenses'];

/* level scaling: output and cost multipliers per level */
function lvlOut(lvl){ return 1 + (lvl-1)*0.85; }       // +85% output per level
function lvlCostMul(lvl){ return Math.pow(1.55, lvl-1); } // upgrades stay affordable
function upgradeCost(key, lvl){
  const def=CITY[key]||BUILDINGS[key];
  const base=def.cost||{credits:200};
  const mul=lvlCostMul(lvl+1)*0.55;
  const out={};
  for(const r in base) out[r]=Math.ceil(base[r]*mul);
  if(!out.credits) out.credits=Math.ceil(180*mul);
  return out;
}
function canAfford(cost){
  for(const r in cost) if((STOCK[r]||0) < cost[r]) return false;
  return true;
}
function payCost(cost){ for(const r in cost) STOCK[r]-=cost[r]; }
function costText(cost){
  return Object.keys(cost).map(r=>{
    const have=(STOCK[r]||0)>=cost[r];
    const R=RESOURCES[r]||{ic:'?',nm:r};
    return `<span style="color:${have?'var(--ink)':'var(--bad)'}">${R.ic}${cost[r]}</span>`;
  }).join(' ');
}

  concrete:0xcfcabf, concreteDark:0xa8a298, panel:0xdfe3e6,
  glass:0x9fc9dd, glassDark:0x6f9db4, metal:0xb9bfc4, dark:0x5c6169,
  roof:0x8d8f92, accent:0x3a7fb5, brickRed:0xa5624a, wood:0xa9793f,
  green:0x6f9d52, asphalt:0x54565c, warmLight:0xffdca8,
};
const M = MODERN;
function cm(hex,o){ return mat(hex, Object.assign({metal:0.1,rough:0.75},o||{})); }
function glassMat(){ return mat(M.glass,{metal:0.55,rough:0.12,emissive:0x14202a,ei:0.12}); }

/* windows for modern blocks — regular bands, warm interior light at night */
function modWindows(g,w,h,d,floors,cols,seed,yBase){
  const rnd=srand(seed||3); yBase=yBase||0;
  const fh=h/floors;
  const faces=[{ax:'z',off:d/2+0.04,rot:0,across:w},{ax:'z',off:-d/2-0.04,rot:Math.PI,across:w},
               {ax:'x',off:w/2+0.04,rot:Math.PI/2,across:d},{ax:'x',off:-w/2-0.04,rot:-Math.PI/2,across:d}];
  for(const f of faces){
    const cw=f.across/cols*0.68, ch=fh*0.55;
    for(let fl=0;fl<floors;fl++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){
      const lit=rnd()<0.45;
      const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(cw,ch),
        mat(M.glass,{metal:0.5,rough:0.12,emissive:M.warmLight,ei:lit?0.9:0.1}));
      m.userData.window=true; m.userData.lit=lit;
      const ax=(c+0.5)/cols*f.across-f.across/2, y=yBase+(fl+0.5)*fh;
      if(f.ax==='z'){ m.position.set(ax,y,f.off); m.rotation.y=f.rot; }
      else { m.position.set(f.off,y,ax); m.rotation.y=f.rot; }
      g.add(m);
    }
  }
}
/* extra facade detail: sills, a canopy, downpipes, a sign and roof clutter.
   Applied on top of the plain blocks so ordinary buildings read as built. */
function detailFacade(g,w,h2,d,seed,opt){
  opt=opt||{}; const rnd=srand(seed||11);
  const trim=cm(M.concreteDark,{rough:0.85}), metal=cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5,rough:0.45});
  const floors=Math.max(1,Math.round(h2/1.9));
  // window sills band on each floor
  for(let f=1;f<floors;f++){
    const y=(f/floors)*h2;
    g.add(box(w*1.012,0.07,d*1.012, trim, 0,y,0));
  }
  // corner pilasters
  for(const sx of[-1,1])for(const sz of[-1,1])
    g.add(box(0.13,h2,0.13, trim, sx*w/2, h2/2, sz*d/2));
  // entrance canopy + steps + door
  g.add(box(w*0.34,0.1,0.75, metal, 0,1.35,d/2+0.36));
  g.add(box(w*0.3,1.1,0.07, glassMat(), 0,0.62,d/2+0.03));
  g.add(box(w*0.4,0.14,0.5, trim, 0,0.07,d/2+0.4));
  // downpipes
  for(const sx of[-1,1]) g.add(cyl(0.055,0.055,h2*0.92,6, metal, sx*w*0.44, h2*0.46, d/2-0.06));
  // a small sign over the door
  if(opt.sign!==false)
    g.add(box(w*0.3,0.24,0.06, cm(opt.signCol||M.accent,{emissive:opt.signCol||M.accent,ei:0.25}),
      0, 1.72, d/2+0.05));
  // roof clutter: vents, an aerial, a hauler
  const top=h2+0.2;
  for(let i=0;i<2+Math.round(rnd()*2);i++)
    g.add(box(0.34,0.26,0.34, metal, (rnd()-0.5)*w*0.62, top+0.13, (rnd()-0.5)*d*0.62));
  g.add(cyl(0.03,0.03,1.5,4, metal, w*0.3, top+0.75, -d*0.3));
  g.add(cyl(0.26,0.26,0.42,10, metal, -w*0.28, top+0.21, d*0.24));
}
/* flat modern roof with parapet, vents and a stair head */
function modRoof(g,w,h,d,seed){
  const rnd=srand(seed||5);
  g.add(box(w*1.03,0.22,d*1.03, cm(M.concreteDark), 0,h+0.11,0));
  g.add(box(w*0.22,0.7,d*0.22, cm(M.concrete), -w*0.25,h+0.45,-d*0.2));   // stair head
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    g.add(box(0.4,0.3,0.4, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5,rough:0.5}),
      (rnd()-0.5)*w*0.6, h+0.36, (rnd()-0.5)*d*0.6));
  }
  g.add(cyl(0.28,0.28,0.5,10, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.6,rough:0.4}), w*0.28,h+0.45,d*0.22));
}

/* ---------- generic modern block, scales with level ---------- */
function modBlock(g, opts){
  const w=opts.w, d=opts.d, h=opts.h, floors=Math.max(1,Math.round(h/1.9));
  const bodyM = opts.bodyM || cm(M.concrete);
  g.add(box(w,h,d, bodyM, 0,h/2,0));
  // ground floor plinth
  g.add(box(w*1.02,0.9,d*1.02, cm(M.concreteDark), 0,0.45,0));
  // vertical fins / mullions
  const fins=Math.max(2,Math.round(w/1.1));
  for(let i=0;i<=fins;i++){
    const x=(i/fins-0.5)*w;
    g.add(box(0.1,h-1.0,0.08, cm(M.panel), x, h/2+0.45, d/2+0.02));
    g.add(box(0.1,h-1.0,0.08, cm(M.panel), x, h/2+0.45, -d/2-0.02));
  }
  modWindows(g,w,h,d,floors,Math.max(2,Math.round(w/1.3)),opts.seed);
  modRoof(g,w,h,d,opts.seed);
  detailFacade(g,w,h,d,opts.seed,{signCol:opts.signCol});
  // entrance canopy
  g.add(box(w*0.34,0.14,0.9, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5,rough:0.4}), 0,1.15,d/2+0.45));
  g.add(box(w*0.3,0.9,0.1, glassMat(), 0,0.55,d/2+0.03));
}

/* ---------- industrial shed used by most production buildings ---------- */
function modShed(g, opts){
  const w=opts.w, d=opts.d, h=opts.h||4.4;
  g.add(box(w,h,d, cm(opts.color||M.panel), 0,h/2,0));
  // ribbed cladding
  for(let i=0;i<Math.round(w/0.8);i++){
    g.add(box(0.06,h,0.06, cm(M.concreteDark), -w/2+i*0.8+0.4,h/2,d/2+0.03));
  }
  // low-pitch roof
  const roof=box(w*1.04,0.42,d*1.04, cm(M.roof,{metal:0.3,rough:0.6}), 0,h+0.21,0);
  roof.castShadow=true; g.add(roof);
  g.add(box(w*0.72,0.34,d*0.72, cm(M.roof,{metal:0.3,rough:0.6}), 0,h+0.55,0));
  // roller shutter + office annex
  g.add(box(w*0.3,h*0.62,0.12, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5,rough:0.5}), -w*0.22,h*0.31,d/2+0.03));
  g.add(box(w*0.3,h*0.72,d*0.3, cm(M.concrete), w*0.3,h*0.36,d/2-d*0.15+0.02));
  g.add(box(w*0.26,0.7,0.08, glassMat(), w*0.3,h*0.5,d/2+0.03));
}
function stack(g,x,z,h,r,smokeScale){
  g.add(cyl(r*0.85,r,h,12, cm(M.concreteDark), x,h/2,z));
  g.add(cyl(r*0.95,r*0.95,0.25,12, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.6,rough:0.4}), x,h,z));
  if(smokeScale) addSmoke(g,x,h+0.3,z,smokeScale);
}
function hauler(g,x,z,r,h,color){
  g.add(cyl(r,r,h,16, cm(color||M.panel,{metal:0.35,rough:0.5}), x,h/2,z));
  g.add(cyl(r*1.03,r*1.03,0.12,16, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5}), x,h,z));
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ const a=i/4*Math.PI*2;
    g.add(box(0.08,h,0.08, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5}), x+Math.cos(a)*r*1.02,h/2,z+Math.sin(a)*r*1.02)); }
}
function conveyor(g,x1,z1,x2,z2,y){
  const dx=x2-x1, dz=z2-z1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
  const belt=box(0.5,0.14,len, cm(M.dark,{metal:0.4}), (x1+x2)/2,y,(z1+z2)/2);
  belt.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dx,dz); g.add(belt);
}

/* generic mine used by coal/iron/copper/zinc/bauxite with a tinted spoil heap */

/* factory-style refiners share a shed + haulers + stacks, tinted per product */
function plantGen(opts){
  return (g,def,lvl,seed)=>{
    const w=TILE*1.6,d=TILE*1.4;
    modShed(g,{w,d,h:opts.h||4.6,color:opts.color||M.panel});
    const n=Math.min(4,1+lvl);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++) hauler(g, -w*0.28+i*0.95, -d*0.34, 0.42, 1.6+ (i%2)*0.4, opts.hauler||M.panel);
    if(opts.stacks) for(let i=0;i<opts.stacks;i++)
      stack(g, w*0.3-i*0.9, -d*0.3, 5.2+lvl*0.4, 0.3, opts.smoke===false?0:0.85);
    if(opts.glow){
      const gl=box(1.0,1.1,0.14, mat(opts.glow,{emissive:opts.glow,ei:1.0}), -w*0.05,0.75,d/2+0.04);
      g.add(gl); g.userData.pulse=gl;
    }
    if(opts.pipes) for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const p=cyl(0.1,0.1,w*0.8,8, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.55}), 0,1.4+i*0.32,-d*0.5-0.2);
      p.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; g.add(p);
    }
    conveyor(g,-w*0.4,d*0.42,w*0.4,d*0.42,0.9);
  };
}

CGEN.watermill=(g,def,lvl,seed)=>{
  const w=TILE*0.62, h=2.8+lvl*0.4;
  // stone-and-timber mill house
  g.add(box(w,h,w, cm(0xbeb39a,{rough:0.9}), 0,h/2,0));
  const roof=box(w*1.12,0.5,w*1.12, cm(M.brickRed,{rough:0.85}), 0,h+0.25,0); g.add(roof);
  g.add(box(w*0.7,0.4,w*0.7, cm(M.brickRed,{rough:0.85}), 0,h+0.6,0));
  // sluice/flume feeding the wheel
  g.add(box(0.4,0.3,w*1.4, cm(M.wood), w*0.55,h*0.4,0));
  // the water wheel — a vertical wheel that dips into the flume alongside the mill
  const wheel=new THREE.Group();
  const rim=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.05,0.09,8,20), cm(M.wood,{rough:0.85}));
  wheel.add(rim);
  const rim2=rim.clone(); rim2.position.z=0.34; wheel.add(rim2);
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const a=i/10*Math.PI*2;
    const spoke=box(0.06,2.1,0.06, cm(M.wood), 0,0,0.17); spoke.rotation.z=a; wheel.add(spoke);
    const pad=box(0.5,0.16,0.42, cm(0x8a6a44,{rough:0.9}),
      Math.cos(a)*1.02, Math.sin(a)*1.02, 0.17); pad.rotation.z=a; wheel.add(pad);
  }
  const axle=cyl(0.12,0.12,0.6,10, cm(M.dark,{metal:0.5}),0,0,0.17); axle.rotation.x=Math.PI/2; wheel.add(axle);
  // stand the wheel up on its side so the paddles meet the water beside the mill
  wheel.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;
  wheel.position.set(w*0.75, 1.1, 0);
  g.add(wheel); g.userData.spinAxle=wheel;   // spins around its own axle
  // generator shed
  g.add(box(0.7,0.7,0.7, cm(M.metal,{metal:0.5}), -w*0.3,0.55,w*0.2));
};

CGEN.roundabout=(g,def,lvl,seed,extra)=>{
  extra=extra||{};
  const wx=extra.wx||0, wz=extra.wz||0;
  const w=TILE*0.5;
  const road=cm(0x53565c,{rough:0.95}), curb=cm(0xcfc6b2,{rough:0.9}),
        line=cm(0xe8d98a,{rough:0.7});
  const c0=(typeof groundHeight==='function')?groundHeight(wx,wz):0;
  const hAt=(dx,dz)=>{ try{ return terrainHeightAt(wx+dx,wz+dz)-c0; }catch(e){ return 0; } };
  // a flat pad averaged from the corners so the junction reads level
  const avg=(hAt(-w,-w)+hAt(w,-w)+hAt(w,w)+hAt(-w,w))/4;
  const pad=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(TILE*0.62,TILE*0.66,0.14,26), road);
  pad.position.y=avg; pad.receiveShadow=true; g.add(pad);
  // approach aprons so it blends into the four roads
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const a=i*Math.PI/2;
    const ap=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(TILE*0.62,0.1,TILE*0.5), road);
    ap.position.set(Math.cos(a)*TILE*0.42, avg+0.01, Math.sin(a)*TILE*0.42);
    ap.rotation.y=a; g.add(ap);
  }
  // outer kerb ring + painted ring
  const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(TILE*0.63,0.09,8,28), curb);
  ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2; ring.position.y=avg+0.1; g.add(ring);
  const paint=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(TILE*0.4,0.035,6,26), line);
  paint.rotation.x=Math.PI/2; paint.position.y=avg+0.1; g.add(paint);
  // central island: kerb, grass, a little planting
  const isl=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(TILE*0.24,TILE*0.26,0.34,20), curb);
  isl.position.y=avg+0.17; isl.castShadow=true; g.add(isl);
  const grass=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(TILE*0.2,TILE*0.2,0.1,20), cm(0x6f9d52,{rough:1}));
  grass.position.y=avg+0.36; g.add(grass);
  const rnd=srand(seed||3);
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const a=rnd()*Math.PI*2, r=rnd()*TILE*0.12;
    g.add(cyl(0.07,0.09,0.6,6, cm(0x6b4f35,{rough:1}), Math.cos(a)*r, avg+0.7, Math.sin(a)*r));
    const cr=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.36,0), cm(0x5f9440,{rough:1,flat:true}));
    cr.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r, avg+1.2, Math.sin(a)*r); g.add(cr);
  }
  // drawn ribbons are laid over the tiles, so the roundabout has to sit above
  // them or it disappears underneath — lift it and force it to draw last
  g.traverse(function(o){
    if(!o.isMesh) return;
    o.renderOrder=6;
    if(o.material){ o.material.polygonOffset=true;
      o.material.polygonOffsetFactor=-6; o.material.polygonOffsetUnits=-6;
      o.material.depthWrite=true; }
  });
  g.position.y += 0.16;
  g.userData.isRoad=true; g.userData.roundabout=true;
};

CGEN.road=(g,def,lvl,seed,extra)=>{
  extra=(typeof extra==='number')?{mask:extra}:(extra||{});
  const mask=extra.mask||0, wx=extra.wx||0, wz=extra.wz||0;
  const w=TILE*0.34;                       // narrower carriageway
  // asphalt tone shifts with how worn the tile is: fresh dark grey, then
  // sun-bleached, then broken-up brown where the surface has failed
  const wear=Math.max(0,Math.min(1, extra.wear||0));
  const fresh=new THREE.Color(0x3f434a), worn=new THREE.Color(0x6d6a60), broke=new THREE.Color(0x7b5f4a);
  const tone=new THREE.Color();
  if(wear<0.6) tone.copy(fresh).lerp(worn, wear/0.6); else tone.copy(worn).lerp(broke,(wear-0.6)/0.4);
  const road=cm(tone.getHex(),{rough:0.9+wear*0.08,metal:0.02}),
        curb=cm(0xc4bfb2,{rough:0.85}),
        line=cm(0xefe3a6,{rough:0.5});
  const c0=(typeof groundHeight==='function')?groundHeight(wx,wz):0;
  const hAt=(dx,dz)=>{ try{ return terrainHeightAt(wx+dx,wz+dz)-c0; }catch(e){ return 0; } };
  const NW=hAt(-w,-w), NE=hAt(w,-w), SE=hAt(w,w), SW=hAt(-w,w);
  // the deck: a single quad pinned to the four ground corners
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  // ordered anti-clockwise seen from above so the surface faces UP — with the
  // old winding the deck pointed at the ground and only the kerbs showed
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array([
    -w,NW,-w,  w,SE, w,  w,NE,-w,
    -w,NW,-w, -w,SW, w,  w,SE, w ]),3));
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  road.side=THREE.DoubleSide;                 // belt and braces
  const deck=new THREE.Mesh(geo, road);
  deck.position.y=0.05; deck.receiveShadow=true; g.add(deck);
  const surf=(x,z)=>{ const u=(x+w)/(2*w), t=(z+w)/(2*w);
    return (NW*(1-u)+NE*u)*(1-t)+(SW*(1-u)+SE*u)*t; };
  const put=(m,x,z,lift)=>{ m.position.set(x, surf(x,z)+(lift||0), z); g.add(m); };
  const N=!!(mask&1), E=!!(mask&2), S=!!(mask&4), W=!!(mask&8);
  const count=(N?1:0)+(E?1:0)+(S?1:0)+(W?1:0);
  // a slim kerb only where the road does not continue
  const kerb=(x,z,sx,sz)=>put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx,0.13,sz),curb),x,z,0.1);
  if(!N) kerb(0,-w*0.93, w*1.9, 0.16);
  if(!S) kerb(0, w*0.93, w*1.9, 0.16);
  if(!W) kerb(-w*0.93,0, 0.16, w*1.9);
  if(!E) kerb( w*0.93,0, 0.16, w*1.9);
  // markings
  const dash=v=>{ for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++)
    put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(v?0.13:0.55,0.03,v?0.55:0.13),line), v?0:i*1.15, v?i*1.15:0, 0.085); };
  if(count>=3){
    put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62,0.03,0.62), cm(0x55585e,{rough:0.9})),0,0,0.08);
  } else if(count===2 && ((N&&S)||(E&&W))) dash(N&&S);
  else if(count===2){
    const cx=(E?1:-1)*(E||W?1:0), cz=(S?1:-1)*(S||N?1:0);
    put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5,0.03,0.13),line), cx*w*0.45,0,0.085);
    put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.13,0.03,0.5),line), 0,cz*w*0.45,0.085);
  } else if(count===1) dash(N||S);
  // cracks and potholes once the surface starts failing
  if(wear>0.55){
    const crack=cm(0x2e2a26,{rough:1});
    const rnd=srand(Math.round(wx*7+wz*13)||3);
    const nCr=Math.round(2+wear*5);
    for(let i=0;i<nCr;i++){
      const cx2=(rnd()-0.5)*w*1.5, cz2=(rnd()-0.5)*w*1.5;
      const len=0.3+rnd()*0.9;
      const m2=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(rnd()>0.5?len:0.08,0.02,rnd()>0.5?0.08:len), crack);
      put(m2,cx2,cz2,0.055);
    }
    if(wear>0.9){
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        const hx=(rnd()-0.5)*w*1.3, hz=(rnd()-0.5)*w*1.3;
        const hole=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.16+rnd()*0.14,0.12,0.06,8), crack);
        put(hole,hx,hz,0.04);
      }
    }
  }
  g.userData.roadMask=mask; g.userData.isRoad=true; g.userData.wear=wear;
};

function addAutomationKit(g, key, lvl){

  for(let i=0;i<5;i++)
    g.add(box(0.5,0.06,0.28, metal, -w*0.2+i*0.34,0.45,w*0.2));

function makeCityBuilding(key, lvl, seed, extra){
  const def = CITY[key] || BUILDINGS[key] || {foot:1};
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  if(CGEN[key]) CGEN[key](g, def, lvl||1, seed||1, extra);
  else if(typeof GEN!=='undefined' && GEN[key]) GEN[key](g, def, STYLES.modern, seed||1);
  else CGEN._default(g, def, lvl||1, seed||1);
  // lift anything whose geometry dips below the plot so it never sinks into terrain
  g.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const bb=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(g);
  if(isFinite(bb.min.y) && bb.min.y < -0.05){
    const lift=-bb.min.y;
    for(const ch of g.children) ch.position.y += lift;
    g.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  }
  // a mechanised worksite looks the part
  try{
    const _d=bldDef(key);
    const _auto=(extra&&extra.auto!==undefined) ? extra.auto
              : (_d.manned && (lvl||1)>=AUTO_LEVEL);
    if(_d.manned && _auto) addAutomationKit(g,key,lvl);
  }catch(e){}
  g.userData.key=key; g.userData.lvl=lvl||1;
  return g;
}

  for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++) g.add(box(0.1,h*0.68,0.1, mmat(0x3a3830), i*w*0.11,h*0.35,d/2+0.14));

  g.add(box(w*0.9,0.18,0.18, trim, 0,h+w*0.5-0.4,0));
  g.add(box(0.5,0.3,0.5, trim, 0.6,h+w*0.5-0.7,0));
  // a hauler hull under construction on the apron
  const hull=box(1.4,0.4,2.2, mmat(c.base,{rough:0.9}), -w*0.15,0.35,d/2+1.7); g.add(hull);
  g.add(box(1.5,0.14,2.3, trim, -w*0.15,0.6,d/2+1.7));
  windowGrid(g,w,h,d,2,4,s,seed);
};

const aiFactions = [];      // {key, name, color, style, origin:{x,z}, buildings:[], units:[], credits, tick}
const allUnits = [];        // every live unit in the world (player + AI)

/* Where each enemy sits relative to the player's central plateau */
const AI_SITES = [
  { dx:-300, dz:-270 }, { dx: 310, dz:-240 }, { dx:-250, dz: 300 }, { dx: 290, dz: 300 },
];

const RIVAL_CITIES=[
  {key:'northgate', nm:'Northgate', color:'#c2603f'},
  {key:'lakeport',  nm:'Lakeport',  color:'#2f9e63'},
  {key:'redridge',  nm:'Redridge',  color:'#8c5bd0'},
  {key:'eastmoor',  nm:'Eastmoor',  color:'#d99a2b'},
];
function aiFindGround(tx,tz){
  let best={x:tx,z:tz}, bs=1e9;
  for(let i=0;i<120;i++){
    const x=tx+(Math.random()*2-1)*40, z=tz+(Math.random()*2-1)*40;
    const h=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
    if(h<WATER_LEVEL+1) continue;
    if(h>16) continue;
    let sl=slotSlope(Math.round(x/TILE),Math.round(z/TILE));
    if(sl<bs){ bs=sl; best={x,z}; if(sl<1.2) break; }
  }
  return best;
}
/* pick a random spawn site for a enemy, kept away from the player and other enemy */
function aiRandomSite(taken){
  const lim=(HALF-40);
  for(let tries=0;tries<200;tries++){
    const x=(Math.random()*2-1)*lim, z=(Math.random()*2-1)*lim;
    // keep a healthy distance from the player's start
    if(Math.hypot(x-START.x, z-START.z) < 300) continue;
    // and from other enemy already placed
    let clash=false;
    for(const t of taken){ if(Math.hypot(x-t.x, z-t.z) < 260){ clash=true; break; } }
    if(clash) continue;
    const h=terrainHeightAt(x,z);
    if(h<WATER_LEVEL+1 || h>16) continue;      // dry, not up a mountain
    return {x,z};
  }
  // fallback: opposite corner from the player
  return {x:-Math.sign(START.x||1)*lim*0.7, z:-Math.sign(START.z||1)*lim*0.7};
}
function spawnAIFactions(){
  const taken=[];
  RIVAL_CITIES.forEach((f)=>{
    const key=f.key;
    const site=aiRandomSite(taken);
    taken.push(site);
    const ai={
      key, name:f.nm, color:f.color, style:'modern',
      origin:aiFindGround(site.x, site.z),
      buildings:[], units:[], credits:1800,
      buildTimer:2+Math.random()*4, unitTimer:8+Math.random()*8,
      grid:{}, ring:1, aggression:0.3+Math.random()*0.5,
    };
    aiFactions.push(ai);
    // seed each enemy with a small starting settlement
    aiPlace(ai,'hall',0,0);
    aiPlace(ai,'apartments',2,0);
    aiPlace(ai,'apartments',-2,0);
    aiPlace(ai,'powerplant',0,3);
    aiPlace(ai,'barracks',3,-2);
    for(let k=0;k<2;k++) aiSpawnUnit(ai,'infantry');
    aiSpawnUnit(ai,'apc');
  });
}

/* place a building for an AI at a grid offset from its origin */
function aiPlace(ai, key, ox, oz){
  const def=(typeof CITY!=='undefined'&&CITY[key])||BUILDINGS[key]; if(!def) return false;
  const gk=ox+','+oz;
  if(ai.grid[gk]) return false;
  const wx=ai.origin.x+ox*TILE, wz=ai.origin.z+oz*TILE;
  // don't build in water
  const h=groundHeight(wx,wz);
  if(h<WATER_LEVEL+0.4) return false;
  // enemy grade their plots too — steep ground slows their expansion
  const agx=Math.round(wx/TILE), agz=Math.round(wz/TILE);
  if(typeof PADS!=='undefined' && PADS[agx+','+agz]===undefined){
    const sl=slotSlope(agx,agz);
    if(sl>2.6) return false;                       // too steep to bother
    ai.credits -= 18+sl*40;
    if(ai.credits<0){ ai.credits=0; return false; }
    if(typeof levelSlot==='function') levelSlot(agx,agz);
  }
  const mesh=makeCityBuilding(key, 1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2), Math.floor(Math.random()*9999));
  if(typeof seatOnGround==='function') seatOnGround(mesh,wx,wz); else mesh.position.set(wx,h,wz);
  mesh.rotation.y=(Math.floor(Math.random()*4))*Math.PI/2;
  scene.add(mesh);
  const b={mesh,key,def,style:ai.style,owner:ai.key};
  ai.buildings.push(b); ai.grid[gk]=b;
  if(typeof applyNightGlow==='function') applyNightGlow(b, isNight);
  return true;
}

/* AI city growth: pick a sensible next building and a free ring slot */
const AI_BUILD_ORDER=['house','apartments','farm','waterworks','shop','quarry','coalplant',
  'lumberyard','brickworks','cement','barracks','ironmine','steelmill','office','park',
  'tower','coppermine','smelter','airpad','lab','tower','radar','stadium'];
function aiGrow(ai){
  if(ai.credits<300) { ai.credits+=60; return; }
  // choose a building, weighted toward what it lacks
  const counts={};
  for(const b of ai.buildings) counts[b.key]=(counts[b.key]||0)+1;
  let pick=null;
  for(const k of AI_BUILD_ORDER){
    const have=counts[k]||0;
    const want = (k==='house'||k==='apartments')?4 : (k==='tower')?3 : (k==='shop')?2 : 1;
    if(have<want){ pick=k; break; }
  }
  if(!pick) pick=AI_BUILD_ORDER[Math.floor(Math.random()*AI_BUILD_ORDER.length)];
  const def=(typeof CITY!=='undefined'&&CITY[pick])||BUILDINGS[pick]; if(!def) return;
  const dc=(def.cost&&def.cost.credits)||200;
  if(ai.credits<dc) return;                    // must afford the full price, like the player
  // find a free slot in an expanding ring around the origin
  for(let tries=0;tries<30;tries++){
    const r=ai.ring;
    const ox=Math.round((Math.random()*2-1)*r*2);
    const oz=Math.round((Math.random()*2-1)*r*2);
    if(ai.grid[ox+','+oz]) continue;
    if(aiPlace(ai,pick,ox,oz)){
      ai.credits-=dc;
      if(ai.buildings.length > ai.ring*ai.ring*1.6) ai.ring++;
      return;
    }
  }
}

/* per-frame unit movement, tower tracking and rotor spin */
/* Does a defensive trap at this world position stop a ground unit?
   Player gates let the player's own units through. Air ignores all of this. */
function barrierBlocks(wx, wz, cls, faction){
  const gx=Math.round(wx/TILE), gz=Math.round(wz/TILE);
  const b=occupied[gx+','+gz];
  if(!b) return false;
  const d=(typeof CITY!=='undefined'&&CITY[b.key])||BUILDINGS[b.key]||{};
  if(!d.trap) return false;
  if(d.gate && faction==='player') return false;     // your own gate opens for you
  if(!d.block) return true;                            // solid obstacle
  return d.block.indexOf(cls)!==-1;                    // blocks this class?
}

function unitsTick(dt, t){
  for(let i=allUnits.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const u=allUnits[i];
    if(u.hp<=0){ scene.remove(u.model); allUnits.splice(i,1); continue; }
    const def=u.def, m=u.model;
    // ---- pick a destination ----
    u.wait-=dt;
    if(u.wait<=0){
      const R = def.cls==='air' ? 34 : 22;
      u.tx = u.homeX + (Math.random()-0.5)*R;
      u.tz = u.homeZ + (Math.random()-0.5)*R;
      u.wait = 3+Math.random()*7;
    }
    // ---- move ----
    const dx=u.tx-u.x, dz=u.tz-u.z, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
    if(dist>0.6){
      const step=Math.min(def.spd*dt, dist);
      let nx=u.x + dx/dist*step, nz=u.z + dz/dist*step;
      // ground units are blocked by defensive traps; air ignores them
      if(def.cls!=='air' && typeof barrierBlocks==='function' && barrierBlocks(nx,nz,def.cls,u.faction)){
        // stopped by a wall/fence/etc — pick a new wander target and wait
        u.tx=u.homeX+(Math.random()-0.5)*20; u.tz=u.homeZ+(Math.random()-0.5)*20; u.wait=1+Math.random()*3;
      } else {
        u.x=nx; u.z=nz;
      }
      const want=Math.atan2(dx,dz);
      // smooth turn
      let diff=((want-u.heading+Math.PI*3)%(Math.PI*2))-Math.PI;
      u.heading += diff*Math.min(1, dt*(def.cls==='air'?2.5:1.8));
    }
    m.rotation.y = u.heading;
    // ---- ground follow / flight ----
    if(def.cls==='air'){
      m.position.set(u.x, 0, u.z);
      const fly=m.userData.flyer;
      if(fly){
        const cruise = u.type==='jet' ? 7.5 : 3.4;
        const terr = groundHeight(u.x,u.z);
        fly.position.y = terr + cruise + Math.sin(t*1.3 + u.x*0.1)*0.35;
        // bank into the turn
        fly.rotation.z = -Math.sin(t*0.8+u.z*0.05)*0.12;
      }
      if(m.userData.rotor) m.userData.rotor.rotation.y += dt*38;
      if(m.userData.props) for(const p of m.userData.props) p.rotation.y += dt*60;
      if(m.userData.tailRotor) m.userData.tailRotor.rotation.x += dt*46;
      if(m.userData.burners) for(const b of m.userData.burners)
        b.material.emissiveIntensity = 1.2+Math.sin(t*18)*0.5;
    } else {
      m.position.set(u.x, groundHeight(u.x,u.z), u.z);
      // tilt vehicles to the slope
      const hf=groundHeight(u.x+Math.sin(u.heading)*1.2, u.z+Math.cos(u.heading)*1.2);
      const hb=groundHeight(u.x-Math.sin(u.heading)*1.2, u.z-Math.cos(u.heading)*1.2);
      m.rotation.x = Math.atan2(hb-hf, 2.4);
      // infantry bob while walking
      if(m.userData.walkers && dist>0.6){
        for(const w of m.userData.walkers){
          w.userData.bob += dt*9;
          w.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(w.userData.bob))*0.09;
        }
      }
    }
    // ---- tower scan ----
    if(m.userData.tower){
      m.userData.tower.rotation.y = Math.sin(t*0.5 + u.x*0.07)*0.7;
    }
  }
}

function aiPressure(dt){

  const active = score>110;

  }
  _aggro-=dt;
  if(_aggro>0) return;

  try{

function aiTick(dt){

  dt*=_aiMul;

    // roughly matching what a player earns at the same number of buildings

      const sx=(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*TILE)+Math.cos(ang)*r;
      const sz=(b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*TILE)+Math.sin(ang)*r;

/* A missing element must never be able to abort startup, so $() returns a
   harmless stub instead of null when an id is destroyed. */
const _NULLEL = { style:{}, classList:{add(){},remove(){},toggle(){},contains(){return false;}},
  querySelectorAll:()=>[], querySelector:()=>null, appendChild(){}, addEventListener(){},
  removeEventListener(){}, focus(){}, blur(){}, remove(){}, getAttribute(){return null;},
  setAttribute(){}, textContent:'', innerHTML:'', value:'', disabled:false, dataset:{} };
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id) || _NULLEL;

/* Seat a model so its lowest geometry rests exactly on the ground. */
function seatOnGround(mesh, wx, wz){
  mesh.position.set(wx, 0, wz);
  mesh.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const bb=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(mesh);
  const drop=isFinite(bb.min.y)?bb.min.y:0;
  mesh.position.y = groundHeight(wx,wz) - drop;
}

/* ============================================================
   PRIORITIES — you decide what keeps running when power or materials
   run short. 0 = essential, 1 = normal, 2 = low, 3 = only if spare.
   ============================================================ */
const PRIORITY_LABELS=['Essential','Normal','Low','Last'];
const CAT_PRIORITY={};                  // per-category default
function buildPriority(b){
  if(b.pri!==undefined && b.pri!==null) return b.pri;
  const d=bldDef(b.key);
  const c=CAT_PRIORITY[d.cat];
  return (c!==undefined)? c : 1;
}
function setBuildPriority(b, p){ b.pri = (p===null? null : Math.max(0,Math.min(3,p|0))); }
function setCategoryPriority(cat, p){ CAT_PRIORITY[cat]=Math.max(0,Math.min(3,p|0)); }

/* How much of a scarce input this building may take this tick. The whole
   allocation is worked out once per resource per tick, handing supply to the
   highest priority first, so a shortage starves the things you marked
   expendable rather than crippling everything a little. */
let _resAlloc=null, _resStamp=-1, _econDt=0.5;
function resourceShare(res, b, need){
  const have=STOCK[res]||0;
  if(have>=need*1.000001 && !_short(res)) return 1;
  if(_resStamp!==_econStamp){ _resAlloc={}; _resStamp=_econStamp; }
  if(!_resAlloc[res]){
    const claims=[];
    let total=0;
    for(const ob of buildings){
      const od=bldDef(ob.key);
      if(!od.needs || od.needs[res]===undefined) continue;
      const want=od.needs[res]*lvlOut(ob.lvl)*_econDt;
      if(want<=0) continue;
      claims.push({b:ob, want, pri:buildPriority(ob)});
      total+=want;
    }
    claims.sort((x,y)=> x.pri-y.pri);
    let left=STOCK[res]||0;
    const share=new Map();
    for(const c of claims){
      const give=Math.min(left, c.want);
      share.set(c.b, c.want>0? give/c.want : 1);
      left-=give;
    }
    _resAlloc[res]={share, total};
  }
  const s=_resAlloc[res].share.get(b);
  return s===undefined? 1 : s;
}
function _short(res){
  const a=_resAlloc && _resAlloc[res];
  return !!(a && a.total > (STOCK[res]||0));
}
let _econStamp=0;

/* ============================================================
   BUILD ORDER CHECK — no building may cost a material that cannot exist
   until that building is built. Left alone, definitions drift into
   stalemates (a steel mill costing concrete while the concrete plant
   costs steel). This works out what each resource depends on and
   rewrites any build cost that traps its own chain.
   ============================================================ */
const BASE_RESOURCES = ['credits','wood','stone','clay','sand','water','food','wheat',
                        'coal','ironOre','copperOre','zincOre','bauxite','oil','dirt'];
function resourceTiers(){
  const tier={};
  for(const r of BASE_RESOURCES) tier[r]=0;
  // a produced resource sits one level above the deepest thing it needs
  for(let pass=0; pass<12; pass++){
    let moved=false;
    for(const k in CITY){
      const d=CITY[k];
      if(!d.makes) continue;
      let inMax=0, known=true;
      if(d.needs){
        for(const r in d.needs){
          if(r==='power') continue;
          if(tier[r]===undefined){ known=false; break; }
          inMax=Math.max(inMax, tier[r]);
        }
      }
      if(!known) continue;
      for(const out in d.makes){
        if(out==='power'||out==='credits'||out==='research') continue;
        const t=inMax+1;
        if(tier[out]===undefined || t<tier[out]){ tier[out]=t; moved=true; }
      }
    }
    if(!moved) break;
  }
  return tier;
}
/* a rough worth, used when swapping a blocked cost for something buildable */
const SWAP_VALUE = { credits:1, wood:4, stone:4, clay:4, bricks:9, concrete:9, glass:14,
                     steel:18, copper:17, aluminium:22, plastic:16, machinery:95,
                     electronics:85, components:38, fuel:20, sand:4, coal:7 };
/* Walk the tech tree from raw materials. Anything still unbuildable afterwards
   is caught in a cycle, so we swap only the cost items that are causing it —
   nothing else is touched. */
function fixBuildOrder(verbose){
  const changes=[];
  for(let round=0; round<300; round++){
    const have=new Set(BASE_RESOURCES);
    const built=new Set();
    for(let pass=0; pass<40; pass++){
      let moved=false;
      for(const k in CITY){
        if(built.has(k)) continue;
        let ok=true;
        for(const r in (CITY[k].cost||{})) if(!have.has(r)){ ok=false; break; }
        if(!ok) continue;
        built.add(k); moved=true;
        for(const out in (CITY[k].makes||{})) have.add(out);
      }
      if(!moved) break;
    }
    const blocked=Object.keys(CITY).filter(k=>!built.has(k));
    if(!blocked.length) break;
    // unblock the cheapest link first: the building needing the fewest swaps
    let best=null, bestMissing=null;
    for(const k of blocked){
      const d=CITY[k]; if(!d.cost) continue;
      const missing=Object.keys(d.cost).filter(r=>r!=='credits' && !have.has(r));
      if(!missing.length) continue;
      if(!best || missing.length<bestMissing.length){ best=k; bestMissing=missing; }
    }
    if(!best) break;
    const d=CITY[best];
    for(const r of bestMissing){
      const amt=d.cost[r];
      const worth=(SWAP_VALUE[r]||10)*amt;
      delete d.cost[r];
      let swap='stone';
      for(const cand of ['bricks','concrete','wood','stone']) if(have.has(cand)){ swap=cand; break; }
      const swapAmt=Math.max(4, Math.round(worth/(SWAP_VALUE[swap]||4)));
      d.cost[swap]=(d.cost[swap]||0)+swapAmt;
      d.cost.credits=(d.cost.credits||0)+Math.round(worth*0.4);
      changes.push(best+': '+amt+' '+r+' -> '+swapAmt+' '+swap);
    }
  }
  if(verbose && changes.length) console.log('bootsbarrier fixes:', changes);
  return {changes};
}
/* Can every building be reached starting from nothing but raw materials? */
function verifyBuildOrder(){
  const have=new Set(BASE_RESOURCES);
  const built=new Set();
  for(let pass=0; pass<20; pass++){
    let moved=false;
    for(const k in CITY){
      if(built.has(k)) continue;
      const d=CITY[k];
      let ok=true;
      for(const r in (d.cost||{})) if(!have.has(r)) { ok=false; break; }
      if(!ok) continue;
      built.add(k); moved=true;
      for(const out in (d.makes||{})) have.add(out);
    }
    if(!moved) break;
  }
  const blocked=Object.keys(CITY).filter(k=>!built.has(k));
  return {built:built.size, blocked};
}

/* ============================================================
   CROPS — a farm is not just "a farm". You choose what it grows and how the
   field is laid out, and both change what comes off it. Water demand, season
   and weather all pull on the yield.
   ============================================================ */
const CROPS = {
  wheat:    { nm:'Wheat',      ic:'🌾', makes:{wheat:1.4},              water:0.5,
              row:0xd9c46a, h:1.0, best:'summer',
              d:'The staple. Feeds a food mill and keeps bread on the table.' },
  potatoes: { nm:'Potatoes',   ic:'🥔', makes:{potatoes:1.9},           water:0.4,
              row:0x6f8f4a, h:0.6, best:'autumn',
              d:'Heavy yield per field and hardy in poor weather.' },
  produce:  { nm:'Vegetables', ic:'🥬', makes:{produce:1.1, food:0.35}, water:0.9,
              row:0x5f9f52, h:0.75, best:'spring',
              d:'Thirsty, but goes straight to the table as food.' },
  grass:    { nm:'Grass',      ic:'🍃', makes:{grass:2.6},              water:0.25,
              row:0x8fc46a, h:0.45, best:'spring',
              d:'Cheap and undemanding. Roll it into bales at a Baling Shed.' },
  mixed:    { nm:'Mixed beds', ic:'🌱', makes:{wheat:0.6, produce:0.5, potatoes:0.6}, water:0.7,
              row:0x8aa85a, h:0.8, best:null,
              d:'A bit of everything. Lower totals, but never a total loss.' }
};
const FIELD_LAYOUTS = {
  rows:   { nm:'Straight rows',  ic:'▤', yield:1.00, water:1.00, jobs:1.00,
            d:'The standard. Balanced work, water and output.' },
  dense:  { nm:'Dense planting', ic:'▩', yield:1.35, water:1.45, jobs:1.30,
            d:'More crop per field, but thirsty and labour-heavy.' },
  strips: { nm:'Strip fields',   ic:'▥', yield:0.85, water:0.70, jobs:0.85,
            d:'Gentler on water and staff. Steady rather than large.' },
  terrace:{ nm:'Terraced',       ic:'▦', yield:1.10, water:0.85, jobs:1.15,
            d:'Works the slope properly. Good yield with less runoff.' }
};
/* What this particular farm produces, given its crop, layout and the season. */
function farmOutput(b){
  const crop=CROPS[b.crop||'wheat']||CROPS.wheat;
  const lay=FIELD_LAYOUTS[b.layout||'rows']||FIELD_LAYOUTS.rows;
  let mul=lay.yield;
  try{
    const CV=window.__DOM_CIVIC;
    if(CV){ set('sDate', CV.day+' '+['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][(CV.month-1)%12]);
      set('sYear','Year '+CV.year);
      const ds=$('dateStat');
      if(ds) ds.title='Date: '+CV.dateText()+' · upkeep '+CV.upkeep.toFixed(1)+'/s · '+
        'births '+CV.births+' · deaths '+CV.deaths+
        (CV.waste>5?(' · rubbish '+Math.round(CV.waste)):'');
    }
    const Z=window.__DOM_ZONE;
    if(Z){ const zs=$('svcStat');
      if(zs) zs.title=(zs.title||'')+' · demand R'+Math.round(Z.demand.res*100)+
        '% C'+Math.round(Z.demand.com*100)+'% I'+Math.round(Z.demand.ind*100)+
        '% O'+Math.round(Z.demand.off*100)+'%'; }
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    const W=window.__DOM_WEATHER;
    if(W){
      if(crop.best && W.season===crop.best) mul*=1.25;       // in season
      if(W.season==='winter') mul*= (b.crop==='grass') ? 0.7 : 0.45;
      mul*=W.farm;                                            // rain helps, snow hurts
    }
  }catch(e){}
  const out={};
  for(const r in crop.makes) out[r]=crop.makes[r]*mul;
  return out;
}
function farmWater(b){
  const crop=CROPS[b.crop||'wheat']||CROPS.wheat;
  const lay=FIELD_LAYOUTS[b.layout||'rows']||FIELD_LAYOUTS.rows;
  return crop.water*lay.water;
}

/* A manned building runs on people rather than electricity: it needs hands on
   site, and it slows down when the city has nobody spare to send. */
/* From this level a manned worksite is mechanised: it stops needing hands and
   starts drawing power instead. */
const AUTO_LEVEL = 3;
function isAutomated(b){
  const d=bldDef(b.key);
  return !!(d.manned && (b.lvl||1)>=AUTO_LEVEL);
}
function powerNeed(b){
  const d=bldDef(b.key);
  let p=(d.powerUse||0);
  if(isAutomated(b)) p += (d.autoPower!==undefined ? d.autoPower : Math.max(3,(d.jobs||10)*0.45));
  return p*lvlOut(b.lvl);
}
function workerCover(){
  try{
    let need=0;
    // an automated site no longer competes for staff
    for(const b of buildings){ const d=bldDef(b.key);
      if(d.manned && !isAutomated(b)) need+=(d.jobs||0)*lvlOut(b.lvl); }
    if(need<=0) return 1;
    const workingAge=cityPop*0.62;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, workingAge/need));
  }catch(e){ return 1; }
}
/* ---------- level-aware economy ---------- */
function bldDef(key){ return CITY[key] || BUILDINGS[key] || {}; }

function economyTick(dt){
  _econStamp++; _econDt=dt;
  if(!gameStarted||cityLost) return;
  for(const k in FLOW) FLOW[k]=0;

  let jobs=0, popCap=0, happyBonus=0, dirty=0, powerGen=0, powerUse=0;
  const daylight = Math.max(0, Math.sin((dayTime-0.25)*Math.PI*2));

  // pass 1: power supply
  for(const b of buildings){
    const d=bldDef(b.key), o=lvlOut(b.lvl);
    if(d.makes&&d.makes.power){
      let mul = d.solar?daylight:1;
      if(d.hydro) mul = 0.5 + 0.25*waterAdjacency(b.gx,b.gz);   // more river = more power
      powerGen += d.makes.power*o*mul;
      b.hydroMul = d.hydro ? mul : undefined;
    }
    if(d.powerUse) powerUse += d.powerUse*o;
  }
  const powerRatio = powerUse>0 ? Math.min(1, powerGen/powerUse) : 1;
  const powered = powerRatio >= 0.999;         // grid meets demand?

  /* ---- POWER RATIONING BY PRIORITY ----
     When the grid cannot meet demand, we no longer brown everything out
     equally. Buildings are served in priority order — essential first — so a
     shortage shuts down the things you marked expendable and leaves the rest
     running at full output. */
  {
    const consumers=[];
    for(const b of buildings){
      const d=bldDef(b.key);
      const pn=powerNeed(b);
      if(!pn) { b.powerShare=1; continue; }
      consumers.push({b, need:pn, pri:buildPriority(b)});
    }
    consumers.sort((a,c)=> a.pri-c.pri || c.need-a.need);
    let budget=powerGen;
    for(const c of consumers){
      if(budget<=0){ c.b.powerShare=0; }
      else if(budget>=c.need){ c.b.powerShare=1; budget-=c.need; }
      else { c.b.powerShare=budget/c.need; budget=0; }
    }
  }
  STOCK.power = powerGen; FLOW.power = powerGen-powerUse;
  lastPowerGen=powerGen; lastPowerUse=powerUse; window.__lastPowerUse=powerUse;

  // ---- service coverage: how much of your housing sits inside a clinic /
  // school / fire / police / transit radius. Uncovered districts are unhappy
  // and stop growing, which is what forces you to plan districts properly. ----
  const SERVICE_KINDS=['health','fire','safety','education','transit'];
  const svcSources={}; for(const s of SERVICE_KINDS) svcSources[s]=[];
  for(const b of buildings){
    const d=bldDef(b.key);
    if(!d.service) continue;
    if(b.unpowered) continue;
    svcSources[d.service].push({
      x:(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*TILE), z:(b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*TILE),
      r:(d.radius||24)*(1+((b.lvl||1)-1)*0.18), s:(d.strength||1)*lvlOut(b.lvl)
    });
  }
  const homes=buildings.filter(b=>bldDef(b.key).pop);
  const cover={}; for(const s of SERVICE_KINDS) cover[s]=0;
  let homeWeight=0;
  for(const hb of homes){
    const hx=(hb.cx!==undefined?hb.cx:hb.gx*TILE), hz=(hb.cz!==undefined?hb.cz:hb.gz*TILE);
    const wgt=(bldDef(hb.key).pop||1)*lvlOut(hb.lvl);
    homeWeight+=wgt;
    hb.svc={};
    for(const s of SERVICE_KINDS){
      let best=0;
      for(const src of svcSources[s]){
        const dd=Math.hypot(hx-src.x, hz-src.z);
        if(dd<=src.r) best=Math.max(best, Math.min(1, src.s*(1-dd/src.r*0.45)));
      }
      hb.svc[s]=best; cover[s]+=best*wgt;
    }
  }
  for(const s of SERVICE_KINDS) cover[s] = homeWeight>0 ? cover[s]/homeWeight : 0;
  cityCover=cover;
  const svcAvg=(cover.health+cover.fire+cover.safety+cover.education+cover.transit)/5;
  cityServices=svcAvg;

  window.__workerCover=workerCover();
  // pass 2: production, gated by power and by input availability
  let builders = 1;   // City Hall always provides a small baseline troops
  for(const b of buildings){
    const d=bldDef(b.key), o=lvlOut(b.lvl);
    popCap += (d.pop||0)*o;
    jobs   += (d.jobs||0)*o;
    if(d.builders) builders += d.builders*o;
    if(d.happy) happyBonus += d.happy*o;
    if(d.pollute) dirty += d.pollute*o;

    // a building that draws power only works when the grid supplies its share
    const _auto=isAutomated(b);
    b.automated=_auto;
    const _needsPower=(d.powerUse||_auto);
    let run = (_needsPower ? (b.powerShare!==undefined ? b.powerShare : powerRatio) : 1);
    if(d.manned && !_auto){
      const wc=(window.__workerCover!==undefined? window.__workerCover : 1);
      run=Math.min(run, wc);
      b.shortStaffed = wc<0.6;
    } else b.shortStaffed=false;
    b.unpowered = !!_needsPower && run < 0.05;
    b.unpowered = !!d.powerUse && run < 0.05;
    if(d.needs){
      for(const r in d.needs){
        let need=d.needs[r]*o*dt;
        if(r==='power') continue;
        if(d.farmable && r==='water') need=farmWater(b)*o*dt;   // crop decides thirst
        // scarce inputs are shared out by priority: a high-priority plant keeps
        // running while a low-priority one waits
        const share=resourceShare(r, b, need);
        if(share<1) run = Math.min(run, share);
      }
      run=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,run));
      for(const r in d.needs){
        if(r==='power') continue;
        const used=d.needs[r]*o*dt*run;
        STOCK[r]=Math.max(0,(STOCK[r]||0)-used);
        FLOW[r]-=d.needs[r]*o*run;
      }
    }
    // a lumber yard only runs while there is forest in reach, and it cuts it down
    if(d.needsTrees && typeof treesNear==='function'){
      const lx=(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*TILE), lz=(b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*TILE);
      const stand=treesNear(lx,lz,d.needsTrees);
      b.trees=stand;
      const supply=Math.min(1, stand/6);
      run=Math.min(run, supply);
      if(supply<=0){ b.noTrees=true; } else { b.noTrees=false;
        // felling is deliberately slow: one tree takes a long shift, so a
        // stand lasts for ages and regrowth can keep pace with it
        b._fell=(b._fell||0)+dt*run*lvlOut(b.lvl)*0.012;
        while(b._fell>=1){ b._fell-=1; fellNearestTree(lx,lz,d.needsTrees); }
      }
    }
    b.eff = run;
    if(d.makesDirt){ DIRT += d.makesDirt*o*dt*run; }   // dirt extractor
    // a farm's output comes from its crop and layout, not a fixed recipe
    if(d.farmable){
      const fo=farmOutput(b);
      for(const r in fo){ STOCK[r]=(STOCK[r]||0)+fo[r]*o*dt*run; FLOW[r]=(FLOW[r]||0)+fo[r]*o*run; }
    }
    // weather changes what farms and solar can manage
    try{
      const W=window.__DOM_WEATHER;
      if(W){
        if(d.solar) run *= W.solar;
      // department funding shows up as real output
      try{
        if(govMul.industry && (d.cat==='Industry'||d.cat==='Electrical')) run*=govMul.industry;
        if(govMul.power && d.makes && d.makes.power) run*=govMul.power;
        if(govMul.services && d.service) run*=govMul.services;
      }catch(e){}
        if(d.makes && (d.makes.wheat||d.makes.food)) run *= W.farm;
      }
    }catch(e){}
    if(d.makes){
      if(d.farmable){ /* handled by farmOutput above */ }
      else for(const r in d.makes){
        if(r==='power') continue;
        const made=d.makes[r]*o*dt*run*(d.solar?daylight:1);
        STOCK[r]=(STOCK[r]||0)+made;
        FLOW[r]+=d.makes[r]*o*run*(d.solar?daylight:1);
      }
    }
    // dim the 3D model's lit windows / signage when the building isn't working
    markBuildingActive(b, !b.unpowered && run>0.3);
    // ⚡/⏳ badge for both the top-down symbol and the 3D floating marker
    const badge = b.unpowered ? '⚡' : (b.noTrees ? '🌲' : (run<0.35 && bldDef(b.key).makes ? '⏳' : ''));
    if(typeof setSymbolBadge==='function') setSymbolBadge(b, badge);
    updateStatusMarker(b, flatViewActive ? '' : badge);
  }

  // ---- FOOD: your population must be fed ----
  // each citizen eats food per second; if short, people leave and are unhappy
  const foodDemand = cityPop * FOOD_PER_CITIZEN * dt;
  const foodHave = STOCK.food||0;
  const foodCover = foodDemand>0 ? Math.min(1, foodHave/foodDemand) : 1;
  STOCK.food = Math.max(0, foodHave - Math.min(foodHave, foodDemand));
  FLOW.food -= cityPop * FOOD_PER_CITIZEN;
  starving = foodCover < 0.85;

  // Rolled grass keeps livestock going, so the city works through it steadily.
  // It is not survival food — having it lifts spirits, running out just costs
  // you that bonus rather than starving anyone.
  const baleDemand = cityPop * 0.0016 * dt;
  const baleHave = STOCK.rolledgrass||0;
  baleCover = baleDemand>0 ? Math.min(1, baleHave/baleDemand) : 1;
  if(baleDemand>0){
    STOCK.rolledgrass = Math.max(0, baleHave - Math.min(baleHave, baleDemand));
    FLOW.rolledgrass = (FLOW.rolledgrass||0) - cityPop*0.0016;
  }

  // ---- TAX: your citizens pay tax each second, scaled by happiness ----
  // (unhappy cities pay less; this is your main passive income as you grow)
  // educated, well-served cities pay noticeably more tax
  const govTax = (window.__DOM_GOV_TAX!==undefined? window.__DOM_GOV_TAX : 0.10);
  const govMul = window.__DOM_GOV_MUL || {};
  const taxPerCitizen = 0.042 * (govTax/0.10)
    * (1 + cityCover.education*0.55 + cityServices*0.25);
  const taxIncome = cityPop * taxPerCitizen * (0.4 + 0.6*(cityHappy/100));
  STOCK.credits += taxIncome*dt;
  FLOW.credits = (FLOW.credits||0) + taxIncome;
  lastTax = taxIncome;

  // builders from construction buildings speed up every active build site
  cityBuilders = builders;
  window.cityBuilders = builders;

  // population grows toward capacity only if fed & housed & powered
  // districts with no services barely attract anyone
  const growth = (foodCover>0.95 ? 1 : (foodCover>0.6?0.2:-0.6)) * (0.35 + svcAvg*0.65);
  cityPop += (popCap-cityPop)*0.05*dt*Math.max(0,growth)
             + (growth<0 ? growth*cityPop*0.04*dt : 0);   // people leave when starved
  cityPop = Math.max(0, cityPop);

  // pollution & happiness
  let cleanPow=0;
  const _polMul=(window.__DOM_GOV_MUL&&window.__DOM_GOV_MUL.pollution)||1;
  for(const b of buildings){ const d=bldDef(b.key); if(d.cleans) cleanPow+=d.cleans*lvlOut(b.lvl)*(b.eff||1); }
  const parks = buildings.filter(b=>b.key==='park'||b.key==='plazaSmall').length + cleanPow*0.4;
  pollution += (dirty*0.02 - parks*0.05 - 0.01)*dt;
  pollution = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,pollution));
  let hT = 62 + happyBonus + baleCover*5 + svcAvg*26 - pollution*0.35 + (powered?4:-14)
           + (foodCover>0.95?5 : foodCover>0.6?-6 : -20);
  cityHappy += (hT-cityHappy)*0.06*dt;
  cityHappy = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,cityHappy));

  if(typeof citizenTick==='function') citizenTick(dt);
  if(typeof terraTick==='function') terraTick(dt);
  if(typeof forestTick==='function') forestTick(dt);
  checkCityHealth(dt);
  updateHUD();
  if(resOpen) renderResourceDropdown();
  if(selectedBuilding) refreshInspector();
}
const FOOD_PER_CITIZEN = 0.0026;      // food eaten per citizen per second
let starving=false, baleCover=1, lastPowerGen=0, lastPowerUse=0, lastTax=0, cityBuilders=1;
let cityCover={health:0,fire:0,safety:0,education:0,transit:0}, cityServices=0;
window.cityBuilders=1;

/* Watch for common problems and surface a helpful guide (throttled so it
   doesn't nag — each distinct warning only re-appears every ~30s). */
let _warnAcc=0; const _warnSeen={};
function checkCityHealth(dt){
  _warnAcc+=dt; if(_warnAcc<3) return; _warnAcc=0;
  const now=Date.now();
  const fire=(id,info)=>{ if(now-(_warnSeen[id]||0) < 30000) return false;
    _warnSeen[id]=now; guide(info); return true; };

  if(lastPowerUse > lastPowerGen+0.5){
    if(fire('power',{t:'Power shortage',d:'Your buildings need more electricity than you generate. Build a <b>power plant</b> (Power category) — a <b>🎡 Water Mill</b> beside a river is cheap and clean, or a <b>Coal/Gas plant</b> for more output.'})) return;
  }
  if(starving && cityPop>1){
    if(fire('food',{t:'Food shortage',d:'Citizens are leaving because there is not enough food. Build a <b>🌾 Farm</b> (Extraction) and a <b>🍞 Food Mill</b> (Industry) to turn wheat into food.'})) return;
  }
  const hasHousing = buildings.some(b=>bldDef(b.key).pop);
  if(!hasHousing && buildings.length>2){
    if(fire('housing',{t:'No housing',d:'You have no homes, so no citizens. Build <b>🏠 Suburban Homes</b> (Housing) to attract people who will work and pay taxes.'})) return;
  }
  const dryYard=buildings.find(b=>b.noTrees);
  if(dryYard){
    if(fire('trees',{t:'A lumber yard has no forest left',d:'It has felled everything within reach. Move it, or wait — saplings keep seeding around your city. Check the yard to see how many trees are still in range.'})) return;
  }
  if(cityServices<0.3 && cityPop>60){
    if(fire('services',{t:'Your districts have no services',d:'Housing needs a <b>⚕ Clinic</b>, <b>🚒 Fire Station</b>, <b>🚓 Police Post</b> and <b>🏫 School</b> within range. Uncovered districts are unhappy and stop growing — build services near your housing, not in one corner.'})) return;
  }
  if(cityHappy<35 && cityPop>10){
    if(fire('happy',{t:'Unhappy city',d:'Happiness is low, which cuts your tax income. Add a <b>🌳 Park</b> or <b>⛲ Plaza</b>, keep food and power steady, and avoid too much pollution.'})) return;
  }
  // fun: celebrate population milestones
  checkMilestones();
}
const MILESTONES=[100,500,1000,5000,10000,50000];
let _msIdx=0;
function checkMilestones(){
  while(_msIdx<MILESTONES.length && cityPop>=MILESTONES[_msIdx]){
    const m=MILESTONES[_msIdx]; _msIdx++;
    flash(`🎉 Milestone! Your city passed <b>${m.toLocaleString()}</b> citizens!`);
    STOCK.credits += m;                          // bonus grant
    if(typeof celebrate==='function') celebrate();
  }
}

/* visually mark a 3D building as inactive (dim its lit windows / signage) */
function markBuildingActive(b, active){
  if(b._active!==active){
    b._active=active;
    b.mesh.traverse(o=>{
      if(o.isMesh && o.userData.window && o.material){
        o.material.emissiveIntensity = active ? (isNight? (o.userData.lit?0.95:0.12):0.02) : 0.0;
      }
    });
    if(b.mesh.userData.pulse) b.mesh.userData.pulse.visible=active;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   PONDER — a visual "how do I make this?" recipe diagram, like
   Create mod's ponder. Traces the supply chain back to raw inputs.
   ============================================================ */
function producersOf(res){          // buildings that output this resource
  return Object.keys(CITY).filter(k=>CITY[k].makes && CITY[k].makes[res]!==undefined);
}
function openPonder(res){
  const modal=$('ponder'), body=$('ponderBody'), title=$('ponderTitle');
  if(!modal) return;
  const R=RESOURCES[res];
  title.innerHTML=`${R.ic} How to make <b>${R.nm}</b>`;
  body.innerHTML=renderPonderTree(res, new Set(), 0);
  modal.classList.add('show');
}
function closePonder(){ const m=$('ponder'); if(m) m.classList.remove('show'); }
/* Render the recipe as a tree:  input + input  →in→  BUILDING  →=→  output + output
   Every input that is itself crafted is expanded above it, so you can read the
   whole chain from raw materials up to the thing you asked about. */
function ponderChip(res, cls, note){
  const R=RESOURCES[res]; if(!R) return '';
  return `<div class="pchip ${cls||''}" style="border-color:${R.col}">
    <span class="pci">${R.ic}</span><span>${R.nm}</span>
    ${note?`<span class="psrc">${note}</span>`:''}</div>`;
}
function renderPonderTree(res, seen, depth){
  const R=RESOURCES[res]; if(!R) return '';
  if(seen.has(res) || depth>5)
    return ponderChip(res,'loop','already shown above');
  seen=new Set(seen); seen.add(res);

  const prods=producersOf(res);
  if(!prods.length){
    const raw = R.grp==='Raw';
    return ponderChip(res,'raw', raw?'mined / gathered':'starting resource');
  }

  const bk=prods[0], d=CITY[bk];
  const inputs=Object.keys(d.needs||{}).filter(r=>r!=='power' && RESOURCES[r]);
  const needsPower=(d.needs&&d.needs.power)||d.powerUse;
  // every product this building makes — the co-products are the point of the tree
  const outputs=Object.keys(d.makes||{}).filter(r=>RESOURCES[r]);

  // ---- the inputs row, each expanded into its own sub-tree ----
  let ins='';
  if(inputs.length || needsPower){
    const cells=[];
    if(needsPower) cells.push(`<div class="pcell"><div class="pchip pw" style="border-color:#ffd75e">
      <span class="pci">⚡</span><span>Electricity</span><span class="psrc">from a power plant</span></div></div>`);
    for(const r of inputs){
      cells.push(`<div class="pcell">
        <div class="psub">${renderPonderTree(r, seen, depth+1)}</div>
        <div class="pamt">${(d.needs[r]).toFixed(2)}/s</div>
      </div>`);
    }
    ins=`<div class="prow">${cells.join('<div class="pplus">+</div>')}</div>`;
  } else {
    ins=`<div class="prow"><div class="pcell"><div class="pchip raw">
      <span class="pci">✦</span><span>no inputs</span></div></div></div>`;
  }

  // ---- the outputs row: what you asked for, plus anything else it makes ----
  const outCells=outputs.map(r=>{
    const amt=d.makes[r];
    return `<div class="pcell">${ponderChip(r, r===res?'out target':'out')}
      <div class="pamt">${typeof amt==='number'?('+'+amt.toFixed(2)+'/s'):''}</div></div>`;
  });
  if(!outCells.length) outCells.push(`<div class="pcell">${ponderChip(res,'out target')}</div>`);

  const alt = prods.length>1
    ? `<span class="palt">also made in ${prods.length-1} other building${prods.length>2?'s':''}</span>` : '';

  return `<div class="pstep">
    ${ins}
    <div class="pconn"><span class="pline"></span><span class="plbl">in the</span><span class="pline"></span></div>
    <div class="pbuild">${d.ic||'▣'} <b>${d.nm}</b>${alt}</div>
    <div class="pconn"><span class="pline"></span><span class="plbl eq">=</span><span class="pline"></span></div>
    <div class="prow">${outCells.join('<div class="pplus">+</div>')}</div>
  </div>`;
}
function initResourceUI(){
  const btn=$('resBtn'), panel=$('resPanel'), wrap=$('resWrap');
  let closeT=null;
  const open=()=>{ if(closeT){clearTimeout(closeT);closeT=null;} resOpen=true;
    panel.classList.add('show'); renderResourceDropdown(); };

let pendingLine=null;   // {kind:'road'|'trap', key, path, ghosts:[]}
/* traps can go anywhere you can currently SEE (not under fog) and on the map,
   dry ground — no need to own the territory */
function canPlaceInFog(gx,gz){
  if(Math.abs(gx*TILE-START.x)>HALF-4 || Math.abs(gz*TILE-START.z)>HALF-4) return false;
  if(typeof fogVisible!=='undefined' && fogVisible){
    const src = (typeof collectSightSources==='function') ? collectSightSources() : null;
    if(typeof inSight==='function' && !inSight(gx*TILE,gz*TILE,src)) return false;   // hidden by fog
  }
  return true;
}
function commitBarrierLine(path, direct){
  if(!barrierMode || !path.length) return;
  // filter to placeable tiles and preview them, then ask to confirm
  const good=path.filter(p=>!(occupied[p.gx+','+p.gz] ||
    (typeof slotUnderwater==='function'&&slotUnderwater(p.gx,p.gz)) || !canPlaceInFog(p.gx,p.gz)));
  if(!good.length){ guide({t:'Cannot place there',d:'Traps must sit on dry, unoccupied ground you can see (not under fog). Scout the area or extend your reach first.'}); return; }
  if(direct){
    // place the straight run immediately
    const d=CITY[barrierMode], cost=d.cost||{};
    let placed=0;
    for(const p of good){
      if(!canAfford(cost)) break;
      payCost(cost);
      placeCityBuilding(barrierMode, p.gx, p.gz, 1, {animate:false});
      placed++;
    }
    if(placed) flash(`Placed <b>${placed}</b> ${d.nm}${placed>1?'s':''}`);
    return;
  }
  startPendingLine('trap', barrierMode, good);
}
/* Tidy a hand-drawn road: strip duplicate tiles and shave single-tile
   zig-zags so a wobbly drag becomes a clean run of straights and corners. */
function smoothRoadPath(path){
  var out=[], seen={};
  for(var i=0;i<path.length;i++){
    var k=path[i].gx+','+path[i].gz;
    if(seen[k]) continue; seen[k]=1; out.push(path[i]);
  }
  // destroy a tile that only creates a one-step jog between two aligned tiles
  for(var pass=0;pass<2;pass++){
    for(var j=1;j<out.length-1;j++){
      var a=out[j-1], b=out[j], c=out[j+1];
      var straight=(a.gx===c.gx)||(a.gz===c.gz);
      var detour=(a.gx!==b.gx&&a.gz!==b.gz)||(c.gx!==b.gx&&c.gz!==b.gz);
      if(straight && detour && Math.abs(a.gx-c.gx)+Math.abs(a.gz-c.gz)<=2){ out.splice(j,1); j--; }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function commitRoadPath(path, stroke){
  if(!path.length) return;
  _pendingStroke = stroke || null;
  // A freehand road is committed as one continuous piece. It never goes through
  // the tile-by-tile ghost preview, which is what used to look like square tiles.
  if(_pendingStroke && _pendingStroke.length>1){
    layDrawnRoad(path, _pendingStroke);
    _pendingStroke=null;
    return;
  }
  path = smoothRoadPath(path);
  const good=path.filter(p=>canPlaceRoad(p.gx,p.gz));
  if(!good.length){ guide({t:'Cannot place road here',d:'Roads cannot go on water, on other buildings, or off the map edge. Try a clear, dry path.'}); return; }
  startPendingLine('road', 'road', good);
}
/* show translucent ghosts for a whole line and a Confirm/Cancel bar */
function startPendingLine(kind, key, path){
  cancelPendingLine();
  const ghosts=[];
  for(const p of path){
    const gh=makeCityBuilding(key,1,7);
    seatOnGround(gh, p.gx*TILE, p.gz*TILE);
    gh.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh&&o.material){ o.material=o.material.clone();
      o.material.transparent=true; o.material.opacity=0.5; o.material.depthWrite=false; } });
    scene.add(gh); ghosts.push(gh);
  }
  pendingLine={kind, key, path, ghosts};
  const d=CITY[key];
  const bar=$('confirmBar');
  if(bar){ $('confirmLabel').innerHTML=`Place <b>${path.length}× ${d.nm}</b>?`; bar.classList.add('show'); }
  flash('Tap <b>Confirm</b> to place the row, or Cancel.');
}
function cancelPendingLine(){
  if(pendingLine){ for(const g of pendingLine.ghosts){ scene.remove(g);
    g.traverse(o=>{ if(o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); }); } pendingLine=null; }
  const bar=$('confirmBar'); if(bar && !pendingBuild) bar.classList.remove('show');
}
function confirmPendingLine(){
  if(!pendingLine) return;
  const {kind,key,path}=pendingLine;
  const d=CITY[key], cost=d.cost||{};
  let placed=0, blocked=0;
  for(const p of path){
    const bad = kind==='road' ? !canPlaceRoad(p.gx,p.gz)
      : (occupied[p.gx+','+p.gz] || (typeof slotUnderwater==='function'&&slotUnderwater(p.gx,p.gz)) || !canPlaceInFog(p.gx,p.gz));
    if(bad){ blocked++; continue; }
    if(!canAfford(cost)){ guide({t:'Out of materials',d:`Each ${d.nm} costs ${costText(cost)}. Build up your economy and try again.`}); break; }
    payCost(cost);
    placeCityBuilding(key, p.gx, p.gz, 1, {animate:false});
    placed++;
  }
  cancelPendingLine();
  if(kind==='road'){
    // mark the tiles as ribbon-covered BEFORE re-meshing so they never flash
    if(_pendingStroke && _pendingStroke.length>1 && window.__DOM_RIBBON){
      for(const p of path) window.__DOM_RIBBON.covered[p.gx+','+p.gz]=true;
    }
    gradeRoadPath(path);
    refreshRoadNetwork();
    // a pen stroke also gets a continuous shaped surface laid over the tiles
    if(_pendingStroke && _pendingStroke.length>1 && window.__DOM_RIBBON){
      try{ window.__DOM_RIBBON.layStroke(_pendingStroke, path); }catch(e){}
    }
    _pendingStroke=null;
  }
  if(placed) flash(`Placed <b>${placed}</b> ${d.nm}${placed>1?'s':''}${blocked?` (${blocked} skipped)`:''}`);
}
/* Ease the terrain under a road run so the deck runs smoothly instead of
   stepping. Each tile is pulled toward the average of its road neighbours. */
function gradeRoadPath(path){
  if(!path||!path.length) return;
  const key=p=>p.gx+','+p.gz;
  const set={}; for(const p of path) set[key(p)]=true;
  for(let pass=0;pass<3;pass++){
    const next={};
    for(const p of path){
      const hs=[terrainHeightAt(p.gx*TILE,p.gz*TILE)];
      const nb=[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];
      for(const [dx,dz] of nb){
        const k=(p.gx+dx)+','+(p.gz+dz);
        if(set[k]||isRoad(p.gx+dx,p.gz+dz)) hs.push(terrainHeightAt((p.gx+dx)*TILE,(p.gz+dz)*TILE));
      }
      let s=0; for(const v of hs) s+=v;
      next[key(p)] = s/hs.length;
    }
    for(const p of path){
      const nat=baseHeight(p.gx*TILE,p.gz*TILE);
      const cur=terrainHeightAt(p.gx*TILE,p.gz*TILE);
      const tgt=cur+(next[key(p)]-cur)*0.8;
      HMOD[key(p)] = tgt-nat;
    }
  }
  reshapeTerrain();
}
/* Is this tile hidden beneath a drawn ribbon? */
function ribbonCovers(gx,gz){
  try{ return !!(window.__DOM_RIBBON && window.__DOM_RIBBON.covered[gx+','+gz]); }catch(e){ return false; }
}
/* Lay a drawn road: reserve the tiles for the traffic network (invisible),
   then sweep the visible ribbon along the stroke at the chosen altitude. */
function layDrawnRoad(path, stroke){
  const road=CITY.road, cost=road.cost||{};
  const A=window.__DOM_ALT;
  const altY = (A && A.level!==0) ? A.targetY() : null;
  let laid=0, blocked=0;
  for(const p of path){
    if(window.__DOM_RIBBON) window.__DOM_RIBBON.covered[p.gx+','+p.gz]=true;
    if(!canPlaceRoad(p.gx,p.gz,altY)){ blocked++; continue; }
    if(!canAfford(cost)){ guide({t:'Out of materials',d:`Each stretch of road costs ${costText(cost)}.`}); break; }
    payCost(cost);
    const b=placeCityBuilding('road',p.gx,p.gz,1,{animate:false, elevated:altY});
    if(b){ b.altY=altY; if(b.mesh) b.mesh.visible=false; }   // the ribbon is the road you see
    laid++;
  }
  if(laid){
    gradeRoadPath(altY===null? path : []);      // only reshape ground for surface roads
    refreshRoadNetwork();
    if(window.__DOM_RIBBON) window.__DOM_RIBBON.layStroke(stroke, path, altY);
    flash(`Road laid${blocked?` (${blocked} sections skipped)`:''}`);
  } else if(blocked) guide({t:'Cannot lay road there',d:'Roads need clear, dry ground — or enough height to cross over an existing road.'});
}
/* is there a road at this tile? */
function isRoad(gx,gz){ const b=occupied[gx+','+gz]; return !!(b && (b.key==='road'||b.key==='roundabout')); }
/* recompute the shape of every road so straights/corners/junctions line up */
function refreshRoadNetwork(){
  for(const b of buildings){
    if(b.key!=='road') continue;   // roundabouts keep their own shape
    const mask=(isRoad(b.gx,b.gz-1)?1:0)|(isRoad(b.gx+1,b.gz)?2:0)|
               (isRoad(b.gx,b.gz+1)?4:0)|(isRoad(b.gx-1,b.gz)?8:0);
    if(b.mesh.userData.roadMask===mask && Math.abs((b.mesh.userData.wear||0)-(b.wear||0))<0.12) continue;
    scene.remove(b.mesh);
    b.mesh.traverse(o=>{ if(o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); });
    b.mesh=makeCityBuilding('road',1,1,{mask:mask, wx:b.gx*TILE, wz:b.gz*TILE, wear:(b.wear||0)});
    b.mesh.rotation.y=0;                              // roads never randomly rotate
    b.mesh.position.set(b.gx*TILE, groundHeight(b.gx*TILE,b.gz*TILE), b.gz*TILE);
    b.mesh.userData.roadMask=mask;
    if(ribbonCovers(b.gx,b.gz)){ b.mesh.visible=false; b.mesh.userData.ribbonHidden=true; }
    else scene.add(b.mesh);
    if(flatViewActive) b.mesh.visible=false;
  }
}
/* commit a terraform action over a dragged rectangle — now takes TIME.
   The job is validated & paid up front, then applied when the timer completes. */
let terraJob=null;   // {type,area,secs,elapsed,label}
function commitTerra(a,b){
  if(terraJob){ flash('Earthworks already in progress…'); return; }
  const gx0=Math.min(a.gx,b.gx), gx1=Math.max(a.gx,b.gx);
  const gz0=Math.min(a.gz,b.gz), gz1=Math.max(a.gz,b.gz);
  const tiles=(gx1-gx0+1)*(gz1-gz0+1);

  if(terraTool==='flatten'){
    const tgt=areaTargetHeight(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1);
    let moved=0;
    for(let gx=gx0;gx<=gx1;gx++)for(let gz=gz0;gz<=gz1;gz++)
      moved+=Math.abs(terrainHeightAt(gx*TILE,gz*TILE)-tgt);
    const cost={credits:Math.ceil(moved*6+tiles*4), fuel:Math.ceil(moved*0.5)};
    if(!canAfford(cost)){ flash(`Not enough for earthworks — needs ${costText(cost)}`); return; }
    payCost(cost);
    startTerraJob('flatten', {gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1,tgt}, 0.8+moved*0.25+tiles*0.15, `Levelling ${tiles} plots`);
  } else if(terraTool==='dig'){
    const cost={credits:Math.ceil(tiles*5)};
    if(!canAfford(cost)){ flash(`Not enough — needs ${costText(cost)}`); return; }
    payCost(cost);
    startTerraJob('dig', {gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1}, 0.8+tiles*0.35, `Excavating ${tiles} plots`);
  } else if(terraTool==='fill'){
    const need=fillArea(gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1);
    if(DIRT<need){ flash(`Need ${Math.ceil(need)} dirt to fill — you have ${Math.round(DIRT)}. Dig elsewhere first.`); return; }
    DIRT-=need;
    const cost={credits:Math.ceil(tiles*4)}; if(canAfford(cost)) payCost(cost);
    startTerraJob('fill', {gx0,gz0,gx1,gz1}, 0.8+tiles*0.3, `Filling ${tiles} plots`);
  } else if(terraTool==='river'){
    const cost={credits:Math.ceil(tiles*3+40), fuel:Math.ceil(tiles*0.4)};
    if(!canAfford(cost)){ flash(`Not enough — needs ${costText(cost)}`); return; }
    payCost(cost);
    startTerraJob('river', {ax:a.gx,az:a.gz,bx:b.gx,bz:b.gz}, 1.0+tiles*0.25, `Carving a river`);
  }
}
function startTerraJob(type, area, secs, label){
  terraJob={type, area, secs:Math.max(0.6,secs), elapsed:0, label};
  const bar=$('terraBar'); if(bar) bar.classList.add('show');
  flash(`${label}…`);
  updateTerraReadout();
}
/* called each economy tick — advances the current earthworks job */
function terraTick(dt){
  if(!terraJob) return;
  terraJob.elapsed += dt;
  const p=Math.min(1, terraJob.elapsed/terraJob.secs);
  const bar=$('terraProg'); if(bar){ bar.style.width=(p*100)+'%'; }
  if(p>=1){
    const {type,area:A}=terraJob;
    if(type==='flatten') flattenArea(A.gx0,A.gz0,A.gx1,A.gz1,A.tgt);
    else if(type==='dig'){ const d=digArea(A.gx0,A.gz0,A.gx1,A.gz1); DIRT+=d; }
    else if(type==='fill') commitFill(A.gx0,A.gz0,A.gx1,A.gz1);
    else if(type==='river'){
      // follow the whole drawn stroke instead of a single straight segment
      const pts=(riverPath && riverPath.length>1) ? riverPath.slice()
              : [{gx:A.ax,gz:A.az},{gx:A.bx,gz:A.bz}];
      carveRiver(pts, A.width||1);
      riverPath=null;
    }
    flash(`${terraJob.label} — done`);
    terraJob=null;
    updateTerraReadout(); updateHUD();
    const bar2=$('terraProg'); if(bar2) bar2.style.width='0%';
    const bw=$('terraBar'); if(bw) bw.classList.remove('show');
  }
}

function doBuild(key){
  if(!buildSlot) return;
  const d=bldDef(key), cost=d.cost||{credits:200};
  if(!canAfford(cost)){ flash('Not enough resources.'); return; }
  const {gx,gz}=buildSlot;
  // hydro power must sit next to water (a river or lake edge)
  if(d.hydro && !nearWater(gx,gz)){
    guide({t:'Water power needs water',d:'A water mill or dam must sit <b>right beside a river or lake</b>. Use the <b>🌊 River</b> terraform tool to carve a channel next to this spot, then build here — the mill will turn to face the water automatically.'});
    return;
  }
  // a Town Hall may be founded anywhere you can actually see (outside the fog)
  const outpost = (key==='townhall');
  if(outpost){
    if(typeof canPlaceInFog==='function' && !canPlaceInFog(gx,gz)){
      guide({t:'You cannot see that ground',d:'A <b>Town Hall</b> can be founded anywhere outside the fog — scout the area with a unit first, then place it there to claim a new region.'});
      return;
    }
    window.__DOM_ANYWHERE = true;      // bypass the territory rule for this check only
  }
  const cells=footprintCells(gx,gz,d.foot||1);
  const _px=(buildSlot.world?buildSlot.world.x:gx*TILE), _pz=(buildSlot.world?buildSlot.world.z:gz*TILE);
  if(d.road){ for(const c of cells) if(occupied[c.gx+','+c.gz]){ window.__DOM_ANYWHERE=false; flash('Not enough room here.'); return; } }
  else { const _hit=buildingOverlaps(_px,_pz,buildRadius(key),null,key);
    if(_hit){ window.__DOM_ANYWHERE=false; flash('Too close to <b>'+(bldDef(_hit.key).nm||'another building')+'</b>.'); return; } }
  const _clear = !cells.some(c=>!slotBuildable(c.gx,c.gz));
  window.__DOM_ANYWHERE=false;
  if(!_clear){
    guide({t:'Footprint not fully clear',d:'This is a larger building — <b>every tile</b> it covers must be flat and inside your borders. Flatten the whole area (or extend a road to it) first.'});
    return;
  }
  // steep ground is allowed — it just needs paid-for foundations
  const fc=foundationCost(gx,gz,d.foot||1);
  const total=Object.assign({},cost);
  if(fc.sev>0){
    total.credits=(total.credits||0)+fc.credits;
    total.concrete=(total.concrete||0)+fc.concrete;
    if(DIRT < fc.dirt){
      guide({t:'Not enough fill for the foundations',d:`Building on this slope needs <b>${fc.dirt} dirt</b> for footings — you have ${Math.round(DIRT)}. Dig somewhere flat, or build a <b>🚜 Dirt Extractor</b>.`});
      return;
    }
    if(!canAfford(total)){ guide({t:'Steep ground costs more',d:`Founding here needs an extra ${costText({credits:fc.credits,concrete:fc.concrete})} and ${fc.dirt} dirt for supports.`}); return; }
  }
  startPendingBuild(key, gx, gz, total, fc);
}

/* Placement is free-form: every building carries a footprint radius and can
   stand anywhere its hitbox clears the others. Roads stay gridded because the
   road network is built from tiles. */
/* ============================================================
   BUILD ALTITUDE — everything you place is built at this height,
   measured relative to the City Hall's ground level. Raised plots get
   a supporting structure; sunken ones get a hole dug for them.
   ============================================================ */
window.__DOM_ALT = {
  level:0,
  set:function(v){ this.level=Math.max(-12,Math.min(24,Math.round(v*2)/2));
    try{ flash('Build altitude <b>'+(this.level>0?'+':'')+this.level.toFixed(1)+'</b> relative to the town hall'); }catch(e){} },
  baseY:function(){
    try{
      for(const b of buildings){
        const d=bldDef(b.key);
        if(d.core) return groundHeight(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*TILE, b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*TILE);
      }
      return groundHeight(START.x,START.z);
    }catch(e){ return 0; }
  },
  targetY:function(){ return this.baseY()+this.level; }
