  }

  /* ---------- a handful of visible cars, sampled from real trips ---------- */
  var CAR_CAP=42;
  function tickVehicles(dt){
    var g=R(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE||!M.graph) return;
    var peak=commutePeak();
    var want=Math.round(CAR_CAP*peak);
    // retire finished cars
    for(var i=M.vehicles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var v=M.vehicles[i];
      v.t += v.spd*dt;
      if(v.t>=1 || !v.path.length){ try{ g.scene.remove(v.mesh); }catch(e){} M.vehicles.splice(i,1); continue; }
      var idx=Math.min(v.path.length-1, Math.floor(v.t*(v.path.length-1)));
      var n=M.graph[v.path[idx]]; if(!n) continue;
      // drive on the right-hand side of the road rather than down the middle
      var nxt=M.graph[v.path[Math.min(v.path.length-1, idx+1)]] || n;
      var hx=nxt.gx-n.gx, hz=nxt.gz-n.gz;
      var hl=Math.hypot(hx,hz)||1; hx/=hl; hz/=hl;
      var lane=v.lane||0.45;
      var nx=n.gx*g.TILE + (-hz)*lane, nz=n.gz*g.TILE + (hx)*lane;
      // hold at a red signal
      var axis=(Math.abs(hx)>Math.abs(hz))? 'ew' : 'ns';
      if(M.isJunction(n.gx,n.gz) && axis!==lightPhase()){
        v.wait=(v.wait||0)+dt;
        if(v.wait<3.5){ v.spd=0; }
      } else { v.wait=0; }
      v.mesh.position.x += (nx-v.mesh.position.x)*Math.min(1,dt*4);
      v.mesh.position.z += (nz-v.mesh.position.z)*Math.min(1,dt*4);
      v.mesh.position.y = (g.groundHeight(v.mesh.position.x,v.mesh.position.z)||0)+0.25;
      // slow down where the road is busy — visible congestion
      var cong=n.ema/Math.max(1,n.cap);
      if(!v.wait) v.spd = v.base*(1-Math.min(0.8,Math.max(0,cong-0.4)));
    }
    while(M.vehicles.length<want && M.cohorts.length){
      var co=M.cohorts[Math.floor(Math.random()*M.cohorts.length)];
      if(!co.work) break;
      var trip=tripCost(wx(co.home),wz(co.home),co.work.x,co.work.z);
      if(!trip.path||trip.path.length<2) break;
      if(!M.carGeo){
        // three kinds of road user, each behaving differently
        M.VEHICLES={
          car:  {geo:new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(0.8,0.55,1.7),  spd:1.0,  w:0.45, share:0.72,
                 cols:[0x3d6f9e,0xb0453a,0xd9c34a,0xe8e4d8,0x4a7a52]},
          bus:  {geo:new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(1.0,0.95,3.6),  spd:0.72, w:0.5,  share:0.12,
                 cols:[0x2f9e63,0x3d8fe0]},
          truck:{geo:new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(1.0,0.9,3.0),   spd:0.62, w:0.5,  share:0.16,
                 cols:[0x8a8f96,0xc9922b,0x6a5b8a]}
        };
        M.carGeo=M.VEHICLES.car.geo;
        M.carMats=M.VEHICLES.car.cols.map(function(c){
          return new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,metalness:0.35,roughness:0.5}); });
      }
      // pick a type by share
      var roll=Math.random(), kind='car', acc=0;
      for(var vk in M.VEHICLES){ acc+=M.VEHICLES[vk].share; if(roll<=acc){ kind=vk; break; } }
      var VT=M.VEHICLES[kind];
      var mesh=new g.THREE.Mesh(VT.geo, new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color:VT.cols[(Math.random()*VT.cols.length)|0], metalness:0.35, roughness:0.5}));
      mesh.castShadow=true;
      var s=M.graph[trip.path[0]];
      mesh.position.set(s.gx*g.TILE,(g.groundHeight(s.gx*g.TILE,s.gz*g.TILE)||0)+0.25,s.gz*g.TILE);
      g.scene.add(mesh);
      var base=0.12+Math.random()*0.1;
      M.vehicles.push({mesh:mesh,path:trip.path,t:0,spd:base*VT.spd,base:base*VT.spd,kind:kind,lane:VT.w,wait:0});
    }
    while(M.vehicles.length>want){
      var v2=M.vehicles.pop(); try{ g.scene.remove(v2.mesh); }catch(e){}
    }
  }

  /* ================= EVENTS ================= */
  /* Each event has a trigger read from real city state, and consequences that
     push the simulation — they are not popups bolted on the side. */
  var EVENTS = [
    { id:'housing', nm:'Housing shortage', ic:'🏚',
      test:function(s){ return s.vacancy<=0 && s.pop>40; },
      msg:'Every home is full. Rents are climbing and poorer households are being squeezed out.',
      apply:function(s){ M.rentPressure=Math.min(3,(M.rentPressure||1)+0.35); } },
    { id:'unemp', nm:'Unemployment spike', ic:'📉',
      test:function(s){ return s.unemployment>0.28 && s.workforce>20; },
      msg:'Too few jobs for the people you have. Households are drifting away to find work.',
      apply:function(s){ M.leavePressure=(M.leavePressure||0)+0.4; } },
    { id:'boom', nm:'Business boom', ic:'📈',
      test:function(s){ return s.unemployment<0.05 && s.jobsFree>25 && s.satisfaction>62; },
      msg:'Word is spreading that there is work here. New residents are arriving.',
      apply:function(s){ M.attract=(M.attract||0)+0.5; } },
    { id:'traffic', nm:'Traffic crisis', ic:'🚦',
      test:function(s){ return s.congestion>0.72 && s.roads>18; },
      msg:'The road network is gridlocked at peak hours. Commutes are painful and satisfaction is falling.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+6; } },
    { id:'power', nm:'Power shortage', ic:'⚡',
      test:function(s){ return s.powerDeficit>0.5; },
      msg:'Demand has outrun generation. Buildings are dropping offline across the city.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+4; } },
    { id:'water', nm:'Water shortage', ic:'💧',
      test:function(s){ return (s.stock.water||0)<2 && s.pop>60; },
      msg:'Reservoirs are nearly dry. Households and industry are both rationing.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+5; } },
    { id:'pollute', nm:'Pollution crisis', ic:'🏭',
      test:function(s){ return s.pollution>62; },
      msg:'Air quality has collapsed. Illness is rising and people want out.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+7; M.leavePressure=(M.leavePressure||0)+0.2; } },
    { id:'disease', nm:'Disease outbreak', ic:'🦠',
      test:function(s){ return s.health<0.25 && s.pop>90; },
      msg:'With almost no healthcare cover, an outbreak is spreading through crowded districts.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+9; M.leavePressure=(M.leavePressure||0)+0.35; } },
    { id:'fire', nm:'Fire', ic:'🔥',
      test:function(s){ return s.fire<0.2 && s.pop>70 && Math.random()<0.35; },
      msg:'A fire broke out in an unprotected district. With no fire cover it burned unchecked.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+5; } },
    { id:'recession', nm:'Economic recession', ic:'💸',
      test:function(s){ return s.credits<400 && s.pop>60; },
      msg:'The treasury is empty. Services are stretched and confidence is draining.',
      apply:function(s){ M.satPenalty=(M.satPenalty||0)+4; } },
    { id:'popboom', nm:'Population boom', ic:'👥',
      test:function(s){ return s.satisfaction>76 && s.vacancy>25; },
      msg:'High satisfaction and spare housing are pulling families in fast.',
      apply:function(s){ M.attract=(M.attract||0)+0.8; } },
    { id:'decline', nm:'Population decline', ic:'📦',
      test:function(s){ return s.satisfaction<32 && s.pop>50; },
      msg:'Residents are packing up. The city is shrinking.',
      apply:function(s){ M.leavePressure=(M.leavePressure||0)+0.5; } }
  ];
  function checkEvents(s){
    var now=Date.now();
    for(var i=0;i<EVENTS.length;i++){
      var e=EVENTS[i];
      var on=false;
      try{ on=e.test(s); }catch(err){ on=false; }
      var st=M.events[e.id]||(M.events[e.id]={active:false,since:0,last:0});
      if(on && !st.active && now-st.last>45000){
        st.active=true; st.since=now; st.last=now;
        try{ e.apply(s); }catch(err){}
        pushLog(e, s);
      } else if(!on && st.active){
        st.active=false;
        M.log.unshift({ic:'✅',nm:e.nm+' resolved',msg:'Conditions have returned to normal.',t:now});
        if(M.log.length>40) M.log.pop();
      } else if(on && st.active){
        try{ e.apply(s); }catch(err){}
      }
    }
  }
  function pushLog(e, s){
    M.log.unshift({ic:e.ic, nm:e.nm, msg:e.msg, t:Date.now()});
    if(M.log.length>40) M.log.pop();
    try{ if(typeof guide==='function') guide({t:e.ic+' '+e.nm, d:e.msg}); }catch(err){}
  }

  /* ================= MAIN TICK ================= */
  var acc=0;
  function tick(dt){
    var g=R();
    if(!g.buildings) return;
    M.t+=dt;
    // rebuild the road graph only when the network actually changed
    var rc=0, bs=g.buildings;
    for(var i=0;i<bs.length;i++) if(bs[i].key==='road'||bs[i].key==='roundabout') rc++;
    if(rc!==M.roadCount) buildGraph();

    syncPopulation(dt);

    // ---- shared context, computed once per tick, not per cohort ----
    var js=jobSites(), sc=schools(), hs=homes();
    _smokeAt+=dt; if(_smokeAt>2 || !_smoke.length){ _smokeAt=0; refreshSmoke(); }
    var freeSlots={}, totalJobs=0;
    for(var j=0;j<js.length;j++){ freeSlots[key(js[j].b)]=js[j].slots; totalJobs+=js[j].slots; }
    var capacity=0;
    for(var h=0;h<hs.length;h++) capacity+=def(hs[h].key).pop*lvlO(hs[h].lvl);
    var residents=0; for(var c=0;c<M.cohorts.length;c++) residents+=M.cohorts[c].size;
    var cong=0, roadN=0;
    if(M.graph) for(var id in M.graph){ var n=M.graph[id]; cong+=n.ema/Math.max(1,n.cap); roadN++; }
    cong = roadN? cong/roadN : 0;
    var cover={health:0,fire:0,safety:0,education:0,transit:0}, svc=0;
    try{ cover=cityCover; svc=cityServices; }catch(e){}
    var ctx={
      jobs:js, schools:sc, freeSlots:freeSlots, stock:(g.STOCK||{}),
      services:svc, congestion:cong, vacancy:capacity-residents,
      leisure:(function(){ try{
        var l=0; for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++){ var d2=def(buildings[i].key);
          if(d2.happy) l+=d2.happy*lvlO(buildings[i].lvl); }
        return Math.min(1, l/Math.max(30, residents*0.5));
      }catch(e){ return 0; } })(),
      bales:(function(){ try{ return baleCover; }catch(e){ return 1; } })(),
      approval:(function(){ try{ return window.__DOM_GOV? window.__DOM_GOV.approval : 60; }catch(e){ return 60; } })(),
      rent: 30*(M.rentPressure||1),
      pollution:(function(){ try{ return pollution; }catch(e){ return 0; } })()
    };
    // ---- update a slice of cohorts, so cost stays flat with population ----
    var budget=Math.min(M.cohorts.length, 45);
    for(var b2=0;b2<budget;b2++){
      M.cursor=(M.cursor+1)%Math.max(1,M.cohorts.length);
      var co=M.cohorts[M.cursor];
      if(!co) continue;
      updateCohort(co, dt*(M.cohorts.length/Math.max(1,budget)), ctx);
      co.phase=phaseNow(co);
    }
    // ---- departures ----
    for(var d2=M.cohorts.length-1;d2>=0;d2--){
      if(M.cohorts[d2]._leave){
        M.cohorts.splice(d2,1);
        M.stats.movedOut=(M.stats.movedOut||0)+HOUSEHOLD;
        try{ cityPop=Math.max(0,cityPop-HOUSEHOLD); }catch(e){}
      }
    }
    applyTrafficLoad(dt);
    tickLights(dt);
    tickVehicles(dt);
    colourRoads();
    computeStats(ctx, totalJobs, capacity, residents, cong);
    checkEvents(M.stats);
    // ---- feed back into the game's own happiness ----
    try{
      if(M.stats.satisfaction!==undefined){
        var pen=(M.satPenalty||0);
        cityHappy += ((M.stats.satisfaction-pen) - cityHappy)*Math.min(1,dt*0.25);
        cityHappy = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,cityHappy));
      }
      // attractiveness pulls people in
      // people are not conjured into houses: a van drives in from the edge and
      // the population only rises when it actually reaches a home
      if(M.attract>0 && ctx.vacancy>0){
        M._inbound=(M._inbound||0)+M.attract*dt*2;
        while(M._inbound>=4){ M._inbound-=4;
          try{ if(window.__DOM_FX) window.__DOM_FX.arrive(4); }catch(e){} }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    M.satPenalty=Math.max(0,(M.satPenalty||0)-dt*1.2);
    M.attract=Math.max(0,(M.attract||0)-dt*0.25);
    M.leavePressure=Math.max(0,(M.leavePressure||0)-dt*0.15);
    M.rentPressure=Math.max(1,(M.rentPressure||1)-dt*0.02);
    M.ready=true;
  }

  function computeStats(ctx, totalJobs, capacity, residents, cong){
    var employed=0, workforce=0, satSum=0, incSum=0, commuteSum=0, commuteN=0;
    var ages={child:0,young:0,adult:0,senior:0};
    var bands={low:0,mid:0,high:0};
    for(var i=0;i<M.cohorts.length;i++){
      var c=M.cohorts[i];
      ages[c.age]+=c.size;
      satSum+=c.sat*c.size;
      if(c.age==='young'||c.age==='adult'){ workforce+=c.size; if(c.employed) employed+=c.size; }
      incSum+=c.income*c.size;
      if(c.income<0.7) bands.low+=c.size; else if(c.income<1.3) bands.mid+=c.size; else bands.high+=c.size;
      if(c.commute>0){ commuteSum+=c.commute; commuteN++; }
    }
    // roll every household's reasons into one picture of the city's mood
    var reasons={};
    for(var q=0;q<M.cohorts.length;q++){
      var w=M.cohorts[q].why; if(!w) continue;
      for(var k2 in w) reasons[k2]=(reasons[k2]||0)+w[k2]*M.cohorts[q].size;
    }
    M.reasons=reasons;
    var vol=0, worst=null, worstV=-1;
    if(M.graph) for(var id in M.graph){
      var n=M.graph[id]; vol+=n.ema;
      if(n.ema>worstV){ worstV=n.ema; worst=n; }
    }
    var g=R();
    M.stats = {
      pop:residents, cohorts:M.cohorts.length,
      employed:employed, workforce:workforce,
      unemployment: workforce? (workforce-employed)/workforce : 0,
      jobsFree: Math.max(0,totalJobs-employed), totalJobs:totalJobs,
      vacancy: capacity-residents, capacity:capacity,
      satisfaction: residents? satSum/residents : 70,
      avgIncome: residents? incSum/residents : 0,
      ages:ages, bands:bands,
      avgCommute: commuteN? commuteSum/commuteN : 0,
      congestion: cong, volume: vol,
      worstRoad: worst? (worst.gx+','+worst.gz) : null,
      worstLoad: worstV>0? worstV : 0,
      avgSpeed: 1 - Math.min(0.85, Math.max(0,cong-0.3)),
      transit: (cover_transit()),
      roads: M.roadCount,
      movedIn:M.stats.movedIn||0, movedOut:M.stats.movedOut||0,
      stock:(g.STOCK||{}),
      credits:(g.STOCK&&g.STOCK.credits)||0,
      powerDeficit: powerDef(),
      pollution:(function(){ try{ return pollution; }catch(e){ return 0; } })(),
      health:(function(){ try{ return cityCover.health; }catch(e){ return 0; } })(),
      fire:(function(){ try{ return cityCover.fire; }catch(e){ return 0; } })(),
      rent: ctx.rent
    };
  }
  function cover_transit(){ try{ return cityCover.transit; }catch(e){ return 0; } }
  function powerDef(){
    try{ return lastPowerGen>0 ? Math.max(0,(lastPowerUse-lastPowerGen)/Math.max(1,lastPowerUse)) : (lastPowerUse>0?1:0); }
    catch(e){ return 0; }
  }

  M.buildGraph=function(){ return buildGraph(); };
  M.toggleTraffic=function(){ M.showTraffic=!M.showTraffic;
    for(var id in (M.graph||{})){ var b=M.graph[id].b; if(b) b._tcol=null; }
    return M.showTraffic; };
  M.showTraffic=true;

  /* drive from the render loop, throttled */
  var last=Date.now(), a2=0;
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(), dt=Math.min(0.2,(now-last)/1000)||0.016; last=now;
    a2+=dt;
    if(a2<0.25) return;              // 4 Hz is plenty for a city simulation
    var step=a2; a2=0;
    try{ tick(step); }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();

/* ===================== DOMINION · MODELLED CITIZENS START =====================
   Every resident gets a body on the map. They are drawn with InstancedMesh
   (one draw call for all of them) and walk their household's actual routine —
   home in the evening, out to work or school by day, shops in between. */
(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_PEOPLE) return;
  var P = window.__DOM_PEOPLE = { cap:2400, n:0, people:[], ready:false, t:0,
    visible:true, _hidden:false };
  P.setVisible=function(v){ P.visible=!!v; if(!v) { if(P.ready) hideAll(); } else P._hidden=false; };

  var _R={};
  function R(){
    try{ if(_R.scene===undefined && typeof scene!=='undefined') _R.scene=scene; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.THREE===undefined && typeof THREE!=='undefined') _R.THREE=THREE; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._t && typeof TILE==='number'){ _R.TILE=TILE; _R._t=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    return _R;
  }
  function SIM(){ return window.__DOM_SIM; }
  function wx(b){ var g=R(); return b&&(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*g.TILE); }
  function wz(b){ var g=R(); return b&&(b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*g.TILE); }

  var SKIN=[0xe8c39e,0xd6a87c,0xb07d52,0x8a5a38,0x5f3d28];
  var CLOTH=[0x3d6f9e,0xb0453a,0x4a7a52,0x6a5b8a,0xd9a23c,0x455565,0xc06a4a,0x2f6f8f];

  function build(){
    var g=R(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE||P.ready) return;
    // body + head, one instanced mesh each
    var bodyG=new g.THREE.CapsuleGeometry ? new g.THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.16,0.42,4,7)
              : new g.THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.16,0.18,0.62,7);
    var headG=new g.THREE.SphereGeometry(0.13,7,6);
    P.body=new g.THREE.InstancedMesh(bodyG,
      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({roughness:0.85,metalness:0.02}), P.cap);
    P.head=new g.THREE.InstancedMesh(headG,
      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({roughness:0.9,metalness:0.0}), P.cap);
    P.body.instanceColor=new g.THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(P.cap*3),3);
    P.head.instanceColor=new g.THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(P.cap*3),3);
    P.body.castShadow=true; P.head.castShadow=true;
    P.body.frustumCulled=false; P.head.frustumCulled=false;
    var hide=new g.THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-9999,0);
    for(var i=0;i<P.cap;i++){ P.body.setMatrixAt(i,hide); P.head.setMatrixAt(i,hide); }
    g.scene.add(P.body); g.scene.add(P.head);
    P.ready=true;
  }

  /* keep one body per resident, capped so huge cities stay smooth */
  function sync(){
    var S=SIM(); if(!S||!S.cohorts) return;
    var want=0;
    for(var i=0;i<S.cohorts.length;i++) want+=S.cohorts[i].size;
    want=Math.min(P.cap, want);
    while(P.people.length<want){
      var idx=P.people.length;
      P.people.push({ ci:0, mi:0, x:0, z:0, tx:0, tz:0, ph:0,
        sp:0.55+Math.random()*0.5, jit:(Math.random()-0.5)*2.2, jit2:(Math.random()-0.5)*2.2,
        skin:SKIN[Math.floor(Math.random()*SKIN.length)],
        cloth:CLOTH[Math.floor(Math.random()*CLOTH.length)] });
    }
    while(P.people.length>want){
      var p=P.people.pop();
      hideAt(P.people.length);
    }
    // map each body onto a cohort
    var k=0;
    for(var c=0;c<S.cohorts.length && k<P.people.length;c++){
      for(var m=0;m<S.cohorts[c].size && k<P.people.length;m++){
        P.people[k].ci=c; P.people[k].mi=m; k++;
      }
    }
    P.n=P.people.length;
  }
  function hideAt(i){
    var g=R(); if(!P.ready) return;
    var hide=new g.THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-9999,0);
    P.body.setMatrixAt(i,hide); P.head.setMatrixAt(i,hide);
  }

  /* where should this person be right now? straight from their routine */
  function destOf(p){
    var S=SIM(); var co=S.cohorts[p.ci]; if(!co) return null;
    var phase=co.phase||'home';
    var b=null;
    if(phase==='work'||phase==='commute') b = co.work? co.work.b : (co.school||co.home);
    else if(phase==='school') b = co.school||co.home;
    else if(phase==='shop' || phase==='leisure'){
      // pick a nearby shop or park once, then keep using it
      if(!co.shop){
        try{
          var opts=buildings.filter(function(x){ var d=CITY[x.key]||{};
            return d.cat==='Civic' || x.key==='shop' || x.key==='market'; });
          if(opts.length) co.shop=opts[(Math.random()*opts.length)|0];
        }catch(e){}
      }
      b = co.shop || co.home;
    }
    else if(phase==='eat' || phase==='sleep') b = co.home;
    else b = co.home;
    if(!b) b=co.home;
    if(!b) return null;
    return { x:wx(b)+p.jit, z:wz(b)+p.jit2, moving:(phase==='commute') };
  }

  var acc=0;
  function tick(dt){
    var g=R(); if(!P.ready) return;
    var S=SIM(); if(!S||!S.cohorts||!S.cohorts.length) return;
    if(!P.visible) return;
    P.t+=dt;
    var m=new g.THREE.Matrix4(), q=new g.THREE.Quaternion(),
        v=new g.THREE.Vector3(), s=new g.THREE.Vector3(1,1,1);
    var col=new g.THREE.Color();
    P._hidden=false;
    for(var i=0;i<P.n;i++){
      var p=P.people[i];
      var d=destOf(p);
      if(!d){ hideAt(i); continue; }
      if(!p.init){ p.x=d.x; p.z=d.z; p.init=1; }
      // walk toward wherever the routine says they should be
      var dx=d.x-p.x, dz=d.z-p.z, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
      if(dist>0.4){
        var step=Math.min(dist, p.sp*dt*(d.moving?2.4:1));
        p.x+=dx/dist*step; p.z+=dz/dist*step;
        p.ph+=dt*7;
      } else p.ph+=dt*1.2;
      var y=(g.groundHeight(p.x,p.z)||0);
      var bob=Math.abs(Math.sin(p.ph))*0.05;
      var face=Math.atan2(dx,dz);
      q.setFromAxisAngle(new g.THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), face);
      v.set(p.x, y+0.42+bob, p.z); m.compose(v,q,s); P.body.setMatrixAt(i,m);
      v.set(p.x, y+0.83+bob, p.z); m.compose(v,q,s); P.head.setMatrixAt(i,m);
      col.setHex(p.cloth); P.body.setColorAt(i,col);
      col.setHex(p.skin);  P.head.setColorAt(i,col);
    }
    P.body.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
    P.head.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
    if(P.body.instanceColor) P.body.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;
    if(P.head.instanceColor) P.head.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;
  }

  var last=Date.now();
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(), dt=Math.min(0.2,(now-last)/1000)||0.016; last=now;
    acc+=dt;
    // citizens update at 8Hz; nothing at all is built or walked until the
    // first resident actually exists, so the menu and early game stay light
    if(acc<0.125) return; var step=acc; acc=0;
    var S=SIM();
    var pop = (S&&S.cohorts)? S.cohorts.length : 0;
    if(!pop){ return; }                  // no people yet -> no meshes, no work
    if(!P.visible){ if(P.ready) hideAll(); return; }
    try{ build(); sync(); tick(step); }catch(e){}
  }
  function hideAll(){
    if(P._hidden||!P.ready) return;
    P._hidden=true;
    var g=R(); var hide=new g.THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-9999,0);
    for(var i=0;i<P.cap;i++){ P.body.setMatrixAt(i,hide); P.head.setMatrixAt(i,hide); }
    P.body.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true; P.head.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();
/* ===================== DOMINION · MODELLED CITIZENS END ===================== */

/* ===================== DOMINION · ROAD RIBBONS START =====================
   A road drawn in pen mode is built as one continuous ribbon that follows the
   stroke — proper curves and banking, not a staircase of square tiles. The
   tile network underneath is still created so traffic, routing and congestion
   keep working; those tile meshes are just hidden under the ribbon.
   ======================================================================== */
(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_RIBBON) return;
  var RB = window.__DOM_RIBBON = { list:[], covered:{} };

  var _R={};
  function R(){
    try{ if(_R.scene===undefined && typeof scene!=='undefined') _R.scene=scene; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.THREE===undefined && typeof THREE!=='undefined') _R.THREE=THREE; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._t && typeof TILE==='number'){ _R.TILE=TILE; _R._t=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    return _R;
  }

  /* Catmull-Rom through the stroke points, resampled at an even spacing so the
     ribbon has consistent geometry however fast the cursor moved. */
  /* evenly spaced points along a straight run */
  function resample(pts, step){
    var out=[], a=pts[0], b=pts[pts.length-1];
    var L=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.z-a.z), n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(L/step));
    for(var i=0;i<=n;i++) out.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n, z:a.z+(b.z-a.z)*i/n});
    return out;
  }
  function spline(pts, step){
    if(pts.length<2) return pts.slice();
    var P=pts.slice();
    P.unshift(P[0]); P.push(P[P.length-1]);
    var out=[], acc=0;
    for(var i=1;i<P.length-2;i++){
      var p0=P[i-1],p1=P[i],p2=P[i+1],p3=P[i+2];
      var seg=Math.hypot(p2.x-p1.x,p2.z-p1.z);
      var n=Math.max(2, Math.ceil(seg/step));
      for(var j=0;j<n;j++){
        var t=j/n, t2=t*t, t3=t2*t;
        out.push({
          x:0.5*((2*p1.x)+(-p0.x+p2.x)*t+(2*p0.x-5*p1.x+4*p2.x-p3.x)*t2+(-p0.x+3*p1.x-3*p2.x+p3.x)*t3),
          z:0.5*((2*p1.z)+(-p0.z+p2.z)*t+(2*p0.z-5*p1.z+4*p2.z-p3.z)*t2+(-p0.z+3*p1.z-3*p2.z+p3.z)*t3)
        });
      }
    }
    out.push(P[P.length-2]);
    return out;
  }

  /* Sweep a width along the centreline and lay the surface on the ground. */
  /* Is there already a road on the tile under this point? Piers must not be
     dropped through one. */
  function roadUnder(x,z){
    try{ var t=TILE; return isRoad(Math.round(x/t), Math.round(z/t)); }catch(e){ return false; }
  }
  function buildRibbon(center, opts){
    var g=R(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE||center.length<2) return null;
    opts=opts||{};
    var HW=(opts.width||3.4)/2;   // a lane each way, not a runway                  // half width of the carriageway
    var LIFT=0.09;
    var pos=[], nrm=[], uv=[], idx=[];
    var kerbL=[], kerbR=[], dash=[], piers=[];
    for(var i=0;i<center.length;i++){
      var c=center[i];
      var a=center[Math.max(0,i-1)], b=center[Math.min(center.length-1,i+1)];
      var tx=b.x-a.x, tz=b.z-a.z;
      var L=Math.hypot(tx,tz)||1; tx/=L; tz/=L;
      var nx=-tz, nz=tx;                          // sideways
      var lx=c.x+nx*HW, lz=c.z+nz*HW;
      var rx=c.x-nx*HW, rz=c.z-nz*HW;
      // an elevated road runs flat level at its altitude instead of hugging the ground
      var ly = (opts.altY!==null && opts.altY!==undefined) ? opts.altY+LIFT : (g.groundHeight(lx,lz)||0)+LIFT;
      var ry = (opts.altY!==null && opts.altY!==undefined) ? opts.altY+LIFT : (g.groundHeight(rx,rz)||0)+LIFT;
      pos.push(lx,ly,lz, rx,ry,rz);
      nrm.push(0,1,0, 0,1,0);
      var v=i/(center.length-1);
      uv.push(0,v, 1,v);
      kerbL.push({x:lx,y:ly,z:lz}); kerbR.push({x:rx,y:ry,z:rz});
      var cy = (opts.altY!==null && opts.altY!==undefined) ? opts.altY+LIFT : (g.groundHeight(c.x,c.z)||0)+LIFT;
      if(i%6===0) dash.push({x:c.x,y:cy+0.02,z:c.z,tx:tx,tz:tz});
      if(opts.altY!==null && opts.altY!==undefined && i%9===0) piers.push({x:c.x,z:c.z,y:cy});
      if(i<center.length-1){
        var k=i*2;
        idx.push(k,k+2,k+1,  k+1,k+2,k+3);        // ordered so the surface faces up
      }
    }
    var geo=new g.THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new g.THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
    geo.setAttribute('normal',   new g.THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm,3));
    geo.setAttribute('uv',       new g.THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
    geo.setIndex(idx);
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    var grp=new g.THREE.Group();
    var asphalt=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color:(opts.color!==undefined?opts.color:0x3f434a), roughness:0.92, metalness:0.02,
      side:g.THREE.DoubleSide, polygonOffset:true, polygonOffsetFactor:-2, polygonOffsetUnits:-2 });
    var deck=new g.THREE.Mesh(geo, asphalt);
    deck.receiveShadow=true; grp.add(deck);
    grp.userData.deckMat=asphalt;

    // kerb lines down both edges, following every bend
    var kerbMat=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc4bfb2, roughness:0.85});
    [kerbL,kerbR].forEach(function(side){
      var kp=[], ki=[];
      for(var i2=0;i2<side.length;i2++){
        var s=side[i2];
        kp.push(s.x, s.y+0.02, s.z, s.x, s.y+0.15, s.z);
        if(i2<side.length-1){ var k2=i2*2; ki.push(k2,k2+2,k2+1, k2+1,k2+2,k2+3); }
      }
      var kg=new g.THREE.BufferGeometry();
      kg.setAttribute('position', new g.THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(kp,3));
      kg.setIndex(ki); kg.computeVertexNormals();
      grp.add(new g.THREE.Mesh(kg, kerbMat));
    });
    // centre line dashes, each turned to follow the road
    var lineMat=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xefe3a6, roughness:0.5});
    var dashGeo=new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16,0.03,1.5);
    for(var d2=0;d2<dash.length;d2++){
      var dd=dash[d2];
      var m=new g.THREE.Mesh(dashGeo, lineMat);
      m.position.set(dd.x, dd.y+0.03, dd.z);
      m.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dd.tx, dd.tz);

    if(piers.length && !opts.preview){
      var pierMat=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb9b3a6,roughness:0.92,metalness:0.02});
      for(var pi=0;pi<piers.length;pi++){

  /* A ghost of the road you are currently drawing, rebuilt as you move. */
  RB.preview=function(worldPts, straight){
    var g=R();
    RB.clearPreview();
    if(!worldPts||worldPts.length<2) return;
    var center=(straight||worldPts.length===2)
      ? resample(worldPts, Math.max(1.2, g.TILE*0.4))          // Shift = flat straight
      : spline(smoothStroke(worldPts), Math.max(1.2, g.TILE*0.4));
    var A=window.__DOM_ALT;
    var m=buildRibbon(center,{color:0x2f7fd0, preview:true,
      altY:(A && A.level!==0)? A.targetY() : null});
    if(!m) return;
    m.traverse(function(o){ if(o.isMesh&&o.material){ o.material.transparent=true;
      o.material.opacity=0.55; o.material.depthWrite=false; } });
    RB._prev=m;
  };
  RB.clearPreview=function(){
    if(RB._prev){ try{ R().scene.remove(RB._prev); }catch(e){} RB._prev=null; }
  };

     wobbly drag from turning into a wobbly road. */
  function smoothStroke(pts){
    if(window.__DOM_SMOOTH===false || pts.length<3) return pts.slice();
    var p=pts.slice();
    for(var pass=0;pass<2;pass++){
      var out=[p[0]];
      for(var i=1;i<p.length-1;i++){
        out.push({ x:(p[i-1].x+p[i].x*2+p[i+1].x)/4,
                   z:(p[i-1].z+p[i].z*2+p[i+1].z)/4 });
      }
      out.push(p[p.length-1]);
      p=out;
    }
    return p;
  }

  /* Public: lay a road along a hand-drawn stroke. */
  RB.layStroke=function(worldPts, tiles, altY){
    var g=R();
    if(!worldPts||worldPts.length<2) return;
    var center=(worldPts.length===2)? resample(worldPts, Math.max(1.2, g.TILE*0.4))
                                     : spline(smoothStroke(worldPts), Math.max(1.2, g.TILE*0.4));
    var mesh=buildRibbon(center,{altY:(altY===undefined?null:altY)});
    if(!mesh) return;
    RB.list.push({mesh:mesh, center:center, tiles:tiles||[], wear:0, altY:(altY===undefined?null:altY)});
    // hide the square tile meshes that sit under the ribbon
    if(tiles) for(var i=0;i<tiles.length;i++){
      RB.covered[tiles[i].gx+','+tiles[i].gz]=true;
    }
    hideCovered();
  };
  function hideCovered(){
    var g=R(); var bs=null;
    try{ bs=buildings; }catch(e){ return; }
    for(var i=0;i<bs.length;i++){
      var b=bs[i];
      if(b.key==='roundabout'){ if(b.mesh) b.mesh.visible=true; continue; }  // always on top
      if(b.key!=='road') continue;
      if(RB.covered[b.gx+','+b.gz] && b.mesh) b.mesh.visible=false;
    }
  }
  RB.hideCovered=hideCovered;
  /* keep the ribbon colour in step with how worn the road underneath is */
  RB.tint=function(){
    var bs=null; try{ bs=buildings; }catch(e){ return; }
    for(var i=0;i<RB.list.length;i++){
      var rb=RB.list[i]; if(!rb.tiles.length||!rb.mesh) continue;
      var w=0, n=0;
      for(var t=0;t<rb.tiles.length;t++){
        var k=rb.tiles[t].gx+','+rb.tiles[t].gz;
        for(var b=0;b<bs.length;b++) if(bs[b].gx===rb.tiles[t].gx&&bs[b].gz===rb.tiles[t].gz&&bs[b].key==='road'){ w+=(bs[b].wear||0); n++; break; }
      }
      if(!n) continue;
      w/=n;
      if(Math.abs(w-(rb.wear||0))<0.08) continue;
      rb.wear=w;
      var T=R().THREE;
      var fresh=new T.Color(0x3f434a), worn=new T.Color(0x6d6a60), broke=new T.Color(0x7b5f4a);
      var c=new T.Color();
      if(w<0.6) c.copy(fresh).lerp(worn,w/0.6); else c.copy(worn).lerp(broke,(w-0.6)/0.4);
      if(rb.mesh.userData.deckMat) rb.mesh.userData.deckMat.color.copy(c);
    }
  };
  var acc=0, last=Date.now();
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(); acc+=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
    if(acc<1.5) return; acc=0;
    try{ hideCovered(); RB.tint(); }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();

(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_RAIL) return;

    try{ if(_R.THREE===undefined && typeof THREE!=='undefined') _R.THREE=THREE; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.renderer===undefined && typeof renderer!=='undefined') _R.renderer=renderer; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._t && typeof TILE==='number'){ _R.TILE=TILE; _R._t=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._p && typeof pointerToGrid==='function'){ _R.pointerToGrid=pointerToGrid; _R._p=1; } }catch(e){}

  /* ---------- stations ---------- */
  function stations(){
    var out=[];

      for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++){
        var b=buildings[i];
        if(b.key!=='trainstation') continue;
        out.push({b:b, x:(b.cx!==undefined?b.cx:b.gx*G().TILE),
                       z:(b.cz!==undefined?b.cz:b.gz*G().TILE)});
      }
    }catch(e){}

  }
  function nearestStation(x,z,maxD){
    var st=stations(), best=null, bd=(maxD||26)*(maxD||26);
    for(var i=0;i<st.length;i++){
      var d=(st[i].x-x)*(st[i].x-x)+(st[i].z-z)*(st[i].z-z);

          '<b>E</b> to extend from an end, <b>Delete</b> to destroy it. <b>Esc</b> exits.');
    } else { R.select(null); }

    R.nodes=[]; R.sel=L;

  };
  function nearestLine(x,z){

      for(var j=0;j<c.length;j+=2){

        if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=R.lines[i]; }

  }
  function nearestNode(x,z){
    var best=null, bd=6*6;
    for(var i=0;i<R.nodes.length;i++){

      var nx=[out[0]];
      for(var i=0;i<out.length-1;i++){
        var a=out[i], b=out[i+1];
        nx.push({x:a.x*0.75+b.x*0.25, z:a.z*0.75+b.z*0.25});
        nx.push({x:a.x*0.25+b.x*0.75, z:a.z*0.25+b.z*0.75});

      nx.push(out[out.length-1]); out=nx;

    return out;
  }
  function ghost(){
    var g=G(); clearGhost();
    if(R.pts.length<2) return;
    var c=smooth(R.pts), v=[];
    for(var i=0;i<c.length;i++) v.push(new g.THREE.Vector3(c[i].x,(g.groundHeight(c[i].x,c[i].z)||0)+0.7,c[i].z));

  /* ---------- building the finished line ---------- */
  function buildTrack(center){
    var g=G();
    var grp=new g.THREE.Group();
    var ballastM=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x6b6357,roughness:1});
    var railM=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8a8f96,metalness:0.65,roughness:0.4});
    var tieM=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x4a3a2a,roughness:1});
    var tieGeo=new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(2.6,0.14,0.42);
    for(var i=1;i<center.length;i++){
      var a=center[i-1], b=center[i];
      var len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.z-a.z); if(len<0.01) continue;
      var mx=(a.x+b.x)/2, mz=(a.z+b.z)/2;
      var y=((g.groundHeight(a.x,a.z)+g.groundHeight(b.x,b.z))/2)+0.1;
      var ang=Math.atan2(b.x-a.x, b.z-a.z);
      var bal=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(3.1,0.18,len), ballastM);
      bal.position.set(mx,y,mz); bal.rotation.y=ang; bal.receiveShadow=true; grp.add(bal);
      for(var s=-1;s<=1;s+=2){
        var rail=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16,0.16,len), railM);
        rail.position.set(mx+Math.cos(ang)*s*0.75, y+0.19, mz-Math.sin(ang)*s*0.75);
        rail.rotation.y=ang; grp.add(rail);
      }
      if(i%3===0){
        var tie=new g.THREE.Mesh(tieGeo, tieM);
        tie.position.set(mx,y+0.11,mz); tie.rotation.y=ang; grp.add(tie);
      }

    g.scene.add(grp);

  }
  function makeTrain(){
    var g=G();
    var t=new g.THREE.Group();
    var body=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x2f6f9e,metalness:0.4,roughness:0.45});
    var win=new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xbfe0f5,metalness:0.3,roughness:0.2});
    t.userData.cars=[];
    for(var c=0;c<4;c++){
      var car=new g.THREE.Group();
      var hull=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(2.2,1.9,5.6),
        c===0? new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd24b3f,metalness:0.4,roughness:0.45}) : body);
      hull.position.y=1.5; hull.castShadow=true; car.add(hull);
      for(var s2=-1;s2<=1;s2+=2){
        var w=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06,0.6,4.4), win);
        w.position.set(s2*1.12,1.8,0); car.add(w);

  function pathLen(p){ var s=0; for(var i=1;i<p.length;i++) s+=Math.hypot(p[i].x-p[i-1].x,p[i].z-p[i-1].z); return s; }

    var total=pathLen(p), want=total*(t%1), acc=0;

      if(acc+seg>=want){ var f=seg>0?(want-acc)/seg:0;
        return {x:p[i-1].x+(p[i].x-p[i-1].x)*f, z:p[i-1].z+(p[i].z-p[i-1].z)*f}; }
      acc+=seg;

  }

    if(pathLen(R.pts)<40){ say('That line is too short to be worth running.'); R.pts=[]; clearGhost(); return false; }

    // turn around, so it moves far more people. Otherwise it is a shuttle.

        if(Math.hypot(st[i].x-center[j].x, st[i].z-center[j].z) < 22){ served.push(st[i]); break; }

  /* ---------- running ---------- */

        if(L.t>=1){ L.t=1; L.dir=-1; L.carried+=Math.round(70*Math.max(1,L.served.length)); }
        if(L.t<=0){ L.t=0; L.dir=1;  L.carried+=Math.round(70*Math.max(1,L.served.length)); }
      }
      var p=at(L.center,L.closed? L.t : Math.max(0,Math.min(1,L.t)));
      var q=at(L.center,L.closed? L.t+0.004 : Math.max(0,Math.min(1,L.t+0.004*L.dir)));

      // whole train bends through curves instead of sliding as one rigid box

      L.train.rotation.set(0,0,0);

        L.t-=1;

   fund each department, pass policies with real trade-offs, and live with
   the approval rating that results.

(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_GOV) return;
  var G = window.__DOM_GOV = {
    open:false,
    tax:0.10,                       // 0 – 0.25
    budget:{ services:1.0, power:1.0, transport:1.0, industry:1.0 },
    policies:{},
    approval:60, unrest:0, t:0
  };

  var POLICIES = {
    recycling:{ nm:'Recycling mandate', ic:'♻', cost:0.6,
      d:'Households sort their waste. Cuts pollution, costs a little to run.',
      eff:{ pollution:-0.18, happy:-1 } },
    freetransit:{ nm:'Free public transport', ic:'🚌', cost:2.2,
      d:'No fares. Roads clear a little and people like it, but you pay for it.',
      eff:{ congestion:-0.15, happy:+6 } },
    smokeless:{ nm:'Smokeless zone', ic:'🏭', cost:1.0,
      d:'Heavy industry is restricted. Cleaner air, lower factory output.',
      eff:{ pollution:-0.3, industry:-0.15, happy:+3 } },
    education:{ nm:'Schooling grant', ic:'🎓', cost:1.8,
      d:'Pays families to keep children in school. Better educated, costlier.',
      eff:{ education:+0.2, happy:+2 } },
    nightshift:{ nm:'Night shifts', ic:'🌙', cost:0,
      d:'Factories run around the clock. More output, unhappier residents.',
      eff:{ industry:+0.22, happy:-7 } },
    greenbelt:{ nm:'Green belt', ic:'🌳', cost:0.8,
      d:'Protects open land around the city. Popular, but limits sprawl.',
      eff:{ happy:+5, pollution:-0.1 } },
    healthdrive:{ nm:'Health campaign', ic:'⚕', cost:1.4,
      d:'Public health outreach. Fewer illnesses, ongoing cost.',
      eff:{ health:+0.15, happy:+3 } }
  };
  G.POLICIES=POLICIES;

  function el(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){
    return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c]; }); }
  function ingame(){ try{ return !!gameStarted && !document.body.classList.contains('inMenu'); }catch(e){ return false; } }

  /* combined effect of everything currently in force */
  G.effect=function(key){
    var v=0;
    for(var k in G.policies) if(G.policies[k] && POLICIES[k] && POLICIES[k].eff[key]!==undefined)
      v+=POLICIES[k].eff[key];
    return v;
  };
  G.upkeep=function(){
    var c=0;
    for(var k in G.policies) if(G.policies[k]) c+=POLICIES[k].cost;
    // departments cost more the better funded they are
    var b=G.budget;
    c += (b.services-1)*6 + (b.power-1)*3 + (b.transport-1)*3 + (b.industry-1)*3;
    return Math.max(0,c);
  };

  /* the running of the city, applied once a second */
  function tick(dt){
    G.t+=dt;
    if(G.t<1) return;
    var step=G.t; G.t=0;
    try{
      // policy and department upkeep comes out of the treasury
      var cost=G.upkeep()*step;
      STOCK.credits=Math.max(0,(STOCK.credits||0)-cost);

      // approval: taxes bite, services and policies help
      var happy=60; try{ happy=cityHappy; }catch(e){}
      var svc=0;   try{ svc=cityServices; }catch(e){}
      var target = happy*0.55
        + svc*22
        - (G.tax-0.10)*220                        // above 10% starts to hurt
        + G.effect('happy')
        + (G.budget.services-1)*14;
      if((STOCK.credits||0) < 1) target -= 25;    // an empty treasury is noticed
      G.approval += (Math.max(0,Math.min(100,target)) - G.approval) * Math.min(1, step*0.15);

      // unrest builds while approval is poor
      if(G.approval<30) G.unrest=Math.min(100, G.unrest+step*(30-G.approval)*0.05);
      else G.unrest=Math.max(0, G.unrest-step*2.5);
      if(G.unrest>60 && !G._unrestWarned){
        G._unrestWarned=true;
        try{ if(window.__DOM_SIDE) window.__DOM_SIDE.note('bad',
          '📢 Public patience is running out. Cut taxes or fund services.'); }catch(e){}
      }
      if(G.unrest<20) G._unrestWarned=false;

      // expose the levers the economy reads
      window.__DOM_GOV_TAX = G.tax;
      window.__DOM_GOV_MUL = {
        services: G.budget.services,
        power:    G.budget.power,
        transport:G.budget.transport,
        industry: G.budget.industry * (1+G.effect('industry')),
        pollution:1+G.effect('pollution'),
        approval: G.approval
      };
    }catch(e){}
  }

  /* ---------- UI ---------- */
  function css(){
    if(el('gov-css')) return;
    var s=document.createElement('style'); s.id='gov-css';
    s.textContent=[
      '#gov-panel{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:150px;z-index:36;width:min(400px,46vw);',
      ' max-height:62vh;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e7ee;border-radius:15px;',
      ' box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(18,28,40,.18);display:none;flex-direction:column;',
      ' overflow:hidden;font-family:Inter,system-ui}',
      '#gov-panel.show{display:flex}',
      '.gv-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f5}',
      '.gv-h b{font-size:13.5px;color:#1d242c}',
      '.gv-x{margin-left:auto;background:none;border:none;color:#8a95a1;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}',
      '.gv-b{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 14px 14px}',
      '.gv-sect{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#98a1ab;',
      ' font-weight:800;margin:14px 0 7px}',
      '.gv-sect:first-child{margin-top:0}',
      '.gv-stat{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}',
      '.gv-card{flex:1;border:1px solid #e4e9ee;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:#fbfcfe}',
      '.gv-card .k{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#98a1ab;font-weight:800}',
      '.gv-card .v{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",Inter,sans-serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;color:#1d242c}',
      '.gv-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 0}',
      '.gv-row label{flex:1;font-size:12px;color:#2a333d}',
      '.gv-row input[type=range]{flex:1.2;accent-color:#2f7fd0}',
      '.gv-row .val{width:52px;text-align:right;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#3b4652}',
      '.gv-p{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #e4e9ee;',
      ' border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;background:#fbfcfe}',
      '.gv-p:hover{border-color:#2f7fd0}',
      '.gv-p.on{border-color:#2f9e63;background:#eef8f1}',
      '.gv-p i{font-style:normal;font-size:17px}',
      '.gv-p b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#1d242c}',
      '.gv-p s{text-decoration:none;font-size:10px;color:#7c8894;line-height:1.45;display:block;margin-top:2px}',
      '.gv-p em{font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;color:#c9922b;font-weight:700}',
      '.gv-bar{height:7px;border-radius:4px;background:#eef1f5;overflow:hidden;margin-top:5px}',
      '.gv-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:4px}'
    ].join('');
    (document.head||document.body).appendChild(s);
  }
  function build(){
    css();
    if(el('gov-panel')) return;
    var d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='gov-panel';
    d.innerHTML='<div class="gv-h">🏛 <b>Governance</b><button class="gv-x" id="gv-x">✕</button></div>'+
      '<div class="gv-b" id="gv-body"></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(d);
    el('gv-x').onclick=G.toggle;
  }
  G.toggle=function(){
    build(); G.open=!G.open;
    el('gov-panel').classList.toggle('show', G.open);
    if(G.open) render();
  };
  function render(){
    var b=el('gv-body'); if(!b||!G.open) return;
    var col = G.approval>65? '#2f9e63' : G.approval>40? '#c9922b' : '#d24b3f';
    var h='<div class="gv-stat">'+
      '<div class="gv-card"><div class="k">Approval</div><div class="v" style="color:'+col+'">'+
        Math.round(G.approval)+'%</div><div class="gv-bar"><i style="width:'+Math.round(G.approval)+'%;background:'+col+'"></i></div></div>'+
      '<div class="gv-card"><div class="k">Tax rate</div><div class="v">'+Math.round(G.tax*100)+'%</div></div>'+
      '<div class="gv-card"><div class="k">Upkeep</div><div class="v">'+G.upkeep().toFixed(1)+'</div></div>'+
      '</div>';
    if(G.unrest>25) h+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#d24b3f;background:#fdecea;border:1px solid #f6cfca;'+
      'border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px">📢 Unrest '+Math.round(G.unrest)+
      '% — people are unhappy with how the city is being run.</div>';

    h+='<div class="gv-sect">Taxation</div>';
    h+='<div class="gv-row"><label>Rate</label><input type="range" id="gv-tax" min="0" max="25" '+
       'value="'+Math.round(G.tax*100)+'"><span class="val">'+Math.round(G.tax*100)+'%</span></div>'+
       '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#7c8894;line-height:1.5">Low taxes keep people happy but starve '+
       'the treasury. Above 10% approval starts to slide.</div>';

    h+='<div class="gv-sect">Department budgets</div>';
    var names={services:'Services',power:'Power grid',transport:'Transport',industry:'Industry'};
    for(var k in G.budget){
      h+='<div class="gv-row"><label>'+names[k]+'</label><input type="range" data-bud="'+k+'" '+
         'min="50" max="150" value="'+Math.round(G.budget[k]*100)+'">'+
         '<span class="val">'+Math.round(G.budget[k]*100)+'%</span></div>';
    }
    h+='<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#7c8894;line-height:1.5">Funding above 100% improves output '+
       'and costs credits every second. Below 100% saves money at the cost of performance.</div>';

    h+='<div class="gv-sect">Policies</div>';
    for(var p in POLICIES){
      var P=POLICIES[p], on=!!G.policies[p];
      h+='<div class="gv-p'+(on?' on':'')+'" data-pol="'+p+'"><i>'+P.ic+'</i><span><b>'+esc(P.nm)+
         '</b><s>'+esc(P.d)+'</s>'+(P.cost?('<em>upkeep '+P.cost.toFixed(1)+'/s</em>'):'<em>free</em>')+
         '</span></div>';
    }
    b.innerHTML=h;
    var t=el('gv-tax');
    if(t) t.oninput=function(){ G.tax=(+t.value)/100; render(); };
    b.querySelectorAll('[data-bud]').forEach(function(r){
      r.oninput=function(){ G.budget[r.getAttribute('data-bud')]=(+r.value)/100; render(); }; });
    b.querySelectorAll('[data-pol]').forEach(function(r){
      r.onclick=function(){ var k=r.getAttribute('data-pol');
        G.policies[k]=!G.policies[k]; render();
        try{ flash((G.policies[k]?'Passed':'Repealed')+' <b>'+POLICIES[k].nm+'</b>'); }catch(e){} }; });
  }

  var last=Date.now(), ui=0;
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(), dt=Math.min(0.3,(now-last)/1000)||0.016; last=now;
    if(!ingame()) return;
    try{ build(); tick(dt);
      ui+=dt; if(G.open && ui>1.2){ ui=0; render(); }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();
/* ===================== DOMINION · GOVERNANCE END ===================== */

/* ===================== DOMINION · PROJECTILES, ROCKETS & ARRIVALS START =====
   Visible shots between units, a rocket pad you aim yourself, and new residents
   who travel in from the edge of the map instead of appearing out of thin air.
   =========================================================================== */
(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_FX) return;
  var F = window.__DOM_FX = { shots:[], rockets:[], arrivals:[], aiming:false, t:0 };

  var _R={};
  function G(){
    try{ if(_R.scene===undefined && typeof scene!=='undefined') _R.scene=scene; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.THREE===undefined && typeof THREE!=='undefined') _R.THREE=THREE; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.renderer===undefined && typeof renderer!=='undefined') _R.renderer=renderer; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._t && typeof TILE==='number'){ _R.TILE=TILE; _R.HALF=HALF; _R._t=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._p && typeof pointerToGrid==='function'){ _R.pointerToGrid=pointerToGrid; _R._p=1; } }catch(e){}
    return _R;
  }
  function ingame(){ try{ return !!gameStarted && !document.body.classList.contains('inMenu'); }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function say(m){ try{ flash(m); }catch(e){} }
  function note(k,t){ try{ if(window.__DOM_SIDE) window.__DOM_SIDE.note(k,t); }catch(e){} }

  /* ---------------- visible shots ---------------- */
  function pool(){
    var g=G();
    if(F.tracer) return;
    F.tracer=new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffe08a});
    F.tracerGeo=new g.THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.055,0.055,1.5,5);
    F.sparkGeo=new g.THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28,7,6);
    F.sparkMat=new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffb347,transparent:true,opacity:0.9});
  }
  /* Called by the fighting code whenever one unit attacks another. */
  F.shot=function(ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,colour){
    if(!ingame()) return;
    var g=G(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE) return;
    if(F.shots.length>90) return;                 // never let it snowball
    pool();
    var m=new g.THREE.Mesh(F.tracerGeo,
      colour? new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:colour}) : F.tracer);
    g.scene.add(m);
    F.shots.push({m:m, ax:ax, ay:ay, az:az, bx:bx, by:by, bz:bz, t:0,
                  sp:2.6+Math.random()*1.2});
  };
  function tickShots(dt){
    var g=G();
    for(var i=F.shots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var s=F.shots[i];
      s.t+=dt*s.sp;
      if(s.t>=1){
        try{ g.scene.remove(s.m); }catch(e){}
        F.shots.splice(i,1);
        spark(s.bx,s.by,s.bz);
        continue;
      }
      var x=s.ax+(s.bx-s.ax)*s.t, y=s.ay+(s.by-s.ay)*s.t, z=s.az+(s.bz-s.az)*s.t;
      s.m.position.set(x,y,z);
      // point the tracer along its flight
      var dx=s.bx-s.ax, dy=s.by-s.ay, dz=s.bz-s.az;
      var len=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz)||1;
      s.m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new g.THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),
        new g.THREE.Vector3(dx/len,dy/len,dz/len));
    }
  }
  function spark(x,y,z){
    var g=G(); pool();
    var m=new g.THREE.Mesh(F.sparkGeo, F.sparkMat.clone());
    m.position.set(x,y,z); g.scene.add(m);
    F.sparks=F.sparks||[];
    F.sparks.push({m:m,t:0});
  }
  function tickSparks(dt){
    if(!F.sparks) return;
    var g=G();
    for(var i=F.sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var s=F.sparks[i]; s.t+=dt*3.2;
      s.m.scale.setScalar(1+s.t*1.6);
      s.m.material.opacity=Math.max(0,0.9-s.t);
      if(s.t>=1){ try{ g.scene.remove(s.m); }catch(e){} F.sparks.splice(i,1); }
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- rocket pad ---------------- */
  function pads(){
    var out=[];
    try{ for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++) if(buildings[i].key==='rocketpad') out.push(buildings[i]); }catch(e){}
    return out;
  }
  F.beginAim=function(){
    var p=pads();
    if(!p.length){ say('Build a <b>🚀 Rocket Pad</b> first.'); return; }
    var ready=p.filter(function(b){ return (b.rocketReady||0)>=1; });
    if(!ready.length){ say('No rocket is ready yet — the pad is still preparing one.'); return; }
    F.aiming=true;
    say('🚀 <b>Aiming</b> — click a target on the map. <b>Esc</b> cancels.');
  };
  F.cancelAim=function(){ F.aiming=false; };
  function launch(tx,tz){
    var g=G();
    var p=pads().filter(function(b){ return (b.rocketReady||0)>=1; })[0];
    if(!p){ say('No rocket ready.'); F.aiming=false; return; }
    p.rocketReady=0;
    var sx=(p.cx!==undefined?p.cx:p.gx*g.TILE), sz=(p.cz!==undefined?p.cz:p.gz*g.TILE);
    var sy=(g.groundHeight(sx,sz)||0)+3;
    var body=new g.THREE.Group();
    var hull=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3,0.3,3.2,10),
      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xdfe3e6,metalness:0.4,roughness:0.4}));
    body.add(hull);
    var nose=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.ConeGeometry(0.3,1.0,10),
      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd24b3f,roughness:0.5}));
    nose.position.y=2.1; body.add(nose);
    for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
      var fin=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08,0.8,0.6),
        new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8a8f96,metalness:0.5}));
      var a=i/3*Math.PI*2;
      fin.position.set(Math.cos(a)*0.34,-1.3,Math.sin(a)*0.34);
      fin.rotation.y=-a; body.add(fin);
    }
    var flame=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.ConeGeometry(0.28,1.4,8),
      new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffb347,transparent:true,opacity:0.9}));
    flame.position.y=-2.2; flame.rotation.x=Math.PI; body.add(flame);
    body.position.set(sx,sy,sz);
    g.scene.add(body);
    F.rockets.push({m:body, flame:flame, sx:sx, sy:sy, sz:sz,
                    tx:tx, tz:tz, ty:(g.groundHeight(tx,tz)||0), t:0, arc:34});
    F.aiming=false;
    note('info','🚀 Rocket away.');
    say('🚀 Away');
  }
  function tickPayloads(dt){
    var g=G();
    for(var i=F.rockets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var r=F.rockets[i];
      r.t+=dt*0.42;
      if(r.t>=1){
        try{ g.scene.remove(r.m); }catch(e){}
        F.rockets.splice(i,1);
        impact(r.tx,r.ty,r.tz);
        continue;
      }
      var x=r.sx+(r.tx-r.sx)*r.t, z=r.sz+(r.tz-r.sz)*r.t;
      var y=r.sy+(r.ty-r.sy)*r.t + Math.sin(r.t*Math.PI)*r.arc;
      var px=r.m.position.x, py=r.m.position.y, pz=r.m.position.z;
      r.m.position.set(x,y,z);
      var dx=x-px, dy=y-py, dz=z-pz, L=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz)||1;
      r.m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new g.THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),
        new g.THREE.Vector3(dx/L,dy/L,dz/L));
      r.flame.scale.setScalar(0.8+Math.random()*0.5);
    }
  }
  function impact(x,y,z){
    var g=G();
    // a bright flash and a shockwave ring
    var fl=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.SphereGeometry(2.4,12,10),
      new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffd08a,transparent:true,opacity:0.95}));
    fl.position.set(x,y+2,z); g.scene.add(fl);
    var ring=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.RingGeometry(1,1.4,26),
      new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffb347,transparent:true,opacity:0.9,
        side:g.THREE.DoubleSide,depthTest:false}));
    ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; ring.position.set(x,y+0.4,z); g.scene.add(ring);
    F.bursts=F.bursts||[]; F.bursts.push({fl:fl,ring:ring,t:0});
    // everything close by takes a hit
    var R=18;
    try{
      for(var i=0;i<allUnits.length;i++){
        var u=allUnits[i]; if(!u||u.hp<=0) continue;
        var d=Math.hypot(u.x-x,u.z-z);
        if(d<R) u.hp -= 90*(1-d/R);
      }
    }catch(e){}
    try{
      var S=window.__DOM_SMP;
      if(S&&S.enemy) for(var id in S.enemy){
        var e2=S.enemy[id]; if(!e2) continue;
        for(var k in e2.units){ var eu=e2.units[k]; if(!eu) continue;
          if(Math.hypot(eu.x-x,eu.z-z)<R) eu.hp=(eu.hp||100)-90; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    note('combat','💥 Rocket impact.');
  }
  function tickBursts(dt){
    if(!F.bursts) return;
    var g=G();
    for(var i=F.bursts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var b=F.bursts[i]; b.t+=dt*1.5;
      b.fl.scale.setScalar(1+b.t*2.2);
      b.fl.material.opacity=Math.max(0,0.95-b.t);
      b.ring.scale.setScalar(1+b.t*16);
      b.ring.material.opacity=Math.max(0,0.9-b.t);
      if(b.t>=1){ try{ g.scene.remove(b.fl); g.scene.remove(b.ring); }catch(e){} F.bursts.splice(i,1); }
    }
  }
  /* pads slowly prepare the next rocket */
  function tickPads(dt){
    var p=pads();
    for(var i=0;i<p.length;i++){
      var b=p[i];
      if(b.unpowered) continue;
      b.rocketReady=Math.min(1,(b.rocketReady||0)+dt/70);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- new residents travel in ---------------- */
  F.arrive=function(count){
    var g=G(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE) return;
    if(F.arrivals.length>18) return;
    // come in from a random edge and walk to a home
    var side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4), H=g.HALF-6;
    var sx,sz;
    if(side===0){ sx=-H; sz=(Math.random()-0.5)*H*2; }
    else if(side===1){ sx=H; sz=(Math.random()-0.5)*H*2; }

    try{
      var hs=buildings.filter(function(b){ return (CITY[b.key]||{}).pop; });

    var van=new g.THREE.Mesh(new g.THREE.BoxGeometry(1.3,1.2,2.8),
      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc9a86a,roughness:0.6}));
    van.position.y=0.9; grp.add(van);

      new g.THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x8a6f4a,roughness:0.6}));

/* ===================== DOMINION · SAVE & LOAD START =====================
   Write the whole city out to a .dominion file and load it back in another

(function(){

      return {x0:r.x0,x1:r.x1,z0:r.z0,z1:r.z1,y:r.y,kind:r.kind,r:r.r}; }); }catch(e){ d.regions=[]; }

})();

/* ===================== DOMINION · UNIT ANIMATION START =====================
   Every unit gets moving parts: legs that stride, wheels and tracks that roll,
   rotors that spin up, and guns that turn to face whatever that unit is
   attacking. A vehicle with two guns aims each one independently.
   ========================================================================== */
(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_UNITFX) return;
  var U = window.__DOM_UNITFX = { t:0, tagged:0 };

  var _R={};
  function G(){
    try{ if(_R.scene===undefined && typeof scene!=='undefined') _R.scene=scene; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.THREE===undefined && typeof THREE!=='undefined') _R.THREE=THREE; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(_R.allUnits===undefined && typeof allUnits!=='undefined') _R.allUnits=allUnits; }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    return _R;
  }
  function ingame(){ try{ return !!gameStarted && !document.body.classList.contains('inMenu'); }catch(e){ return false; } }

  /* Walk the model once and note the parts worth moving. */
  function nodeOf(u){ return u && (u.model || u.mesh); }
  function tag(u){
    var root=nodeOf(u);
    if(!u || !root || u._fx) return;
    var g=G();
    var fx={ guns:[], legs:[], wheels:[], rotors:[], body:null, recoil:0 };
    var i=0;
    root.traverse(function(o){
      if(!o.isMesh && !o.isGroup) return;
      var d=o.userData||{};
      if(d.turret || d.guns) fx.guns.push(o);
      else if(d.leg) fx.legs.push(o);
      else if(d.wheel) fx.wheels.push(o);
      else if(d.rotor || d.spin) fx.rotors.push(o);
    });
    // fall back on geometry when the model has no tags: thin uprights read as
    // legs, flat cylinders as wheels, long flat boxes as rotors

      root.traverse(function(o){
        if(!o.isMesh || !o.geometry || !o.geometry.parameters) return;
        var p=o.geometry.parameters, t=o.geometry.type;
        if(t==='CylinderGeometry' && p.radiusTop<0.42 && p.height<0.4 && Math.abs(o.rotation.z)>1)
          fx.wheels.push(o);
        else if(t==='BoxGeometry' && p.height && p.height>0.35 && p.width<0.28 && o.position.y<0.7)
          fx.legs.push(o);
        else if(t==='BoxGeometry' && p.width>2.4 && p.height<0.14)
          fx.rotors.push(o);
        else if(t==='CylinderGeometry' && p.height>0.7 && p.radiusTop<0.16 && o.position.y>0.6)
          fx.guns.push(o);

    if(u.order && (u.order.type==='attack') && u.order.ref) return u.order.ref;

    var g=G(), us=g.allUnits||[], best=null, bd=44*44;
    for(var i=0;i<us.length;i++){
      var o=us[i];
      if(!o||o===u||o.hp<=0||o.faction===u.faction) continue;
      var d=(o.x-u.x)*(o.x-u.x)+(o.z-u.z)*(o.z-u.z);
      if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=o; }

    if(best) return best;
    try{
      var S=window.__DOM_SMP;
      if(S&&S.enemy) for(var id in S.enemy){
        var e=S.enemy[id]; if(!e) continue;
        for(var k in e.units){ var eu=e.units[k]; if(!eu||eu._gone) continue;
          var dd=(eu.x-u.x)*(eu.x-u.x)+(eu.z-u.z)*(eu.z-u.z);
          if(dd<bd){ bd=dd; best=eu; } }
      }
    }catch(e){}

  }

  function animate(u, dt){
    var fx=u._fx, root=nodeOf(u); if(!fx || !root) return;

    var phase = (u._ph = (u._ph||0) + dt*(moving?9:1.5));

    // stride
    for(var l=0;l<fx.legs.length;l++){
      var leg=fx.legs[l];
      if(leg.userData._base===undefined) leg.userData._base=leg.rotation.x||0;
      leg.rotation.x = leg.userData._base + (moving? Math.sin(phase + l*Math.PI)*0.6 : 0);
    }
    // roll
    for(var w=0;w<fx.wheels.length;w++) if(moving) fx.wheels[w].rotation.x += dt*7;
    // rotors spin up while airborne
    for(var r=0;r<fx.rotors.length;r++) fx.rotors[r].rotation.y += dt*(moving?26:14);

    // each guns tracks its own target
    var tgt=targetOf(u);
    for(var m=0;m<fx.guns.length;m++){
      var mt=fx.guns[m];
      var want=mt.userData._rest||0;
      if(tgt){
        // spread the guns slightly so a twin-guns vehicle does not look
        // like one guns drawn twice
        var ang=Math.atan2(tgt.x-u.x, tgt.z-u.z) - (root.rotation.y||0);
        want = ang + (mt.userData._off||0)*0.12 - 0.06;
      }
      var cur=mt.rotation.y;
      var diff=((want-cur+Math.PI*3)%(Math.PI*2))-Math.PI;
      mt.rotation.y = cur + diff*Math.min(1, dt*4.5);      // swings round, not snaps
      // a small kick when the unit is attacking
      if(u._firing>0){
        mt.position.z = (mt.userData._z===undefined? (mt.userData._z=mt.position.z) : mt.userData._z) - u._firing*0.22;
      } else if(mt.userData._z!==undefined){

    if(u._firing>0) u._firing=Math.max(0,u._firing-dt*3.5);

  function loop(){

    if(!ingame()) return;

      var g=G(), us=g.allUnits||[];

  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();
/* ===================== DOMINION · UNIT ANIMATION END ===================== */

/* ===================== DOMINION · UNIT MODELS START =====================

(function(){

    com:{ nm:'Commercial',  ic:'🏪', col:0x3d8fe0,

    try{ if(!_R._gh && typeof groundHeight==='function'){ _R.groundHeight=groundHeight; _R._gh=1; } }catch(e){}
    try{ if(!_R._p && typeof pointerToGrid==='function'){ _R.pointerToGrid=pointerToGrid; _R._p=1; } }catch(e){}
    return _R;
  }
  function ingame(){ try{ return !!gameStarted && !document.body.classList.contains('inMenu'); }catch(e){ return false; } }

  Z.setTool=function(id){

  function paintAt(gx,gz){
    var r=Z.brush;
    for(var dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++) for(var dz=-r;dz<=r;dz++){
      if(dx*dx+dz*dz>r*r) continue;
      var x=gx+dx, z=gz+dz, key=x+','+z;
      try{
        if(occupied[key]) continue;                       // something is already there
        if(terrainHeightAt(x*TILE,z*TILE) < WATER_LEVEL+0.6) continue;

      }catch(e){}

  /* ---------- the coloured overlay ---------- */
  function rebuildOverlay(){
    var g=G(); if(!g.scene||!g.THREE) return;
    if(Z.overlay){ try{ g.scene.remove(Z.overlay); }catch(e){} Z.overlay=null; }
    var keys=Object.keys(Z.map);
    if(!keys.length) return;
    var grp=new g.THREE.Group();
    var mats={};
    for(var id in ZONES) mats[id]=new g.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color:ZONES[id].col, transparent:true, opacity:0.3, depthWrite:false,
      side:g.THREE.DoubleSide });
    var geo=new g.THREE.PlaneGeometry(g.TILE*0.9, g.TILE*0.9);
    var byZone={};
    for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
      var id=Z.map[keys[i]];
      (byZone[id]=byZone[id]||[]).push(keys[i]);
    }
    for(var zid in byZone){
      var list=byZone[zid];
      var im=new g.THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mats[zid], list.length);
      var m=new g.THREE.Matrix4(), q=new g.THREE.Quaternion();
      q.setFromAxisAngle(new g.THREE.Vector3(1,0,0), -Math.PI/2);
      for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++){
        var p=list[j].split(','), x=(+p[0])*g.TILE, z=(+p[1])*g.TILE;
        m.compose(new g.THREE.Vector3(x,(g.groundHeight(x,z)||0)+0.12,z), q,
                  new g.THREE.Vector3(1,1,1));
        im.setMatrixAt(j,m);

      im.renderOrder=3;

  /* ---------- demand ---------- */
  function recalcDemand(){
    var pop=0, jobs=0, homes=0, shops=0, ind=0, off=0, educated=0;
    try{
      pop=cityPop;
      for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++){
        var b=buildings[i], d=CITY[b.key]||{};
        if(d.pop) homes+=d.pop*lvlOut(b.lvl);
        if(d.jobs) jobs+=d.jobs*lvlOut(b.lvl);
        if(d.cat==='Civic'&&d.makes&&d.makes.credits) shops+=d.jobs||0;
        if(d.cat==='Industry') ind+=d.jobs||0;
        if(b.key==='office'||b.key==='corptower') off+=d.jobs||0;
      }
      educated=(typeof cityCover!=='undefined'? cityCover.education : 0.3)*pop;
    }catch(e){}
    var workforce=pop*0.62;
    // people want homes when there is work; business wants staff when there are people
    Z.demand.res = clamp((jobs-workforce)/Math.max(40,jobs+40) + (homes<pop?0.5:0) + 0.15);
    Z.demand.com = clamp((pop/Math.max(60,shops*16+60)) - 0.35);
    Z.demand.ind = clamp((shops+pop*0.1)/Math.max(60,ind*14+60) - 0.35);
    Z.demand.off = clamp(educated/Math.max(50,off*12+50) - 0.4);
    Z.demand.res = Math.max(Z.demand.res, homes<pop? 0.8 : Z.demand.res);

  function nearRoad(gx,gz){
    try{

    }catch(e){}
    return false;
  }
  function tierFor(zid, gx, gz){
    var t=ZONES[zid].tiers;
    // denser buildings appear where the district is already busy and well served
    var score=0;
    try{
      var svc=(typeof cityServices!=='undefined')? cityServices : 0;
      var neigh=0;
      for(var dx=-4;dx<=4;dx++) for(var dz=-4;dz<=4;dz++)
        if(occupied[(gx+dx)+','+(gz+dz)]) neigh++;
      score = Math.min(1, neigh/26)*0.6 + svc*0.4;
    }catch(e){}
    var idx=Math.min(t.length-1, Math.floor(score*t.length));
    while(idx>0 && !exists(t[idx][0])) idx--;
    return t[idx];
  }
  function growOne(){
    var keys=Object.keys(Z.map);
    if(!keys.length) return;
    for(var tries=0;tries<40;tries++){
      var key=keys[(Math.random()*keys.length)|0];
      var zid=Z.map[key];
      if(!ZONES[zid]) continue;
      if(Z.demand[zid]<=0.05) continue;                  // nobody wants to build here
      var p=key.split(','), gx=+p[0], gz=+p[1];
      try{ if(occupied[key]) continue; }catch(e){}
      if(!nearRoad(gx,gz)) continue;
      var pick=tierFor(zid,gx,gz);
      if(!exists(pick[0])) continue;
      var d=CITY[pick[0]];

      try{
        var wx=gx*TILE, wz=gz*TILE;
        if(typeof buildingOverlaps==='function' && buildingOverlaps(wx,wz,buildRadius(pick[0]),null,pick[0])) continue;
        var b=placeCityBuilding(pick[0], gx, gz, pick[1]||1, {animate:true, free:{x:wx,z:wz}});

  }

      if(!cands.length) return;

    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      if(!Z.tool||e.button===2) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      Z.painting=true;
      var gp=null; try{ gp=g.pointerToGrid(e); }catch(err){}
      if(gp) paintAt(gp.gx,gp.gz);
    }, true);
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
      if(!Z.tool||!Z.painting) return;
      var gp=null; try{ gp=g.pointerToGrid(e); }catch(err){}
      if(gp) paintAt(gp.gx,gp.gz);
    }, true);
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', function(){ Z.painting=false; }, true);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape' && Z.tool){ Z.tool=null; say('Zoning off'); }
      if(!Z.tool) return;
      if(e.key==='['){ Z.brush=Math.max(0,Z.brush-1); say('Brush '+(Z.brush*2+1)); }
      if(e.key===']'){ Z.brush=Math.min(6,Z.brush+1); say('Brush '+(Z.brush*2+1)); }
    }, true);
  }

  var last=Date.now();
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(), dt=Math.min(0.2,(now-last)/1000)||0.016; last=now;
    if(!ingame()) return;
    Z.t+=dt;
    try{
      bind();
      if(Z.dirty){ Z.dirty=false; rebuildOverlay(); }
      if(Z.t>1.5){
        Z.t=0;
        recalcDemand();
        Z.grow+=1;
        if(Z.grow>=2){ Z.grow=0; growOne(); abandonOne(); }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();
/* ===================== DOMINION · ZONING END ===================== */

/* ===================== DOMINION · CALENDAR, LIFE & UPKEEP START ===========
   A real calendar, people being born and dying, buildings that cost money to
   keep running, and rubbish that has to go somewhere.
   ========================================================================= */
(function(){
  if (window.__DOM_CIVIC) return;
  var C = window.__DOM_CIVIC = {
    day:1, month:1, year:1, lastDay:-1,
    births:0, deaths:0, waste:0, wasteCap:0, upkeep:0, t:0
  };
  var MONTHS=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  C.dateText=function(){ return C.day+' '+MONTHS[(C.month-1)%12]+' Yr '+C.year; };

  function ingame(){ try{ return !!gameStarted && !document.body.classList.contains('inMenu'); }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function note(k,t){ try{ if(window.__DOM_SIDE) window.__DOM_SIDE.note(k,t); }catch(e){} }

  /* ---------- the calendar turns with the day cycle ---------- */
  function tickCalendar(){
    var t=0; try{ t=dayTime; }catch(e){ return; }
    var d=Math.floor(t*1000);
    if(C.lastDay<0){ C.lastDay=d; return; }
    if(d<C.lastDay){                      // the clock wrapped: a new day
      C.day++;
      if(C.day>30){ C.day=1; C.month++;
        if(C.month>12){ C.month=1; C.year++;
          note('good','📅 A new year begins — Year '+C.year+'.');
        } else note('info','📅 '+MONTHS[C.month-1]+' begins.');
        endOfMonth();
      }
      endOfDay();
    }
    C.lastDay=d;
  }

  /* ---------- births and deaths ---------- */
  function endOfDay(){
    var S=window.__DOM_SIM;
    if(!S || !S.cohorts) return;
    var food=1, housingRoom=0, health=0, happy=60;
    try{ food=(STOCK.food||0)>0?1:0; }catch(e){}
    try{ health=(typeof cityCover!=='undefined')? cityCover.health : 0; }catch(e){}
    try{ happy=cityHappy; }catch(e){}
    try{ housingRoom=(S.stats&&S.stats.vacancy)||0; }catch(e){}

    var born=0, died=0;
    for(var i=S.cohorts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var co=S.cohorts[i];
      // people grow older
      co.years=(co.years||0)+1;
      if(co.years>26 && co.age==='child'){ co.age='young'; co.years=0; }
      else if(co.years>90 && co.age==='young'){ co.age='adult'; co.years=0; }
      else if(co.years>160 && co.age==='adult'){ co.age='senior'; co.years=0; }

      // a settled, fed household with room to grow has children
      if((co.age==='young'||co.age==='adult') && food && housingRoom>1 && happy>32){
        // a modest base rate, rising with contentment
        if(Math.random() < 0.06 + Math.max(0,(happy-32))/700){
          co.size+=1; born++; housingRoom--;
        }
      }
      // seniors pass away, sooner without healthcare
      if(co.age==='senior'){
        var risk=0.018*(1-health*0.75);
        if(Math.random()<risk){
          co.size-=1; died++;
          if(co.size<=0){ S.cohorts.splice(i,1); }
        }
      }
    }
    if(born||died){
      C.births+=born; C.deaths+=died;
      try{ cityPop=Math.max(0, cityPop + born - died); }catch(e){}
    }
    if(born>2) note('good','👶 '+born+' children born today.');
    if(died>2) note('warn','🕯 '+died+' residents passed away'+(health<0.3?' — healthcare is thin.':'.'));
  }

  /* ---------- monthly bills ---------- */
  function endOfMonth(){
    try{
      var bill=Math.round(C.upkeep*30);
      if(bill>0){
        STOCK.credits=(STOCK.credits||0)-bill;
        if(STOCK.credits<0){
          STOCK.credits=0;
          note('bad','💸 The city could not pay its upkeep of '+bill+'₡. Services are suffering.');
          try{ cityHappy=Math.max(0, cityHappy-6); }catch(e){}
        } else note('money','💸 Monthly upkeep paid: '+bill+'₡.');
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }

  /* ---------- upkeep and rubbish ---------- */
  function tickCosts(dt){
    var up=0, waste=0, cap=0;
    try{
      for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++){
        var b=buildings[i], d=CITY[b.key]||{};
        if(d.core) continue;
        // running costs scale with size and level
        var base=(d.jobs||2)*0.02 + (d.powerUse||0)*0.03 + (d.foot||1)*0.05;
        if(d.mega) base*=1.6;
        up += base*lvlOut(b.lvl);
        // households and businesses put out rubbish; some buildings take it away
        if(d.pop) waste += d.pop*lvlOut(b.lvl)*0.004;
        else if(d.jobs) waste += d.jobs*lvlOut(b.lvl)*0.002;
        if(d.handlesWaste) cap += d.handlesWaste*lvlOut(b.lvl)*(b.eff===undefined?1:b.eff);
      }
    }catch(e){}
    C.upkeep=up; C.wasteCap=cap;
    // rubbish piles up when collection cannot keep pace
    C.waste = Math.max(0, C.waste + (waste-cap)*dt);
    if(C.waste>60 && !C._wasteWarned){
      C._wasteWarned=true;
      note('bad','🗑 Rubbish is piling up in the streets. Build a Recycling Centre or Landfill.');
    }
    if(C.waste<20) C._wasteWarned=false;
    // and it makes people miserable
    try{
      if(C.waste>25) cityHappy=Math.max(0, cityHappy - Math.min(0.04, C.waste*0.0004)*dt*60);
    }catch(e){}
    window.__DOM_WASTE=C.waste;
  }

  var last=Date.now();
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    var now=Date.now(), dt=Math.min(0.3,(now-last)/1000)||0.016; last=now;
    if(!ingame()) return;
    C.t+=dt;
    try{
      tickCalendar();
      if(C.t>0.5){ tickCosts(C.t); C.t=0; }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loop); else loop();
})();
/* ===================== DOMINION · CALENDAR, LIFE & UPKEEP END ============= */
</script>
